fdroid:app.atrium.name: Atrium
fdroid:app.atrium.summary: Control your self-hosted media stack from one app
fdroid:app.atrium.description:
Atrium is a controller for the servers you already run. Point it at your own
machines and manage the whole stack from your phone, without a middleman
account and without anything phoning home.
It is a controller, not a media player. Atrium browses and manages your media
servers; it does not stream video.
Supported services:
* Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr - library, queue, wanted, history, blocklist,
 system status and the full settings tree
* Prowlarr - indexers, search and grab
* Bazarr - subtitle status, search and download
* Seerr (Overseerr and Jellyseerr) and Ombi - discover, request and manage
 requests
* Tautulli - active streams, history, statistics and users
* Tracearr - who is streaming across Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, watch and
 library statistics, history, a media catalog and policy incidents
* qBittorrent, Deluge, Transmission, rTorrent and aria2 - torrent and
 download lists, transfers and per-download files, peers and trackers
* SABnzbd and NZBGet - usenet queue control and history
* slskd - Soulseek search, transfers, a peer's shares, chat rooms and
 direct messages
* Cleanuparr - malware blocked, strikes on stalled downloads and the audit
 log of what it cleaned
* Jellyfin, Emby and Plex - library browsing, item detail, resume rows and
 now-playing sessions
* Navidrome - artists, albums and tracks, playlists, ratings and favorites
* Glances, Beszel and dashdot - CPU, memory, GPU and disk usage of the host
* Speedtest Tracker and MySpeed - internet speed results and history
* Unraid - array and disk health, per-core system load, Docker containers and
 virtual machine control
* Gluetun - VPN status, the forwarded port and a one-tap reconnect
* AdGuard Home - protection on, off or paused for a while, DNS statistics,
 the query log, filter lists, custom rules, blocked services, rewrites,
 per-client settings and the server's DNS settings
Features:
* Multiple profiles, so a phone can carry more than one stack
* Every instance holds a local and an external URL, and Atrium picks the right
 one for the network you are on
* A dashboard of at-a-glance widgets you can reorder: active downloads, now
 streaming, upcoming releases, recently added, recently downloaded, requests,
 server vitals, speedtest results, VPN status, DNS protection, download
 cleanup and Wake-on-LAN
* Share a magnet or torrent file to a download client, or a movie or show
 link (IMDb, TMDB, Letterboxd, Trakt) to Radarr or Sonarr
* atrium:// links that open a service, movie or show from notifications and
 automation apps
* Custom HTTP headers, for the whole profile or one instance, so services
 behind a reverse proxy keep working
* Profile import and export
* Material 3 Expressive design with dynamic color, custom palettes, light and
 dark themes
* An optional biometric lock
Privacy:
There is no analytics, no telemetry, no advertising and no account. Atrium
never reports anything back to its developers. Credentials are held in
encrypted storage on the device.
Artwork is loaded from your own servers, which cache it, rather than from
sites like TheTVDB or TMDB. There is one exception worth knowing about.
Searching for something to add that your servers have never seen has nothing
cached for it yet, so its poster comes from the artwork site directly, which
then sees your address. The other is sharing a Letterboxd link to Atrium:
Letterboxd's short link has to be opened on letterboxd.com to learn which
film it is. Everything else goes only to the servers you configure.
Free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later.

fdroid:chat.jmp.simmanager.name: JMP SIM Manager
fdroid:chat.jmp.simmanager.summary: Companion app for the JMP eSIM Adapter
fdroid:chat.jmp.simmanager.description:
JMP SIM Manager is a fully free and open-source companion app for the JMP eSIM Adapter. The JMP eSIM Adapter is a removable eSIM chip that enables any device, not just those with included eSIM chips, to make use of downloadable eSIMs.
JMP SIM Manager provides management features such as adding, deleting, enabling, and disabling eSIM profiles for the adapter, and is the easiest option to manage your eSIM Adapter on compatible Android host devices. The manager app is not required once a profile has been downloaded and enabled on the adapter. In other words, you can use a compatible Android device to download your eSIM profile of choice onto the adapter, and then insert the adapter into any device -- Wi-Fi hotspots, dumb phones, laptops -- and the adapter will simply appear as a regular SIM card to those devices.
This app also includes a quick compatibility check to determine whether your Android device can be used to manage a JMP eSIM Adapter. Although the eSIM Adapter will work with almost any device once an eSIM profile is loaded, management requires some specific features that may not be present on a small percentage of Android devices. However, even if your Android device is deemed incompatible, you can still manage the adapter from another Android device, using a PC/SC reader on a PC, or, as a final fallback, through the SIM Toolkit menu along with a self-hostable remote server to handle TLS termination.

fdroid:org.fdroid.fdroid.privileged.name: F-Droid Privileged Extension
fdroid:org.fdroid.fdroid.privileged.summary: Services to allow F-Droid to securely install and update apps
fdroid:org.fdroid.fdroid.privileged.description:
Note: F-Droid requires root privileges to install Privileged Extension
as a system "priv-app".
https://f-droid.org/packages/org.fdroid.fdroid can make use of system privileges or permissions
to install, update and remove applications on its own. The only way to
obtain those privileges is to become a system app.
This is where the Privileged Extension comes in - being a separate app
and much smaller, it can be installed as a system app and communicate
with the main app via AIDL IPC.
This has several advantages:
* Reduced disk usage in the system partition
* System updates don't remove F-Droid
* The process of installing into system via root is safer
Instead of this build, most users will want to install the
"Over-The-Air" (OTA) update ZIP file is called
https://f-droid.org/packages/org.fdroid.fdroid.privileged.ota. This is here to update
Privileged Extension when it has been installed using the OTA ZIP.

fdroid:pl.ascendit.onetimealarm.description:

Using standard alarm app I had a lot of alarms which then I had to delete manually to avoid clutter.
Using the standard calendar event notifications were not loud enough so I could forget about them if I didn't have my phone nearby.
This app solves this use case. After alarm is fired it is deleted, it doesn't have to be deleted manually as in normal alarm application.
READ BEFORE USE!
In this app it's only possible to set alarms which don't repeat and only for today or tomorrow!
Don't expect this app to be used as a replacement for your standard alarm app or calendar! 
It's a different type of application! It is not a calendar or standard alarm clock app.

fdroid:pw.dotto.netmanager.foss.name: NetManager
fdroid:pw.dotto.netmanager.foss.summary: A FOSS mobile network monitoring app built with ease-of-use and speed in mind.
fdroid:pw.dotto.netmanager.foss.description:
NetManager is a powerful, open-source mobile network monitoring app made for everyday users, enthusiasts, and network professionals. 
Built with Flutter and adhering to Material Design guidelines, it provides a clean and fast way to gather mobile cell data.
 Features 
Cleanly displays real-time network metrics across all cellular technologies up to 5G NR, complete with full Dual SIM support for concurrent monitoring.
Import custom cell database files (.ntm and .clf v3) to enrich network details and view active cell towers on a customizable map powered by OpenStreetMap.
Record radio signal strength and network info during trips (drive tests). Replay them inside the app or export them to .kml/.csv formats to view in external tools like Google Earth.
Built-in speed test utility supporting LibreSpeed, OpenSpeedTest and custom backends.
Tracks real-time network changes, such as cell handoffs and frequency band adjustments; receive system notifications for the events you choose.
Optional background service records network events and trip data even when the app is closed, keeping you updated via an active status notification.
Access hidden Android field testing menus (such as Samsung ServiceMode, MTK Engineer Mode, MIUI BandMode, and Huawei ProjectMenu) directly without dialer codes.
Import speed tests from other apps (might require an account/connection to the respective app's services).
Easily read your SIM's carrier config, IMS info & logs with NetManager's advanced mode through Shizuku.
 Compatibility 
NetManager currently supports Android 7.0+ (API 24+).

apple-macos:1097637587.description:
The Absolute Secure Access product portfolio provides resilient network connectivity for users to securely access critical resources in the public cloud, private data centers, and on-premises. These products allow users to transition from traditional VPN to a resilient Zero Trust approach, without impairing productivity or admin controls.
Absolute VPN provides security and confidentiality for data in motion by means of encryption and access controls. It also offers benefits to the end user, such as making tunnel and network sessions resilient and optimizing streaming video and audio.
Absolute ZTNA provides a software-defined perimeter via Zero Trust Network Access, creating a context-based, logical access boundary around an application or set of applications – wherever they're hosted. It shields applications from the Internet, making them invisible to unauthorized users. Access policies are enforced at the endpoint, avoiding latency and any data transgression.
Absolute Insights for Network offers diagnostic and experience monitoring capabilities across endpoints and network, allowing organizations to proactively monitor, investigate, and remediate end user performance issues quickly and at scale, even on networks that are not company-owned or managed.
The Secure Access SaaS platform leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to provide highly resilient, advanced threat detection combined with user and entity behavior analysis (UEBA). Secure Access analyzes each device’s activity to establish a comprehensive baseline of normal network behavior for that device and user. Regardless of whether a device has Secure Access policies that route traffic inside or outside a tunnel, the new AI-powered network security and vulnerability detection capabilities continuously monitor all devices for deviations in behavior, analyzing network traffic, user behavior, application usage and data access patterns, including the following: 
• Data exfiltration
• Unsafe application and web browsing behavior
• Malicious network port scanning
• New applications generating network traffic
• Denial of service attacks
• Device being used at unusual times
• Higher than expected network activity
• New network usage patterns
• Device acting as a server
• Device refusing server-like requests
• Device network usage is abnormal
Secure Access generates configurable alerts with rich context and direct links to detailed Insights for Network dashboards, empowering security teams to prioritize and investigate potential threats. As new threats emerge and user behavior evolves, Secure Access automatically modifies its baseline for each user’s device and potential threat profiles, ensuring your defenses remain continuously updated.

flathub:info.exult.exult.name: Exult Ultima VII Engine
flathub:info.exult.exult.summary: Cross-platform engine for the Ultima VII games
flathub:info.exult.exult.description:
Exult is a project to recreate Ultima VII for modern operating systems, using the game's original
 plot, data, and graphics files.
 Ultima VII, an RPG from the early 1990's, still has a huge following. But, being a DOS game
 with a very nonstandard memory manager, it is difficult to run it on the latest computers. Exult
 is a project to create an Ultima VII game engine that runs on modern operating systems, capable
 of using the data and graphics files that come with the original game.
 Exult is written in C++ and runs on, at least, Linux, macOS and Windows using the SDL library
 to make porting to other platforms relatively easy. The current version supports all of "Ultima
 VII: The Black Gate" and "Ultima VII Part 2: Serpent Isle", allowing you to finish both games.
 This is only possible due to the work done by other fans who have decoded the various Ultima VII
 data files, especially Gary Thompson, Maxim Shatskih, Jakob Schonberg, and Wouter Dijkslag.
 Exult aims to let those people who own Ultima VII (copyright 1993) play the game on modern hardware,
 in as close to (or perhaps even surpassing) its original splendor as is possible. You need to own
 "Ultima VII: The Black Gate" and/or "Ultima VII Part 2: Serpent Isle" and optionally the add-ons
 (not required to run) in order to use Exult, and we encourage you to buy a legal copy. The game
 data from at least one of these games must be installed in a specific directory to play; please
 refer to the Exult documentation for more information.

flathub:io.github.Adda0.Stardrop.name: StardropForked
flathub:io.github.Adda0.Stardrop.description:
StardropForked is my fork of Stardrop with added support for Flatpak (no additional changes
 have been made).
 While all should already work, there may still be some features of the upstream Stardrop which
 do not work for one reason or another, but in general the Flatpak seems to be in a working state.
 Adding mods, checking for updates, selecting mods for your mod list, and updating your profiles
 works.
 Direct all issues and bug reports to the issues on the linked homepage. I would highly appreciate
 it if some of you could give it a try (any Linux users, especially those on Steam Deck, and anyone
 else with Flatpak support on their system) and report back what are the results.
 Stardrop is an open-source, cross-platform mod manager for the game Stardew Valley. It is built
 using the Avalonia UI framework.
 Stardrop utilizes SMAPI (Stardew Modding API) to simplify the management and update checking
 for all applicable Stardew Valley mods. Stardrop is also non-destructive due to how it integrates
 with SMAPI, meaning it can be uninstalled without any impact on SMAPI, Stardew Valley or the original
 mod folder. Profiles are also supported, allowing users to have multiple mod groups for specific
 gameplay or multiplayer sessions. Stardrop also supports the Nexus Mods API, which allows for features
 such as endorsing mods directly from Stardrop. Other features, such as downloading mod updates
 via Stardrop are available to premium Nexus Mods users.

flathub:io.github.hakandundar34coding.sy.name: System Monitoring Center
flathub:io.github.hakandundar34coding.sy.description:
A multi-featured, low-resource system monitor that lets you easily track and manage CPU, RAM,
 disk, network, and GPU usage
 Features:
 Detailed system performance and usage usage monitoring/managing features
 Monitoring CPU, RAM, Disk, Network, GPU hardware/usage information
 Monitoring and managing processes and services (systemd)
 Monitoring users, sensors and general system information
 Supports PolicyKit. No need to run the application with "sudo"
 Hardware selection options (selecting CPU cores, disks, network cards, GPUs)
 Plotting performance data of multiple devices at the same time
 Interactive charts for querying performance data on any point
 Option for showing processes as tree or list
 Optimized for low CPU usage
 Customization menus for almost all tabs
 Supports ARM architecture
 Free and open source
 Notes for Limitations:
 GPU usage information availability depends on vendor/driver.
 GPU load is not tracked if GPU tab is switched off (for lower CPU usage).
 Virtual machines may not provide CPU min-max frequencies, sensors and RAM hardware information.
 Non-Flatpak versions of the application has higher performance (start speed, CPU, RAM usage).
 Notes for Flatpak Support:
 Flatpak version of the application uses some permissions (like not sandboxed) to access performance/system
 information of the host OS.
 Flatpak package of the application may be installed for system-wide instead of user-specific
 for avoiding source code modifications.

Spiderbro is a retro inspired adventure puzzle game for Windows and Linux. You play as Spiderbro, a purple spider that has to face an oppressive and dystopian environment whilst overcoming the obstacles of a shadowy adversary.
 EXPLORE, COLLECT ITEMS, SOLVE PUZZLES! Don't get left behind! Overcome the shadow spider's obstacles by exploring the environment and collecting items for your inventory! Use your inventory items on world objects to solve puzzles! Got a locked door to get through? Better find a key!
 IN-GAME PC's TO FURTHER HELP YOUR JOURNEY! Use the in-game PCs to be able to check for further clues! Text logs with clues and backstory on the local environment can be found on PCs found throughout the game! They can also dispense inventory items, list your inventory, save the game and more!
 WATCH OUT FOR THE SHADOW WORLD! What is with those grey cracks in the walls? Why are PC files being corrupted? Why is the shadow spider here and where are they from? Enter the shadow world at your own risk! The puzzles are bound to be harder!
 EVEN MORE! Simple keyboard controls. Atmospheric soundtrack. Audio and display options.
 CONTROLS Arrow Keys - Move. Space - Use. Q - Pause/Main Menu.

firefox-addons:2923564.name: cSPY - SecurityHeader Scanner
firefox-addons:2923564.summary: Advanced security header scanner with CSP analysis, multi-engine scoring, actionable recommendations, and PDF report export. Zero external requests — all analysis runs locally.
firefox-addons:2923564.description:
CSPy is a professional-grade browser extension that audits HTTP security headers in real time. Built for developers, penetration testers, and security researchers.
WHAT IT DOES
• Scans every HTTP response header on any website
• Deep Content-Security-Policy (CSP) directive-by-directive analysis
• Detects missing, weak, or misconfigured headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CORS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, COEP, CORP, cookies)
• Grades security posture from A+ to F with a 0–100 score
MULTI-ENGINE CONSENSUS
• Three independent scoring engines: CSPy, Google CSP Evaluator, and Mozilla Observatory
• Cross-validates results — when engines agree, confidence is high
ACTIONABLE RECOMMENDATIONS
• Every finding includes a plain-English fix
• Copy-paste server configurations for nginx, Apache, Express, Django, Cloudflare Workers, and Vercel
• Prioritised by severity — fix what matters first
EXPORT & REPORTING

firefox-addons:2971552.name: Video Enhancer
firefox-addons:2971552.summary: Real-time HDR-style color enhancement and shadow recovery for web video. Features an on-screen quick-tweak HUD, smart shadow boost, tuned presets, and zero data collection. visit my official Github: Ronin-CK/Video-Enhancer
firefox-addons:2971552.description:
Transform washed-out streaming video and recover crushed shadow details on LED and IPS displays in real time. Video Enhancer delivers simulated HDR color grading, contrast calibration, and edge refinement directly to HTML5 video players across the web without modifying the source stream or causing frame drops.
KEY FEATURES
• On-Screen Quick Tweak HUD: Adjust settings directly over the video player without opening the extension popup. The sleek on-screen bar auto-hides smoothly after idle time and wakes up instantly on mouse movement.
• Proportional Drag & Drop: Drag the HUD or tweak panel anywhere on screen. It remembers its exact relative placement across window resizing, theater mode, and fullscreen playback. Double-click the header or bar to quickly reset to default.
• Quick Dismissal: Press Escape to close the adjustment panel without exiting browser fullscreen, or click anywhere on the video backdrop.
• Shadow Boost: Recovers lost details in pitch-black and dark night scenes using a calibrated non-linear gamma curve that preserves true black anchors without washing out contrast or turning blacks milky.
• Filmic Highlight Rolloff: Calibrated anti-clipping knee curve (18% knee, 40% compression) that rolls off harsh highlights to prevent blown-out whites.
• Anti-Blooming Sharpness Mask: Custom SVG convolution matrix sharpening paired with a 33-point luminance protection curve. High-luminance areas (such as white clothing and bright lights) automatically roll off to eliminate unnatural halos and edge blooming.
• Decoupled Saturation & Skin-Safe Vibrance: Independent chrominance controls allowing you to boost colors while protecting natural skin tones and neutral whites.
• Calibrated Dynamic Range: Contrast is tuned with strict bounds (75% to 135%) to protect dynamic range and prevent highlight bleaching.
• Direct 1:1 Control Pipeline: All 9 visual sliders operate independently with true 1:1 direct fidelity, free of compounding multiplier controls.
• Audio Booster & Dialogue Compressor: Boost quiet audio up to 400% with dynamic dialogue leveling for clearer speech during loud action scenes.
• Aspect Ratio & Ultrawide Zoom: Easily fit 16:9 video to 21:9 ultrawide displays (no black bars), stretch, fill, or mirror horizontally.
• Per-Site Memory: Automatically remembers custom settings and enabled states per website.
• Image & Thumbnail Support: Optional toggle to apply your color tuning to static images and thumbnails across the web.
TUNED COLOR PRESETS
• Anime: Calibrated vibrant saturation, clean line art definition, and deep shadow recovery.
• Balanced: Natural tones with enhanced clarity for everyday viewing.
• Vivid: Punchy, rich color contrast for colorful streams and nature content.
• Cinema: Warm filmic tones, gentle highlight rolloff, and cinematic depth.
• Gaming: High visibility in dark shadows with bold edge definition.
• Image: Tailored color enhancement for static artwork, photos, and thumbnails.
(Right-click any preset button to rename it, or hit "+" to create unlimited custom profiles.)
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS
• Alt+Shift+H: Open or close the on-screen Quick Tweak HUD.
• Alt+Shift+V: Toggle the Video Enhancer engine on/off globally.
• [ and ]: Cycle through presets during fullscreen playback.
• Esc: Close the on-screen Quick Tweak panel.
PRIVACY & PERFORMANCE
• Zero Data Collection: Video Enhancer operates 100% locally on your machine. No analytics, no tracking, and no external network requests.
• Lightweight: Pure vanilla JavaScript and native browser filter pipelines designed for seamless 4K/60fps playback without battery drain.

firefox-addons:3066778.name: Readabler – Web Accessibility Toolbar
firefox-addons:3066778.summary: Read any website your way — fonts, contrast, spacing, reading masks and six accessibility profiles, on every page you open.
firefox-addons:3066778.description:
The web was not built for the way you read. Readabler fixes that — page by page, everywhere you go.
Some sites set body text at 13 pixels. Some run light grey on white. Some animate half the screen while you are trying to finish a sentence. You cannot rewrite those sites, and you should not have to. Readabler puts an accessibility panel in your toolbar and lets you adjust any page you land on: the typeface, the size, the spacing, the contrast, the colours, the motion, the noise. Turn something on once and it stays on — on that site, or on every site you open, whichever you prefer.
If you already know Readabler from the accessibility widget on other people's websites, this is the same engine, now working for you on sites that never installed it.
Press Alt+A, or click the icon in the toolbar, and the panel opens.

bluejetty:00149385:ios.description:
Play With ASL is a gamified approach to American Sign Language for kids, families, classrooms, and ASL learners of all backgrounds. Real ASL signing — filmed by deaf educators — meets fun mini-games designed to make vocabulary stick.
== Memory Match ==
Flip cards to match ASL signs with their English meanings across 12 themed packs: Animals, Camping, Colors, Food, Nature, Vehicles, Crafts, Emotions, Jobs, Space, Travel, and Weather. Earn stars and help Apollo the monkey collect bananas as you build your vocabulary.
== TILT! ==
A brand-new motion-based mini-game. Tilt your device to guide signs through the screen — an active, hands-on way to reinforce the vocabulary you learn.
== Free + Subscription ==
Two packs (Animals + Colors) are free for everyone — try the games before you commit. Unlock the full library of 12 packs across every game with a Monthly or Yearly subscription, or buy individual packs as one-time purchases.
== What Makes Us Different ==
- Every sign filmed by deaf ASL educators
- No third-party advertising
- No data sold or shared with brokers
- Designed with families and classroom use in mind
- Account sync across iPhone and iPad
- Cancel subscription anytime in Apple Settings
== Always Growing ==
Memory Match and TILT! are just the start. We're actively building more mini-games, story modes, and content packs. Your subscription includes every future addition we ship.
Questions, feedback, or ideas? Visit www.playwithasl.com or write to us at jon@playwithasl.com.
Made by the Play With ASL team — small studio, big goals.

bluejetty:00014027:ios.description:

bluejetty:00120265:ios.summary: Play and learn English grammar, vocabulary and sentence structure free by ordering the words to form correct sentences and sayings. Sentence Master is a fun and educational game for kids and English language students of all ages who want to
bluejetty:00120265:ios.description:
Play and learn English grammar, vocabulary and sentence structure free by ordering the words to form correct sentences and sayings. Sentence Master is a fun and educational game for kids and English language students of all ages who want to learn and improve their language skills in a more entertaining way.
How do you play?
It’s easy. The game consists of putting the scrambled words from each level in order to form a correct sentence. (Beginner, skilled, professional, expert, sayings.)
If you make a mistake and click the English Word in the incorrect order, there is a time penalty.
Once you have completed the sentence you will receive a score based on how fast you were and your total number of errors.
You can share your knowledge with other players worldwide thanks to online multiplayer mode or with your friends on Game Center.
Are you an English student who wants to improve your skills? Sentence Master will help you organize the words in your sentences correctly.
Are you an English expert who wants to show off your skills? Prove it in Competition mode on Game Center.
Sentence Master is the first game of its kind designed and developed completely by educators to help students eliminate the most common mistake among English language learners, correct word order. With four levels from beginner to expert, Sentence Master is a challenge for everyone from the Beginner to the most seasoned English language communicators. The Proverbs and Sayings level is a great way to learn and remember popular English idioms and expressions.
These are the levels:
Beginner: Ideal for children. This level contains the easiest sentences with the fewest words to unscramble.

bluejetty:00096793:ios.description:
Zuri’s Color — Your Home of Beauty, Culture and Love
Welcome home, sister.
Zuri’s Color is a creative sanctuary made for Black women across North America — a safe, loving space to celebrate your shade, your story, and your strength.
Here, every image reflects you: your glow, your confidence, your heritage, and your love.
Fashion and Self-Expression
Discover stunning art inspired by the richness of melanin skin tones, Afro beauty, and trendsetting style. From bold metallic looks to soft matte palettes, every color celebrates individuality. Fashion here is not about following rules — it is about owning your beauty and confidence.
Culture and Heritage
Experience the heartbeat of the community, from Juneteenth tributes to timeless moments of freedom, unity, and pride. Each piece of art honors shared history and the stories that connect generations of Black women with grace and resilience.
Love and Belonging
Zuri’s Color captures love in all its forms — romantic, family, and sisterhood. Feel the warmth of home, the laughter of loved ones, and the embrace of community through every brushstroke. Because love, in every shade, is beautiful.
A Space Made for You
Relax, create, and be seen.
Zuri’s Color is more than an app — it is a home for creativity, peace, and joy.
Your beauty is not defined by others’ standards; it is defined by you
Join a world where color meets soul, where culture shines bright, and where you truly belong.
Download Zuri’s Color and paint your story with love, pride, and purpose.

bluejetty:00185885:ios.description:
"I stare at the horizon every night before I sleep hoping to catch a glimpse of the lighthouse.The light reminds me of Grandpa and my summer visits playing on the cliffs. That warm life saving beacon not only saves ships, it keeps me safe too. Grandpa’s there just across the water watching over me.
But the lighthouse hasn't shone now for days and the fog is thick! What's happened? It's time to visit Grandpa!"
Beneath the lighthouse is a serene puzzle action game about a boy in search of his lost Grandpa. Your journey will take you through mysterious mechanical wheels that lay beneath the lighthouse!
**Beneath The Lighthouse is optimized for iPhone5, iPad3, iPad mini2 and iPod Touch 5G or Newer. You can try it on older devices, but we can’t guarantee a smooth rolling experience!
-This game is free to play or can be unlocked to a premium experience-
Free to Play:
We use advertising to monetise the experience. There are no coins/gems/booster to pay for or timers. The free version of the game contains a lives system which is carefully balanced to be fair but that makes the game slightly harder than premium.
Premium unlock:
We offer a single iAP to unlock the game to a premium experience. The premium version contains no 3rd party ads and we remove the lives system. 
This game contains cross promotion for other Nitrome games and this is not removed with the IAP for removal of ads.

bluejetty:00019095:ios.description:
Become the captain of an interstellar expedition! After a star ship crash, you’ve landed on a post-apocalyptic deadly planet. Evolution: Battle for Utopia is a new multi-genre blockbuster combining unprecedented Action, Strategy and Advanced Graphics into one RPG game. 
FEATURES:
- Engaging storyline: Utopia is a deadly, hostile planet, which survived the apocalypse. Uncover its darkest mysteries in an intergalactic adventure. 
- Exciting gameplay: Experience real-time battle action and develop smart tactics. Easy to pick up yet difficult to master the combat system delivers the strength of an action game. 
- Establish a colony: Build a military base and fortify your defence with a system of turrets.
- Terraform Utopia: Shape the planet as you transform scorched wasteland into a thriving environment. Research and exploit alien technology and pioneer evolution.
- Enthralling combat: Equip and upgrade yourself with the most advanced weaponry, and build an installation to run continental ballistic missiles to overwhelm enemies the size of a skyscraper!

- Fight alongside your friends and allies: Meet Fido, a cyborg dog and your faithful companion.
- Find valuable resources: Search through hidden loots and hack electronic terminals to grow your wealth.
- Communicate with your allies and enemies: A trusted team of four will follow you from the beginning. Challenge fellow players from all over the world to battles.
PLEASE NOTE! Evolution: Battle for Utopia is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00121743:ios.name: News Explorer
bluejetty:00121743:ios.summary:
News Explorer is a full-featured yet easy-to-use RSS, JSON, Atom, Reddit, YouTube, Podcast, Bluesky and Mastodon news reader with iCloud synchronization between Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV.
Full iCloud Sync
• News Explorer
bluejetty:00121743:ios.description:
News Explorer is a full-featured yet easy-to-use RSS, JSON, Atom, Reddit, YouTube, Podcast, Bluesky and Mastodon news reader with iCloud synchronization between Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV.
Full iCloud Sync
• News Explorer syncs your feeds, filters, folders, articles including statuses, notes and tags, across all your Apple devices.
• Synchronization is based on iCloud, so there is no need to login or to sign up into any other service, it just works out of the box.
Smart Filters
• Filter your news according your own conditions and preferences, easily accessible from the feeds list.
• Filters customizations are synced across all your devices.
Automatic Reader View
• Use automatic Reader view to download and read the full text version of truncated articles from supported sources.
• News Explorer makes use of multiple parsers to offer the best Reader view results.
Article Comments
• Read article comments from other readers directly in the app. 
• Works with RSS feeds that has comment feeds per article, YouTube feeds, Reddit feeds and Hacker News feeds.
• Also works with most feeds from websites that use Open Web comments.
Article Notes
• Create rich text notes, directly in the context of the article.
• Notes are synced via iCloud together with the related article.
Feed Settings
• All aspects of a feed like title, source link or icon, can be adjusted in the Feed settings dialog.
• Disable the feed temporarily or permanently.
• Override app settings for syncing, downloading comments and reading articles.
Feed Prefilters
• Prevent the app from downloading articles you don’t want to see or read.
• Prefilters are synced via iCloud, and can be easily configured on feed level in the Feed settings dialog.
Article Inspector
• Inspect metadata, tags, media, notes and comments of articles in the Inspector panel.
• View and add custom tags in the Metadata panel.
• Browse and download media, including podcasts, in the Media panel.
Article Tags
• Article categories of RSS articles are displayed in the Inspector panel as tags.
• Can be extended with your own tags.
• Custom tags are easily recognizable, and are synced via iCloud.
• Tags can be used as conditions in filters.
Local Account
• Add feeds to News Explorer that only exists on your device by activating the Local account option.
• The local account option can be used in addition to or instead of syncing with iCloud.
Reading Features
• Mark items as favorite for later reading.
• Navigate with one click to the original content.
• Full keyboard navigation.
• Full text search in the List and Timeline view.
• Mark as read while scrolling option.
• Image viewer to browse through all images of articles or feeds.
• Built-in sharing to Instapaper, Raindrop and Readwise.
• Share news items via Email, Messages and other services.
Configuration Features
• Countless settings to tweak layout, fonts, behaviors and more.
• Import and export feeds via OPML.
• Add new feeds via the Search new feeds or Add feed dialogs.
• Organize your feeds by assigning them to folders.
• Multiple themes, tint colors and app icons.
System Features
• Create automations with News Explorer actions in the Shortcuts app. 
• Option to index articles with Spotlight.
• Local notifications for feeds selected in the Feeds Manager.
• Widgets with adjustable sources and fonts.
Multi Platform
You only need to buy two apps to cover all Apple platforms: 
• News Explorer for Mac is available on the Mac App Store. 
• News Explorer for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV is a universal purchase app, available on the App Store of the mentioned devices. On visionOS you can use the iPadOS edition of News Explorer.
Support
• News Explorer has an extensive help page on https://betamagic.nl/support/newsexplorer/help.html. 
• If you still have questions or need support, email us at support@betamagic.nl. 
If you like News Explorer then feel free to leave a review or a rating in the App Store, it helps us a lot!

bluejetty:00167781:ios.description:
VOKA 3D Anatomy & Physiology is an advanced anatomy app and interactive atlas anatomy combining accurate anatomy 3D models with a growing library of pathology cases. This 3D anatomy learning platform helps users explore the human body atlas, study anatomy and physiology, and access a complete anatomy reference through realistic visualization.
The app includes 1,000+ 3D models of male and female structures covering systemic, regional, and micro levels. Users can explore the skeleton, study bones of the body, analyze muscle anatomy, and examine complex systems such as the anatomy of heart or brain structures. All models are created according to FIPAT medical terminology and reviewed by medical experts, making the platform a reliable medical reference and one of the most complete medical learning apps.
Explore Structures and Systems
The library works as a detailed body atlas and pocket anatomy guide, providing a complete anatomy overview for studying the anatomy of the human body.
Discover:
- the skeletal system and human bones
- detailed anatomy muscles and muscle anatomy
- systemic and regional structures in layered 3D views
- clear human 3d anatomy visualization
Users can also compare healthy vs pathological anatomy, helping connect structure with physiology and pathophysiology.
Learning and Visualization Tools
The app includes interactive features designed for anatomy training, education, and communication.
- Isolation mode to focus on specific structures
- X-ray mode to reveal internal layers
- AR mode for immersive visible anatomy presentations
- Interactive labels with Latin medical terminology and selected language
- Smart search to quickly find structures
- Personal collections to save models and med notes
These tools support daily anatomy study, lectures, and presentations.
Designed for Study and Practice
The platform is ideal for med student learning, teaching, and professional use.
Students can learn anatomy, review essentials of anatomy, explore functional anatomy, learn skeletal system structures, and learn brain anatomy.
Educators and healthcare professionals can teach anatomy, demonstrate pathology cases, and explain complex structures clearly.
Trusted by 500,000+ users in 190+ countries, the app supports medical study apps workflows and helps people learn medicine, understand human health, and explore the human body in detail.
Download VOKA: 3D Anatomy & Physiology to experience powerful 3D anatomy learning for education, training, and clinical communication.

Music picked by people who really know music. 
Finding something to listen to is easy. Music Choice gives you hundreds of ad-free channels with songs chosen by music experts, from the latest chart-toppers on Today’s Hits to holiday classics on Sounds of the Seasons, and everything in between. Pick a channel, press play, and see where the music takes you before you subscribe or create an account.
---
FEATURES
CHOSEN BY PEOPLE WHO KNOW MUSIC: Our music experts choose the songs for every channel, not algorithms. No AI-generated music, just real artists.
JUST PRESS PLAY: No playlists to build, endless scrolling, or commercial radio chatter. Pick a channel and let us handle the rest. Whether you need focus music for work, background tracks for a Saturday cleaning spree, or soothing sounds to wind down, the right music is ready when you are.
GO AHEAD, SKIP IT. We know every song can’t be your favorite. Skip what you’re not feeling and see what’s next.
LISTEN ANYWHERE: From your morning commute with CarPlay to late nights on your Smart TV or web browser, Music Choice goes wherever you go. 
CABLE SUBSCRIBERS: Already get Music Choice channels through your cable TV package? Sign in with your provider credentials to listen free. 
---

For more than 35 years, Music Choice has been a part of everyday routines and holiday traditions, adding a human touch to music wherever you are. Pick a channel, press play, and leave the music to us.

bluejetty:00061492:ios.description:
OnTheClock is the easy and accurate employee time clock app and time tracking app built for small businesses.
Track employee hours, manage PTO, create schedules, and run payroll, all in one place.
Stop juggling multiple tools. OnTheClock combines time tracking, employee scheduling, timesheets, PTO management, and payroll into a single, easy-to-use platform so you can save time, reduce errors, and get your team paid faster from the office or on the go.
KEY FEATURES
Time Clock & Employee Time Tracking
Employees clock in and out from mobile, tablet, or desktop.
Track employee hours in real time with accurate timesheets and time cards.
• GPS time tracking and geofencing (only clock in when on location)
• Prevent buddy punching with device restrictions and photo capture
• Real-time dashboard of who is clocked in (and where)
Built-In Payroll (No Integrations Required)
Run payroll directly from your time tracking data with our built in payroll, or use your current payroll tool with one of our user-friendly integrations.
• Approve timesheets and pay employees in minutes
• Automatic overtime calculations and tax handling
• Direct deposit and multiple pay rates and overtime rules supported
• No exports. No double entry. No separate payroll system.
Employee Scheduling
Create and manage employee schedules with ease.
• Drag-and-drop shift scheduling
• Notify employees instantly of schedule updates
• Reduce no-shows and scheduling conflicts
PTO & Leave Management
Track paid time off without spreadsheets.
• Employees request PTO in-app
• Automatic accrual tracking
• Simple approvals for managers
GPS, Geofencing & Attendance
• Know exactly where and when employees are working.
• GPS logs for every clock-in and clock-out
• Set job site boundaries with geofencing
Improve accountability and accuracy
Kiosk Time Clock
• Turn any tablet into a shared employee time clock.
• PIN, photo, or biometric clock-ins
• Ideal for job sites, restaurants, retail, and crews
Job Costing & Reporting
Track labor costs and make better decisions.
• Assign time to jobs or projects
• View detailed labor reports and timesheets
• Export data for accounting and audits
Integrations (Optional)
Already using another payroll provider?
• Integrates with QuickBooks, ADP, Gusto, Paychex, and more
WHO IT’S FOR
OnTheClock is built for small business owners and managers.
Perfect for:
• Construction and field service teams
• Restaurants and retail
• Healthcare and clinics
• Churches and nonprofits
• Any business that needs a reliable employee time clock
WHY BUSINESSES CHOOSE ONTHECLOCK
• All-in-one time tracking, scheduling, and payroll
• Transparent pricing and no long term contracts
• Simple setup and easy to use for any team
• Accurate time tracking that reduces payroll errors
• Saves hours of admin work every week
• U.S.-based customer support team with real humans ready to help
Ditch the complexity and run your business with one simple system. OnTheClock combines time tracking, employee scheduling, timesheets, PTO management, and payroll into one easy-to-use platform that saves time, reduces errors, and keeps your team paid accurately.
Built for small businesses that need a reliable time clock app, time tracker, and employee scheduling tool without the headaches.
Trusted by thousands of businesses across the U.S., with responsive, U.S.-based support when you need it.
Start your free trial today, no credit card required.
Learn more at ontheclock.com

bluejetty:00126066:ios.description:
Laban Key - gõ tiếng Việt hiệu quả, không lỗi trên mọi phiên bản hệ điều hành, bao gồm iOS 16. Bàn phím có khả năng kiểm tra chính tả và gợi ý từ có độ chính xác cao. Ngoài ra, bạn có thể thay đổi màu sắc, kích thước, hình nền để có bàn phím của riêng mình.
Các tính năng chính:
- Tùy chọn giao diện bàn phím với nhiều chủ đề đẹp mắt, đồng thời cho phép tự thiết kế chủ đề với phong cách của riêng bạn.
- Gõ Telex và VNI chuẩn như UniKey trên PC: bỏ dấu tại bất cứ đâu, tự động ngừng bỏ dấu khi nhập từ không phải tiếng Việt.
- Kiểu Telex nâng cao giúp tăng tốc độ gõ lên đáng kể: cc=ch, gg=gi, kk=kh, nn=ng, qq=qu, pp=ph, tt=th, uu=ươ.
- Gợi ý từ tiếp theo dựa trên từ đã gõ với độ chính xác cao, giúp tiết kiệm số phím bấm.
- Bàn phím emoji
- Tính năng gõ tắt
Các tính năng tiện ích:
- Di chuyển con trỏ nhanh bằng cách vuốt từ phím G.
- Thay đổi ngôn ngữ bằng cách vuốt trên phím Space.
- Xoá nhanh 1 từ / 1 dòng bằng cách vuốt ngắn / dài từ phím Delete.
- Luôn hiển thị dấu chấm "." phẩy ",".
- Tuỳ chọn luôn hiển thị hàng phím số giúp gõ nhanh và tiện lợi hơn.

bluejetty:00024934:ios.name: Archi - Kids Read-Along Story
bluejetty:00024934:ios.summary: Welcome to the magnificent Island of Phi Phi, where Archi and the island puppers live and play. Archi has always struggled to fit in because he was born different—with a cute arched tail and an inability to speak a word. But when a drought
bluejetty:00024934:ios.description:
Welcome to the magnificent Island of Phi Phi, where Archi and the island puppers live and play. Archi has always struggled to fit in because he was born different—with a cute arched tail and an inability to speak a word. But when a drought strikes and Archi is unknowingly left alone on the island, he stumbles upon a miracle. One by one, his deepest prayers are answered. For his final prayer, Archi wishes for the one thing he has always longed for. Will Archi get his heart’s desire and finally find his place on the island?
— A HEARTWARMING JOURNEY OF HOPE AND ANSWERED PRAYERS
When the world feels quiet and lonely, where do we turn? Archi is a beautifully crafted interactive experience that follows a non-verbal hero who discovers the power of reaching out. It is a comforting tool for parents and educators to help children navigate hardships, find their voice through reflection, and see the miracles that happen when we keep a hopeful heart.
— WHY FAMILIES LOVE ARCHI:
* Read and Learn Together: Children can listen to the story with Read-to-Me narration, hear it read aloud, and follow along with the text. These features encourage reading practice, help children repeat new words, build confidence, and enjoy a shared reading experience.
* Active Participation: Kids don't just watch—they Tap, Pull, Pop, and Drag objects, making them active participants in Archi’s journey toward his heart's desire.
* A Pure Experience: 100% Kid-Safe. No ads, no in-app purchases, and no external links. It’s a secure, distraction-free environment for independent exploration.
* Literacy & Learning: Professional narration and Read-to-Me modes help preschool children and early readers build vocabulary, practice reading, and gain confidence as they learn to read.
* A gentle Christian storybook that helps beginner readers build vocabulary, explore Christian faith, and enjoy interactive family reading.
— KEY FEATURES
* Available Anywhere, Anytime: 100% offline functionality. Once downloaded, the story, animations, and audio—including read-aloud and read-along functions—work perfectly without an internet connection, making Archi ideal for travel.
* Great for Teachers and Students: Perfect for classroom reading, small-group activities, and discussions about faith, kindness, empathy, and personal growth.
* Great for Preschool & Early Readers: A gentle interactive book for preschool children and early readers who are beginning to develop reading skills.
* Read-Along Storybook: Children can listen to professional narration while following along with the words, making Archi an engaging read-along book for independent or family reading.
* A Children’s Book for Family Reading: Enjoy Archi together as a children’s book that encourages parents to read with kids and share meaningful moments.
* Bedtime Stories: The gentle pace, narration, music, and interactive elements make Archi a comforting choice for heartwarming tales and a peaceful bedtime routine.
* Bible Stories & Christian Faith: Archi incorporates Bible-inspired themes of prayer, hope, perseverance, and answered prayers, offering families an opportunity to explore Christian faith.
* Bible Verse: And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives, and the one who seeks finds, and to the one who knocks it will be opened. (Luke 11: 9-10, ESV)
— A STORY OF RESILIENCE
Archi’s journey reminds us that even when we feel alone, help is never far away. By focusing on the universal values of persistence and faith, Archi bridges the gap between feeling lost and finding a home. It is a celebration of the quiet strength found in every child’s heart.

bluejetty:00166198:ios.description:
Brink: AI Workout Planner, Fitness Tracker & Photo Calorie Counter
Brink helps you create workout plans, track gym workouts, and log meals with photo nutrition tracking, all in one simple fitness app.
Whether your goal is to build muscle, lose weight, get stronger, or stay consistent, Brink gives you a clear plan, easy workout tracking, calorie and macro estimates, and progress tools that help you keep going.
No complicated setup. No guessing what to do next. Just a smarter way to train, eat, and stay consistent.
What You Can Do With Brink
Get a Personalized Workout Plan
Tell Brink your goals, experience level, schedule, and available equipment. Brink creates a workout plan built around you, whether you train at the gym, at home, or with limited equipment.
Use Brink to build muscle, lose weight, get stronger, improve fitness, create a gym routine, or stay consistent.
Your plan can be customized as your goals, schedule, or experience level changes.
Track Your Workouts
Follow your workout and log exercises, sets, reps, weight, and workout time.
Whether you are following a strength plan, gym workout routine, or general fitness program, Brink helps you stay organized and see your progress.
Follow Exercise Walkthroughs
Not sure how to do an exercise? Brink includes exercise guidance to help you feel more confident during your workouts.
Track Food From a Photo
Logging food should not take forever.
With Brink's photo nutrition tracking, you can take a picture of your meal and get an estimate of calories, protein, carbs, and fat.
Use Brink as your calorie tracker, macro tracker, and meal tracker to support your fitness goals.
Get Macro Recommendations
Brink can recommend daily nutrition targets based on your body, workouts, and goals, whether you are trying to lose fat, build muscle, or maintain progress.
See Your Progress
View your workout history, nutrition logs, and consistency over time. Staying motivated is easier when you can see the work adding up.
Why Brink?
Brink is built for people who want fitness to feel less confusing.
You get the structure of a workout plan, the convenience of a fitness tracker, and the simplicity of photo-based nutrition tracking in one app.
Brink can help you:
Create AI workout plans
Track gym workouts
Log sets, reps, and weights
Track calories and macros
Estimate nutrition from food photos
Build muscle
Lose weight
Stay consistent
Monitor progress
Whether you are new to fitness or already train regularly, Brink helps you know what to do next.
Common Questions
Can Brink create a workout plan for me?
Yes. Brink can create a personalized workout plan based on your goals, fitness level, schedule, and available equipment.
Is Brink good for beginners?
Yes. Brink is simple enough for beginners while still being useful for people who already work out.
Can I use Brink as a gym workout tracker?
Yes. Brink lets you follow workouts, track exercises, log sets and reps, record weights, and monitor progress.
Can Brink track calories from a food photo?
Yes. Take a photo of your food and Brink helps estimate calories, protein, carbs, and fat.
Can Brink help me build muscle or lose weight?
Yes. Brink can create workout plans and nutrition targets based on goals like building muscle, losing weight, getting stronger, or improving fitness.
Can I customize my workout plan?
Yes. Brink workout plans are customizable as your schedule, equipment, or goals change.
Subscription Information
Some features require a subscription to access.
Subscriptions are available as in-app purchases and are billed through your Apple ID account.

Welcome to QuickTune H5 - the most advanced tuning calculator for Forza Horizon 5!
=====================================
The TRIAL VERSION supports tuning for following cars:
2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Coupe
2021 Ford Bronco
2020 Toyota GR Supra
2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS
2017 Ford GT
2016 Lamborghini Centenario LP 770-4
2014 Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4
2018 McLaren Senna
2013 McLaren P1
2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS
Upgrade to FULL VERSION if you want to unlock tuning for all cars.
=====================================
FEATURES:
+ Calculates ready-made balanced and competitive tunes, no tweaking necessary!
+ Create road, dirt, cross country, drift, drag and top speed tunes
+ Choose between general purpose and track or season specific tunes
+ Supports night, rain and snow tuning
+ Advanced settings for adjustment of tune balance and stiffness
+ Supports imperial and metric units
+ "Favorites" features allows you to save and keep track of your favorite tunes
+ Automatically keeps track of 100 most recent tuned cars
+ Includes aero and transmission tuning
HOW DOES IT WORK:
1) Provide car details
- car model, power, weight & drivetrain
- installed key upgrades: suspension, chassis reinforcement, transmission, tire compound, tire width, aero kits
2) Choose tune type
- Road, Dirt, Cross Country, Drift, Dirt Drift, Drag, Top Speed
- Road, Dirt and Cross Country tunes allow further selection for specific season, conditions and track
3) View calculated tune
- Complete tune settings including aero and gearing
=====================================
ADVANCED FEATURES:
Advanced Tune Options:
---------------------------------------
Advanced tune options allow customizing of tire pressure, anti-roll bars, suspension, ride height, brake balance, differential, gearing and aero downforce.
Advanced Tune Settings:
---------------------------------------
Advanced tune settings allow you adjust tune balance and the stiffness to compensate for balance and stiffness issues that are caused by certain upgrade combinations.

bluejetty:00033807:ios.name: Empirical Sleep for Watch
bluejetty:00033807:ios.summary: Your Apple Watch tracks sleep stages, heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen, ECG, temperature, sleep apnea, breathing disturbances, and more—but what does all that data mean? More importantly, what do you actually do to get
bluejetty:00033807:ios.description:
Your Apple Watch tracks sleep stages, heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen, ECG, temperature, sleep apnea, breathing disturbances, and more—but what does all that data mean? More importantly, what do you actually do to get more shut eye?
If your Apple Watch detects sleep apnea, get testing and treatment covered by your health insurance.
Empirical Sleep distills your Apple Watch health data into one simple sleep score, then suggests actions to help you improve your sleep duration, onset, and quality. Unlike other free sleep trackers for Apple Watch, we're focused not just on more data, but helping you actually sleep better and get more shuteye.
** Sleep score **
Our sleep score auto combines everything into one simple number, including the percentage of time you spend in REM sleep, deep sleep, your heart rate, HRV, and oxygen during sleep, your sleep duration, and how long it took you to fall asleep.
On the checkup screen, you can monitor your health stats against other users of Empirical Sleep and medical norms to understand where you're above, below, and right around the average.
** Take action to improve your sleep **
The goal of all this health monitoring isn't just tracking—it's to act and get better shuteye. The goals tab suggests a comprehensive plan to improve your sleep, including assessing sleep hygiene and risk of sleep apnea.
** Monitor your risk of sleep apnea **
1 in 8 adults have sleep apnea. What's more, 80% of people with sleep apnea don't realize they have it. On the checkup screen, assess your risk of sleep apnea using a medically-validated questionnaire. If you receive an Apple Watch sleep apnea alert, book a priority appointment directly with a doctor for sleep apnea testing and treatment.
** Native Apple Watch app **
View your sleep duration, onset, quality, and stages (REM/deep/core/awake) directly on your watch using our native Apple Watch sleep app.
** Watch face & iPhone lock screen widgets **
Display your sleep stages, sleep duration, onset, and quality directly on your watch face or your iPhone's lock screen, using the new widgets introduced in iOS 16 and watchOS 9.
** Compatible, integrated with health, and free with an optional subscription **
Empirical Sleep is compatible with Apple Watch Series 3 and above. It integrates with the Health app to auto track your sleep segments, heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen (SpO2), steps, sleep stages, breathing disturbances, sleep apnea alerts, and activity. Empirical Sleep is a free app to download, with an optional paid subscription.
** About Empirical Health **
Empirical Health's mission is to build proactive healthcare. Today's healthcare system spends $1.1T reacting to chronic conditions and only a tenth of that on prevention. Our goal is to flip that and build a new type of primary care that's preventive rather than reactive, starting with sleep.
Please seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. If you need a doctor, you book a video visit directly through this app. We accept most major health insurance.

bluejetty:00175946:ios.description:
Can you clear the traffic jam without a single crash?
Traffic Jam Zero 3D is a challenging traffic puzzle game where every move matters. Your goal is simple: send every car safely off the road before time runs out.
But there's a catch.
One wrong move can cause a crash — and a crash means game over.
HOW TO PLAY
Each car has an arrow on its roof showing the direction it will move.
Tap a car to send it on its way. But before you tap, look carefully at the other cars around it and decide which car should move first.
If two cars collide, the level is over.
And cars aren't the only things you need to watch out for. Soccer balls, basketballs, and baseballs may roll across the road. Time your moves carefully and avoid hitting them.
To clear each level, you need to find the right combination of:
• Order — Which car should move first? 
• Timing — When is it safe to move? 
• Strategy — How can you clear every car without a collision?
 • Speed — Can you do it before time runs out?
371 LEVELS TO MASTER
The early levels will help you learn the rules, but don't expect the road ahead to stay easy.
As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and require careful observation, planning, timing, and sometimes several attempts to discover the solution.
A level may look impossible at first.
Look again. 
Try a different order.
 Change your timing.
 There is a way out.
With 371 levels to complete, Traffic Jam Zero 3D is made for players who enjoy challenging puzzles and the satisfaction of finally solving a level that seemed impossible.
NO CRASHES. CLEAR THE ROAD. BEAT THE CLOCK.
Think before you tap.
Can you escape all 371 traffic jams?

bluejetty:00026443:ios.description:
Solocator – The GPS Camera for Fieldwork and Photo Proof evidence. Overlay and stamp photos with location, direction, altitude, date & time taken. With the Industry Pack (in-app purchase), capture field notes including project name, photo description, company or username, and company logo.
Solocator is trusted by professionals, government agencies, and industries worldwide for reliable photo documentation.
TAILOR OVERLAY INFORMATION TO YOUR NEEDS
Capture & stamp on your photos:
+ GPS position (Latitude & Longitude in various formats) ± accuracy
+ UTM/MGRS coordinates (Industry Pack)
+ Street address (Industry Pack)
+ Direction – bearing
+ Altitude (MLS / HAE)
+ Tilt & Roll angles
+ Local date & time (based on GPS location)
+ Local time zone
+ UTC time
+ Compass display
+ Cardinal directions
+ Building facade direction, e.g. "North elevation"
+ Field Notes (Industry Pack)
+ Company Logo (Industry Pack)
AUTOSAVE PHOTOS TO iCLOUD & CAMERA ROLL
Autosave two photos at once: one stamped with the selected overlays and the other as an original high-resolution photo.
SORT, SEARCH, SHARE OR EMAIL
+ Photos are sorted by time, location, distance from current location and project name.
+ View photo direction and location in map view and navigate there.
+ Share photos individually or as a zip file via the share sheet.
+ Search for photos by date, date range or notes and street addresses.
+ Email photos including the following information:
 - Exif metadata
 - Compass direction
 - GPS position ± accuracy
 - Altitude
 - Tilt & Roll
 - Date & time taken
 - Street address (Industry Pack)
 - Cardinal Directions
 - Elevation of building facade
 - Links to maps so the receiver can navigate there easily
** INDUSTRY PACK ** (In-App Purchase) "One-off charge"
EDITABLE NOTES OVERLAY
Stamp photos with "Project name", "Description" & “Watermark”. The Project Name field can be used as a job or ticket number. The Watermark field is typically used for a company or username. You can also edit these fields later.
WATERMARK LOGO
Add your Company Logo to photos. You can customise the logo’s size, opacity, and position for both portrait and landscape photos. To get you started, a Solocator icon is included, which can be replaced.
CUSTOM EXPORT FILENAME
Define your photo export filename from a selection of fields: Project Name, Description, Watermark, Street Address, Date/Time, Number#, Custom text field, Photo type (original/stamped), and Coordinates (DD.dddddd, UTM, UTM Bands, MGRS). 
AUTOSAVE OR EXPORT PHOTOS TO CLOUD STORAGE
Autosave original and stamped photos to Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive (Personal & For Business), including SharePoint Sites and Teams. You can also save photos in date or project name subfolders automatically.
PHOTO DATA in KML, KMZ & CSV
Along with photos, email or export photo data and notes in KML, KMZ or CSV formats. Both email and export buttons are customisable to suit your data requirements.
STREET ADDRESS & UTM/MGRS
Add street address to your overlay or use UTM/, UTM Bands & MGRS coordinate formats.
BATCH EDIT NOTES & OVERLAY FIELDS
Select photos from the library and edit Project Name, Description & Watermark fields in one go.
TRACK PHOTOS IN MAP VIEW
View photos by direction, the distance between photos, area of photos taken and distance to your added markers via imported KML files or dropped pins.
REFINE & LOCK GPS LOCATION
Ideal for those working in and around buildings; to improve your GPS location. You can also use it to lock the asset position you're photographing.
COMPACT VIEW
Switch off Compass, Building and Street modes and only show the GPS info bar for a more compact view.
VPP Customers: https://solocator.com/enterprise-app-for-mdms/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00114191:ios.description:
Build, explore, and grow your own thriving animal village from the ground up.
Step into a vibrant forest world where your animals are ready to work, discover, and create. Merge, gather, and expand as you transform a quiet clearing into a bustling village full of life.

Help your animals gather resources, craft tools, and build homes, farms, and shops. Discover new areas, meet charming characters, and turn a small forest camp into a flourishing community.

bluejetty:00160181:ios.description:
Unlock the secrets of the wilderness with Animal Scat Identifier, the most advanced AI-powered wildlife tracking tool for your smartphone. Whether you are deep-woods hiking, scouting for hunting season, or exploring nature, our app turns your camera into a professional field guide. Identify animal droppings instantly and learn about the creatures sharing your trail.
INSTANT AI IDENTIFICATION
Simply snap a photo of any animal droppings or signs, and our cutting-edge neural network will identify the species in seconds. From deer and elk to bears and mountain lions, get accurate results and learn to read the signs of the forest.
COMPREHENSIVE WILDLIFE DATABASE
Go beyond simple identification. Access detailed profiles including:
- Diet and behavior patterns
- Habitat information
- Species-specific safety and health guidelines
- High-quality reference images
PERSONAL OBSERVATION LOG
Keep a digital diary of your discoveries. Save locations, photos, and notes to track wildlife movements over time. Perfect for hunters monitoring game or researchers documenting biodiversity.
SAFETY FIRST
Learn which animals are nearby and how to stay safe. Our app provides critical health warnings regarding scat handling and wildlife encounters, ensuring your outdoor experience remains safe and educational.
Perfect for:
- Hikers and Backpackers
- Hunters and Trackers
- Nature Educators and Students
- Wildlife Researchers
- Outdoor Enthusiasts
FREE FEATURES INCLUDE:
- Introductory Definitions: Start with a limited number of scat identifications.
- Basic Wildlife Database: Explore a selection of common species.
- Foundational Safety Tips: Discover essential advice for handling scat.
- Genre Insights: Learn key details about broad wildlife classifications.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION BENEFITS:
- Enhanced AI Insights: Experience advanced identification features.
- Full Database Access: Unlock a comprehensive repository of species information.
- Robust Health and Safety Details: Stay informed with detailed content.
- Seamless History Tracking: Log and transfer your observations with ease.
- Continuous Learning: Benefit from regular content expansions.
- No Limits: Enjoy unlimited scat identifications.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
- Premium subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans (weekly, monthly, or yearly, depending on availability).
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Get started today by downloading for free, and explore the full potential with a Premium subscription.
Remember to observe wildlife responsibly and adhere to local regulations to ensure a safe experience.

bluejetty:00173263:ios.name: Mountain Bike Park-Tycoon Game
bluejetty:00173263:ios.summary: Are you a fan of mountain biking? And do you want to become a mountain bike tycoon? Welcome to Mountain Bike Tycoon-Trail Racing, the ultimate simulation game where you can build and manage a mountain bike park. Start running a small and ba
bluejetty:00173263:ios.description:
Are you a fan of mountain biking? And do you want to become a mountain bike tycoon? Welcome to Mountain Bike Tycoon-Trail Racing, the ultimate simulation game where you can build and manage a mountain bike park. Start running a small and basic park and work hard to make it be the best MTB park in the world. With a variety of trails, stores and outdoor amusement facilities at your disposal, you can create the wonderful experience for the riders.
BUILD TRAILS AND IMPROVE FACILITIES
 In the Mountain Bike Tycoon-Trail Racing, the whole MTB park is divided into different areas. The core parts are all kinds of trails. You can design different tracks according to different terrains. 
Riders can choose different trails according to their mountain bike level and They can experience different mountain bike modes such as downhill, enduro, freeride. Living facilities are also essential, such as shower rooms, repair shops drink shops and restaurants. Riders can train various tricks in the bike school, fix the broken bicycles in the repair shop, and buy all kinds of accessories in the accessory shop. And you can add amusement facilities such as wingsuit flying, motocross training and western bar. As you level up, you can unlock new locations and amenities to attract more visitors. By managing these resources carefully, you can create a beautiful and thriving mountain bike park that riders will love.
HIRE SERVICE AND MANAGEMENT STAFF
To keep your mountain bike park running smoothly, you can hire service and management staff. Service staff such as waiters and shop assistants can bring the best service experience to the visitors. Receptionists and cashiers will facilitate bookings and operations as well as finances. Coaches will help riders master all kinds of biking skills and improve their professionalism. By hiring the right staff, you can improve the park's efficiency and keep the riders happy.
MAXIMIZE YOUR INCOME AND INVEST PROPERLY
In the Mountain Bike Tycoon-Trail Racing, you must manage your finances carefully to maximize your income. From the entrance parking lot to the medical campsite inside the park, you can set prices for these places and invest in constructing and designing new buildings and amenities to attract more visitors. Strategies are important! You must balance the expenses of all aspects, such as fees for upgrading new facilities and constructing various trails, which ensure that no spending will be overrun. By investing intelligently and managing your finances properly, you can grow the mountain bike park into a profitable business.
ENJOY EXTREME SPORTS AND COLLECT ACHIEVEMENTS
In addition to managing your MTB park, you can also enjoy extreme sports in the game. You can collect different achievements by exploring new trails and completing challenges. When you have unlocked all five trails in the first stage, that means you can open a new section of the mountain bike park where you can challenge more complex terrains of trails,and you can choose other extreme sports, such as motorcycles and wingsuit flying. With its immersive gameplay and beautiful graphics, Mountain Bike Tycoon-Trail Racing is the perfect game for anyone who loves mountain biking and extreme sports.
If you enjoy idle simulation and management games, you'll love Mountain Bike Tycoon-Trail Racing! This casual and easy-to-play game allows you to make strategic decisions to grow your own mountain bike park business. Start with a small and basic park, and work your way up to become the best mountain bike tycoon in the world. Unlock new locations and amenities to attract more riders, and manage your resources carefully to maximize your profits. With incremental and immersive gameplay, Mountain Bike Tycoon is the perfect and addictive game for anyone who likes mountain biking and managing a business.

StoryMii: Unleashing Imagination with Custom Bedtime Stories
Imagine crafting a bedtime story that directly resonates with what's currently impacting your child's day to day life. With StoryMii, this becomes more than just a possibility—it
bluejetty:00097448:ios.description:
StoryMii: Unleashing Imagination with Custom Bedtime Stories
Imagine crafting a bedtime story that directly resonates with what's currently impacting your child's day to day life. With StoryMii, this becomes more than just a possibility—it's a reality. This pioneering app seamlessly blends the magic of personalised storytelling with cutting-edge technology, offering a fresh approach to ignite a passion for reading among children in today's digital age.
Three Pillars of StoryMii: Ignite Imagination, Enlighten Minds, Foster Futures
Ignite Imagination: StoryMii opens the door to worlds unknown, sparking creativity and wonder in young minds through stories that leap beyond the ordinary.
Enlighten Minds: Beyond mere entertainment, each story is a journey into learning, offering insights and knowledge wrapped in the cloak of narrative.
Foster Futures: With a forward-looking approach, StoryMii nurtures the readers of tomorrow, equipping them with the skills and empathy to navigate the future.
Bridging Technology and Literacy
StoryMii leverages safe technology to combat the decline in reading interest, offering a digital solution that makes literature and child's books more captivating than ever. This app redefines reading, ensuring children remain engaged and passionate about exploring new stories.
Custom Stories for Every Reader
At the heart of StoryMii is its unparalleled custom story creation feature, which allows for a personalized reading experience. Whether it's for neurodivergent readers, bilingual children, or any young enthusiast, StoryMii delivers content that is perfectly tailored to each child's reading level, interests, and cultural background, making literature accessible and enjoyable for all.
A Champion for Inclusivity
StoryMii's dedication to inclusivity shines through its offerings for neurodivergent and second-language learners. The app ensures that every child finds relatable and inspiring stories, breaking down barriers to literacy and fostering a love for reading in a diverse audience.
Empowering Neurodivergent Readers
Utilizing AI technology, StoryMii creates accessible and engaging content for neurodivergent readers. This commitment to inclusivity makes reading a positive experience for all children, accommodating different learning styles and needs.
Navigating Reading Milestones Together
From beginner readers to those seeking more complex literature, StoryMii is the perfect companion for every stage of a child's reading journey, evolving with them as they grow and explore the vast world of child's books.
Encouraging Creativity Beyond Reading
StoryMii goes beyond traditional storytime by allowing children to customize characters, settings, and plots. This interactive approach not only enhances engagement but also cultivates creativity, making each bedtime story a unique creation.
Safe and Secure Digital Storytime
In today's digital landscape, StoryMii offers a safe haven for children to engage with literature and bedtime stories, backed by curated content and robust parental controls for peace of mind.
Beyond Reading: A Foundation for Life
StoryMii enriches young minds, integrating lessons on empathy, diversity, and problem-solving into its stories, thereby contributing to the holistic development of children through engaging and educational narratives.
Setting the Standard in EdTech
StoryMii stands at the forefront of educational technology, using innovative solutions to address educational challenges and inspire a new generation of readers.
Fostering a Community of Young Readers
With features that encourage sharing and discussion, StoryMii promotes a collective reading experience, enriching the tradition of storytime and making it a shared journey of discovery.

bluejetty:00063529:ios.description:
IMDb is the world's most trusted source for movie ratings, TV show reviews, celebrity info, trailers, and entertainment news. Whether you're looking for what to watch tonight or tracking upcoming releases, IMDb helps you discover movies and TV shows tailored to you.
Find where to watch any movie or TV show across your streaming services. Connect your preferred platforms, and IMDb shows you what's available to stream, rent, or buy in one place. Save titles to your Watchlist so you never lose track of what to watch next.
Rate movies and TV shows on a scale of 1-10 and join millions of fans shaping the IMDb Top 250 Movies and Top 250 TV Shows charts. Customize your Interests to get personalized recommendations, and enable alerts to know when titles on your Watchlist become available.
Explore cast and crew details, read and write reviews, watch trailers, check box office results, and browse photo galleries. Stay current with entertainment news, Born Today features, and celebrity updates.
IMDb is available worldwide in English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese, and Hindi. We love making IMDb better for fans. Share your feedback at: http://spr.ly/IMDbApp_iOS
