Run your business with Bookipi's award‑winning invoice maker, built for fast, reliable invoicing, estimates, and receipts.
Join over 2,500,000 businesses in 150+ countries who trust Bookipi to manage invoicing and payments—risk-free for your first 3 documents.
What Can Businesses Do on Bookipi with Invoice Maker & Estimates App?
Bookipi's invoice app simplifies your business accounting by automating invoices, estimates, and payment tracking.
• Quick & Easy Invoice Maker App:
Build branded, professional invoices, quotes, and receipts in under two minutes.
• Automated Payment Tracking:
Stay on top of your income with real-time notifications when invoices are sent, viewed, paid, or overdue.
• Smart Reminders & Fast Payments:
Bookipi automatically notifies clients on overdue invoices so you get paid on time. Accept payments via credit cards, PayPal, and contactless payments.
• Professional Invoice Templates:
Choose from a wide range of customizable invoice templates for every business type—trades, freelancers, consultants, and more.
• Effortless Tax and Reporting:
Generate organized PDF reports by month, customer, or item for easy accounting and tax filing.
• Universal Compatibility:
Perfect for freelancers, contractors, and small businesses in any industry—invoice for services, products, or milestones.
• Seamless Proposals & Recurring Billing:
Create proposals, convert them to invoices, and automate recurring invoices for ongoing clients.
• Secure & Synced:
ISO 27001 certified cloud protection with multi-device sync between mobile and web.
• Tap to Pay on iPhone - Available to All in USA, UK & Australia:
Turn your phone into a wireless terminal to accept in-person, contactless payments with just a tap.
• Best Available Payment Methods:
Get paid via American Express, Visa, MasterCard, PayPal and more. Process invoices, send instant receipts, and manage transactions on one app.
• One-click Receipt Maker:
Send receipts right after recording a payment, keeping your clients updated and your records organized without any extra steps.
Why Use Bookipi Invoice Maker & Estimate App?
Bookipi is the best flexible, all-in-one invoice generator for freelancers and small businesses. We help streamline the sales process from invoice building to receiving payment.
How Secure is Your Data on Bookipi?
Bookipi free invoice maker runs securely on the cloud, with your data backed up and protected from third parties. Your information is locked behind your secure login credentials, and Bookipi ensures your privacy with industry-leading security practices, including ISO 27001 certification and regular audits.
Who is Bookipi for?
• Trades (builders, electricians, plumbers, etc.)
• Creative freelancers & consultants
• Food/gig delivery, e-commerce, retail, contractors
• Anyone who wants simple and professional billing
Other Features for Better Invoices, Estimates, and Receipts
• Automatic sync between devices and web app.
• Invoice hours worked, services, products, or by milestone.
• Charge credit card surcharges to clients.
• Import customer details from the contact list.
• Make calls or send emails directly from the customer list.
• Send overdue payment reminders.
Try Bookipi today and experience the easiest way to send invoices, create estimates, collect payments, and grow your business—all from your iOS device.
Bookipi is constantly updating its free invoice app and developing new features. If you have any problems or suggestions, chat with us on our website: https://bookipi.com/

bluejetty:00085650:ios.name: GymBook ・ Strength Training
bluejetty:00085650:ios.summary:
Here is GymBook, your fitness app to efficiently create, log and analyze your workouts at the gym - all in a beautiful and minimalist user interface.
MANAGE YOUR WORKOUTS
• Create your workout with your own exercises or choose from the 50+
bluejetty:00085650:ios.description:
Here is GymBook, your fitness app to efficiently create, log and analyze your workouts at the gym - all in a beautiful and minimalist user interface.
MANAGE YOUR WORKOUTS
• Create your workout with your own exercises or choose from the 50+ simple exercises with animated images and visualizations of the affected primary and secondary muscle groups
• Group and sort your exercises within a workout
• Define the sets, weight and reps you want to perform for each exercise
• Define different settings for your sets of an exercise (e.g. for warm up sets or pyramid training)
• Archive workouts you don't actively use and keep them for statistics or for later use
MANAGE YOUR EXERCISES
• Edit the preloaded exercises
• Create your own exercises (cardio and stretching exercises also supported)
• Assign a region, primary and secondary muscle groups, equipment and write down notes for your exercises
• Add a photo to your exercises
WORK OUT!
• Fast logging and tracking of your workout
• Log your workout on your wrist with GymBook for Apple Watch
• Extend your logs with notes to add additional information
• Immediately see how you did last time
• Use the pre-filled picker views for fast logging and Quick-Log for super fast logging
• Quickly access logs from within a workout, including the graphical statistics
• Change the workout date (if you want to log previous workouts)
• Immediately see your exercise statistics in a configurable, interactive line graph 
• Move automatically to the next exercise of your workout after saving a log (configurable)
• The workout screen immediately shows a detailed overview about today's workout
• The innovative "Workout Matrix" gives you always a detailed overview about your current workout
• Live Activities show your current workout right on your Lock Screen or on your Dynamic Island
• After completing a workout, a summary shows your performance as well as your heat map and lets you analyze your progress compared to last time
• Completed workouts are saved to the Health app (with date, start time, end time, duration, name and optionally active calories and heart rate) and to Strava
MORE...
• Time your rests with the adjustable timer which also works when you set your device to sleep or close your app: you can configure your preferred timer duration, have a primary and a secondary timer (even specific to an exercise), choose between a classic or a graphical timer, have different timer sounds and more
• Receive a detailed analysis of your performance thanks to the interactive line graphs, doughnut charts, and/or radar charts
• Track your body measurements and analyze your progress in interactive line graphs: some body measurements (weight, height, body fat percentage and waist circumference) will also be synced with the Health app
• Export your logs as XML and CSV file and export a backup as a database file
• Synchronize your data with iCloud
• Change the appearance of GymBook and choose from one of 9 great designs, each one available in both light and dark mode
*Some special functions can be activated with GymBook Pro.
SUPPORT: GymBook supports metric (kilograms, meters) and imperial (pounds, feet) system of units.
NOTE: GymBook is developed by gym experts, for gym experts. Therefore it focuses on YOUR workouts and provides only example workouts for better orientation.
TERMS OF USE: https://gymbookapp.com/terms.

bluejetty:00014718:ios.name: Drive and Shop with Shipt
bluejetty:00014718:ios.summary: Looking for flexible work, a delivery gig, or a side hustle? With Shipt, earn money as a delivery driver or personal shopper on your own schedule. Shop for groceries, complete package delivery routes, and help customers get the products the
bluejetty:00014718:ios.description:
Looking for flexible work, a delivery gig, or a side hustle? With Shipt, earn money as a delivery driver or personal shopper on your own schedule. Shop for groceries, complete package delivery routes, and help customers get the products they need from local stores. Choose opportunities that fit your schedule and get paid for completed orders, including customer tips and available same-day pay options.
THE PERFECT SIDE HUSTLE: WORK AS A DELIVERY DRIVER OR PERSONAL SHOPPER
Shipt gives independent contractors flexible opportunities to shop and deliver in their communities.
- Choose grocery shopping orders or package delivery routes that fit your schedule
- Work part-time, on weekends, in the daytime, evenings, or whenever works for you
- Accept delivery and shopping opportunities directly in the app
- Set your own schedule and choose when you want to work
- Earn base pay for completed orders and keep 100% of customer tips
- Access same-day pay opportunities when available
FLEXIBLE GIG WORK THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
Whether you're looking for a side hustle, a part-time opportunity, flexible hours, or independent contractor work, Shipt gives you the freedom to choose opportunities that work for you.
Use Shipt to find flexible delivery driver and personal shopper opportunities in your area. Work around your existing schedule and earn additional income while providing a valuable service to your local community.
GROCERY SHOPPING & DELIVERY
Personal shoppers shop for and deliver groceries, household essentials, wellness products, pet supplies, and other everyday items from local grocery stores and retailers.
- Shop for fresh groceries, pantry staples, household essentials, wellness products, pet supplies, and more
- Communicate with customers about substitutions, preferences, and special requests
- Complete grocery delivery orders from participating stores
- Earn pay based on the estimated time and effort required for each order
- Keep 100% of customer tips
PACKAGE DELIVERY
Package delivery drivers pick up packages and deliver them to multiple addresses using optimized routes.
- Select available package delivery routes in the app
- Complete deliveries to customers in your area
- Earn money for each completed route
- Work flexible delivery shifts that fit your availability
GET PAID FOR YOUR WORK
Shipt offers multiple ways for shoppers and drivers to earn, depending on the type of work and opportunities available in your area.
- Earn base pay for completed shopping and delivery orders
- Keep 100% of customer tips
- Access same-day pay opportunities when available
- Find additional earning opportunities on eligible orders
- Receive customer tips in addition to base pay
- Refer friends and family for eligible referral rewards
Shopper and Driver Benefits 
Shipt provides additional benefits and resources for eligible shoppers and drivers.
- Connect with other shoppers and drivers and learn from the community
- Access eligible car-related benefits, including discounts on gas and oil changes
- Earn rewards through the Shipt Summit Seeker Program
- Eligible active shoppers can receive a complimentary Annual Shipt Membership after meeting program requirements
How to get started
1. Sign up with Shipt as a personal shopper or delivery driver.
2. Start selecting routes/delivery windows for grocery shopping or package delivery.
3. Earn money while providing a valuable service to your community.
Requirements
- At least 18 years old
- Valid mailing address
- Valid U.S. driver's license, Social Security Number, and auto insurance
- A reliable, operable vehicle
- Ability to lift 50 pounds
- Smartphone and the updated Shipt: Shopper and Driver app
Availability, eligibility, pay, delivery opportunities, benefits, and requirements vary by location and role. Terms and conditions apply.

The only USCIS Case Tracker you need!
Real-time updates and push notifications on the progress of your case, customized case analysis based on real data from USCIS, daily USCIS case processing data updates, USCIS processing times, access to the only USCIS Case Status Glossary, an AI Immigration Assistant, a search tool, available in both English and Spanish languages, and more…

As the user’s case status is updated by USCIS, the glossary serves as a valuable resource to eliminate ambiguity, minimize confusion, and assist users in understanding their case status.
Have an immigration question? Ask Sam!
myCaseStatus.app AI Immigration Assistant, Sam, is dedicated to addressing your U.S. immigration-related questions. Sam stands out as the premier choice in the industry due to her exceptional combination of accuracy, reliability, and efficiency. Leveraging an extensive database, she offers precise guidance by delivering information. Sam's efficiency is a valuable asset to our users, and her ongoing development ensures she stays updated with immigration changes, procedures, and regulations, enhancing the user experience by guaranteeing access to the latest information.
Disclaimer: myCaseStatus.app is NOT endorsed by or affiliated with USCIS, DHS, DOS, or any U.S. government entity. myCaseStatus.app does NOT offer any legal advice, is NOT a law firm, and should not be considered a substitute for advice from an immigration attorney.
myCaseStatus.app allows you to receive real-time case updates for your pending immigration benefit application or petition via push notifications, based on the most recent action taken on your case by USCIS. Additionally, myCaseStatus.app provides real statistical information on USCIS case processing to help you better understand the progress of your application(s) while they are pending with USCIS. The information provided through myCaseStatus.app comes from publicly available sources on the USCIS website (https://egov.uscis.gov/casestatus/landing.do) and complies with USCIS Website Policies (https://www.uscis.gov/website-policies), which state: 'Information presented on this site is considered public information and may be distributed or copied. Therefore, the accuracy and availability of the information are not the responsibility of myCaseStatus.app. Users may experience technical difficulties during USCIS website outages, system maintenance, and when retrieving information is slow. These issues may cause delays in data refresh, which are entirely out of myCaseStatus.app's control.
Through its parent company (Signature Immigration Forms, Inc.), myCaseStatus.app also provides U.S. Immigration Government Form Preparation Services. Signature’s fees for services DO NOT include USCIS filing fees, biometrics service fees, or any other fees to be paid to the government. Any fee intended for the government is separate and MUST be paid by the client directly to USCIS. Client access to and use of any of Signature’s websites, mobile apps, and services are subject to our Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy. Legal services provided by independent immigration attorneys are subject to separate Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policies, retainers, and/or Limited Scope Representation Agreements.
This app may contain attorney advertising.

bluejetty:00132586:android.description:
Prepare for an explosive, high-octane experience in "Tank Fury: Battle of Steels." Immerse yourself in a world of relentless tank warfare, intense battles, and strategic combat as you engage in the ultimate showdown of armored might.
Key Features:
🔥 Thrilling Tank Battles: Take command of powerful tanks and dive into action-packed battles. Experience the adrenaline rush of tank warfare as you unleash destruction on your foes.
🌎 Diverse Battlefields: Traverse a variety of meticulously designed landscapes, from war-torn cities to rugged terrains. Each environment offers unique challenges, tactics, and stunning visuals.
🎯 Tactical Combat: Master the art of tank warfare. Employ strategy, maneuvering, and precision to outwit and outgun your opponents. A well-placed shot can turn the tide of battle.

🎨 Spectacular Graphics: Immerse yourself in the immersive world of tank warfare. The game boasts stunning visuals, realistic tank models, and explosive effects that transport you to the frontlines.
Why "Tank Fury" Stands Out:
🌟 Varied Gameplay: From fierce tank duels to team-based missions, "Tank Fury" offers a variety of engaging gameplay modes to keep you entertained.
🥇 Achievements and Rewards: Challenge yourself with a range of achievements. As you conquer new milestones, you'll earn valuable rewards and recognition.
🔄 Regular Updates: Count on us to deliver fresh content and updates that keep the game dynamic and thrilling.
🌐 Global Tank Community: Join a global community of tank enthusiasts. Connect, compete, and form alliances with fellow players from around the world.
🤝 Your Feedback Matters: Your suggestions and feedback are invaluable in shaping the game's future. We're dedicated to delivering the best tank warfare experience.
Ready to prove your tank prowess? "Tank Fury: Battle of Steels" is not just a game; it's a battlefield where you can rise to become a tank legend. Download now and embark on your journey

Connect to hundreds of brokers and trade in financial markets using MetaTrader 5 for iPhone and iPad.
The mobile trading platform allows you to receive quotes of financial instruments, analyze markets using charts and technical indicators, perform demo trades, connect to brokers for live trading and view the history of trading operations.
Risk Warning: Our programs may involve real trading with a high risk of losing money rapidly. Most retail investor accounts lose money when trading financial products. You should consider whether you understand how various financial products work and whether you can afford to take the high risk of losing money.
TRADING
• Real-time quotes of financial instruments
• Full set of trade orders, including pending orders
• Depth of Market (Level 2)
• All types of trade execution
• Complete trading history
ADVANCED FUNCTIONALITY
• High-performance charts
• Customizable chart color scheme
• Configuring properties of graphical objects and indicators
• Display of four charts in one window available on the MetaTrader 5 for iPad
• Trade levels visualizing the prices of pending order, as well as SL and TP values on the chart
• Information window that displays orders, trading history, emails, news, and logs in MetaTrader 5 iPad
• Sound notifications
• Financial news — dozens of materials daily
• Secure and fast chats with other traders, creation of group chats and channels
• Support for push-notifications from the desktop platform and MQL5.community services
TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
• Interactive real-time price charts with zoom and scroll options
• 30 most popular technical indicators
• 24 analytical objects: lines, channels, geometric shapes, as well as Gann, Fibonacci and Elliott tools
• 9 timeframes: M1, M5, M15, M30, H1, H4, D1, W1 and MN
• 3 types of charts: bars, Japanese candlesticks and broken line

bluejetty:00062197:ios.description:
Enki is your AI-powered skills coach!
Use it to learn coding, productivity tools, data skills, and generative AI tools. 
Tailored to fit your unique profile and goals, Enki is an AI-powered mentor in your pocket that can:
* Explain any concept in simple language
* Help with hints anytime you're stuck
* Summarize lessons into key points
* Review your code and provide feedback
* Provide real-world examples
* Translate content and converse in any language
* Recommend resources based on your needs
* Give career advice more generally
Other features include:
* Personalized content suggestions based on your learning preferences
* Coding playground to apply your knowledge
* Interactive questions to stimulate your thinking
* Revision workouts powered by spaced repetition science
* Daily reminders to help you build a learning habit
* Tracked learning streaks to motivate your progress
* Lesson bookmarking for quick access and sharing
You can also learn with others in your company, school, or the Enki community by:
* Engaging in discussions, mentoring other learners, and collaborating on exercises
* Teaming up with friends, co-workers, or peers and tracking each other's progress
* Sharing your favorite lessons with teammates or online
Access 10,000+ lessons in 30+ skills and tools including:
* Fundamental coding skills
* Coding Basics
* Computer Science
* Programming languages
* From Beginner to Advanced in each
* Python
* JavaScript
* Golang
* Kotlin
* Swift
* TypeScript
* Java
* C++
* Artificial Intelligence
* Generative AI tools
* Machine Learning
* Frontend skills
* React
* Web
* HTML
* CSS
* Data skills
* SQL
* Data Science
* Data Analysis
* R
* Interview prep & practice
* Productivity Tools
* Excel & Google Sheets
* Zapier
* Webflow
* Airtable
* Blockchain
* Bitcoin
* NFTs
* Other technical topics
* Security
* Functional Programming
* Git
* Regex
* Docker
* MongoDB
* Linux
Over 1.5 million people have used Enki to build and improve their coding, data and other critical skills.
What the media say about us:
"The exercises on Enki are focused on making professionals more productive."
- Forbes
"Ever imagined yourself as a JavaScript whizz, or pulling no punches with Python? Want to get a handle on SQL, or let yourself loose with Linux? Then let Enki be your coding coach, setting you daily workouts that tackle the intricacies of coding languages in bite-sized steps."
- Apple's App Store; featured as app of the day in 100+ countries
"Compared to free reading options this is structured, personalized content. Enki creates a 5-minute "workout" for you to learn important concepts in your spare time."
- TechCrunch
"The app supports everyone from beginners to more experienced coders. You can almost think of Enki the same way you would an exercise app. It provides you with daily workouts, but here you're leveling up your coding skills instead of burning fat and building muscle."
- MakeUseOf
"Enki adopts a different approach to the apps we've seen so far. It makes use of spaced repetition to help you learn specific concepts regarding coding."
- iGeeksBlog
Subscription pricing and terms:
Enki offers an auto-renewing yearly and monthly subscription to provide you with unlimited access to the Learn Mode features while you maintain an active subscription.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase.
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
Terms of service: https://enki.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://enki.com/privacy

bluejetty:00062732:ios.description:
Train your brain, keep your mind active!
The challenge:
Sudoku is such a deceptively simple puzzle: the challenge can be expressed in one sentence. Given a puzzle in 9x9 box with few known numbers, try and fill in the remaining squares with numbers 1 to 9 such that each row, column and 3x3 box contain all the numbers 1 to 9 without duplication.
Features:
• Dynamic Island, support quick resume right from Live Activity.
• iOS 14 widgets, quick view your game status and start games on the Home Screen.
• Daily Challenge, complete Daily Challenge to collect stars!
• 4 difficulty level supported, good for any beginners and advanced players.
• Over 20,000 puzzles and each puzzle has an unique solution.
• Struggling to solve the puzzle and getting nowhere, try using hint provided.
• You can take notes to track possible entries and your notes are automatically updated.
• Designed for iPadOS, you can play and do other works at the same time on the same screen.
• Support Apple Pencil, you can use Double-tapping to perform actions.
• Dark mode available, you can have fun on lights out.
Optimized for iPadOS:
• Support Slide Over.
• Support Split View.
• Support Smart Keyboard.
• Support Apple Pencil.
Optimized for macOS:
• Support play with keyboard.
Challenge your brain with Sudoku now!

bluejetty:00014600:ios.description:
Product Hunt gives you the front-row seat to everything that’s happening in tech and startups.
It’s the place to launch your ideas and discover your next favorite product.
We’re a welcoming and supportive community for tech enthusiasts. Whether you’re an indie developer, using no-code tools, buying Twitter, or somewhere in between, our community is the place for you. 
From calendar apps to the latest in SaaS, makers post their work looking for your support, feedback, and reviews to take their idea to the next level.
Companies like Loom, Notion, Figma, Stripe, and Shopify have launched on Product Hunt to find their first users, figure out product-market fit, and test new features. We’ve seen makers ride their upvotes straight to the moon. Which one will be next? Only you can decide.
Create an account and see what you’ll find on Product Hunt:
- Always fresh: New ideas and products every day
- Try the trends: Be the first to test out cutting-edge technology that's trending right now
- Upvote your favorites: Your vote helps the most interesting ideas stand out
- Follow your interests: Explore collections of apps and tools for topics you care about
- Friendly feedback: Share your thoughts and experiences directly with the makers
- Meet the people behind the products: Get inspired by stories, Q&As, and AMAs with makers
- Nerd out: Create and join discussions with other tech-lovers in the community

bluejetty:00036871:ios.description:
Christmas Magic is a relaxing Christmas match 3 puzzle game! Swap and match colorful candies, blast shiny ornaments and pop holiday treats through 2,600+ festive levels with Santa and his reindeer Rudy.
Easy to learn, fun to master and one of the coziest Christmas games for the whole family over the holidays - play offline anytime, no Wi-Fi needed.
GAME FEATURES
- Festive Match 3 Puzzles: Match, swap and blast through thousands of holiday-themed levels. Can you solve them all and save the holiday season?
- Free Santa from the Fireplace: Oh no, Santa is stuck! Clear the puzzle and pull him out in time for Christmas.
- Stop the Green Villain: He wants to steal Christmas! Match your way to victory and save the holidays.
- Magical Star Blocks: Feed candies to the cute little stars and unleash their magic to clear the board!
- Holiday Treats: Match candy canes and Christmas puddings, catch runaway gingerbread men and collect shiny ornaments.
- Powerful Boosters: Unlock boosters and special combos to beat even the trickiest levels.
- Daily Rewards: Play every day for special rewards and free boosters.
- Christmas & New Year Events: Seasonal events packed with unique challenges and prizes.
NEW THIS SEASON
- Brand-new look: every world map, every character and the home screens have been beautifully redrawn.
- 140 new levels - now more than 2,600 Christmas match 3 levels to play!
- 2 Seasons in 1 Game: celebrate Christmas in Season 1, then join Santa's summer vacation in Season 2.
- A new story episode: before Christmas begins, relive Santa and Rudy's summer memories.
CHRISTMAS ADVENT CALENDAR & BELL EVENTS
- Advent Calendar: Starting December 1, collect an extra reward every day on the countdown to Christmas!
- Silver Bell & Golden Bell Events: As Christmas Eve gets closer, the Silver Bell and then the Golden Bell reward events unlock one after another. Ring them both for special holiday rewards!
20 EPISODE WORLD MAPS
Every episode takes you somewhere new: Santa's North Pole home with a mailbox overflowing with letters to Santa, Candy Cane Lane, a carol-singing village square, an Ugly Christmas Sweater contest, a starry snowy night and a joyful Christmas Eve.
SANTA & RUDY
Follow the funny, heartwarming banter between Santa and his loyal reindeer Rudy as you help deliver gifts to children around the world. A cozy Xmas story where no one is left without a present!
BONUS SUMMER SEASON
After the snowy Christmas adventure, the fun doesn't stop: follow Santa on his sunny summer vacation for a whole second season of match 3 puzzles in the same game.
WHY PLAYERS LOVE THESE CHRISTMAS GAMES
- Relaxing, cozy puzzles - perfect for unwinding on long winter evenings
- Fun for the whole family over the holidays
- Play offline anywhere - great for holiday travel, no Wi-Fi needed
- Charming storybook art in a warm winter wonderland
- Easy to learn, fun to master - made by match 3 puzzle lovers for all puzzle lovers
- Free to play, whenever you like
Looking for cozy Christmas games and holiday games to share with family this winter? Download Christmas Magic and let the holiday magic begin. It's the perfect way to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year!
Merry Christmas and Happy Matching in the New Year 2027!

bluejetty:00005788:ios.name: Dream Defense
bluejetty:00005788:ios.summary:
The night seems endless and full of terrors… Who will save Robin from her evil nightmares, if not her faithful and fierce teddy bear? 
Are you able to protect your friend from bad dreams and monsters in this addictive action-shooter game?
bluejetty:00005788:ios.description:
The night seems endless and full of terrors… Who will save Robin from her evil nightmares, if not her faithful and fierce teddy bear? 
Are you able to protect your friend from bad dreams and monsters in this addictive action-shooter game? Can you survive until sunrise?
Play as a brave, gun-slinging toy bear and defend Robin from scary and sinister creatures that wait silently in the dead of the night, only to attack as soon as she falls asleep. 
With a wide range of awesome weapons, upgrades, and power-ups at your disposal, use simple touch controls to shoot, bombard, blast, and freeze the enemy swarms. Challenge yourself to multiple levels, build toy defenses and defeat the evil bosses!
Prepare yourself for endless waves of sinister creatures and creepy monsters and do everything you can to prevent the nightmares from coming true! 
Please note: Dream Defense is free to play with the option to unlock items with in-app purchases.
• A BRAVE BEAR NEVER SLEEPS – Tap the screen to shoot monsters and save your friend! Only the toy bear knows what dangers lurk in the dark. From sunset to sunrise enemies swarm Robin’s room, so stay alert and watch out for the evil bosses!
 • A SMART BEAR ALWAYS HAS A STRATEGY - From fire-spewing clowns to giant ghouls, there’s no telling what creepy and spooky enemies Robin will dream of next. Find your enemy’s weakness and pick your arsenal wisely. Choose your best defense strategy and defeat all the creepy demons!
• A RESOURCEFUL BEAR IS ALWAYS PREPARED – Equip yourself with several exciting weapons! Attack the nightmare demons with bb and poison guns, pepper sprays, darts and many, many more! Bombard your enemies with explosives or freeze them with ice-cream! Fortify Robin’s bed with all sorts of awesome toy defenses. Build pencil barricades to keep nightmares away, or equip laser lamps that shoot monsters from afar. 
• A WARRIOR BEAR HAS THE BEST GEAR - Unlock new items at the store by completing levels and shooting new enemies. Upgrade weapons and use power-ups to be even more powerful. Put your toy defense up and ultimately save your best friend from the evil monsters that lurk in the shadows.
Survive the night and don’t let Robin’s nightmares come true! Play the ultimate shooter game Dream Defense now for FREE!
Having problems? Got a suggestion? We'd love to hear from you! You can reach us at: dreamdefense@altitude-games.com

Features:
• Enter time on the right projects or engagements from anywhere
• Create and submit expenses, including photos of receipts uploaded directly to expense reports
• Approve timesheets and expenses anytime
• Email employees that need to edit or submit timesheets
• Access favorite or recent projects for quick and easy entry
• Automatically audit changes to timesheets when revision auditing is enabled
• Easily and securely access the app using a 4-digit pin
To use the app:
• A Deltek Vantagepoint user license is required.
• Contact your firm’s IT resource to obtain your firm-specific Deltek T&E mobile URL needed during set up. Note that this URL is different than the URL used in a browser.

bluejetty:00162271:ios.description:
AI Note Taker for Meetings, Lectures and More!
NoteNinja is your personal AI note taker, designed to capture, organize, and transform your notes effortlessly. Whether you’re in a meeting, attending a lecture this AI-powered tool makes note-taking smarter and more efficient by converting any audio, or media into structured notes, flashcards, quizzes, and more.
Key Features:
-Capture: Let the AI note taker automatically summarize key points from meetings, lectures, or any audio input. Forget about manual note-taking!
-Organize: Keep your notes structured and categorized by topic, date, or priority, making navigation quick and simple with your AI note taker.
-Summarize: Get concise summaries instantly from long meetings, lectures etc.. The AI note taker quickly distills the key points for you.
-Media Integration: Upload audio and let the AI note taker do the work of summarizing and organizing content from various sources.
-Interactive Learning: Use the AI note taker to create quizzes and flashcards based on your notes for deeper engagement and easier learning.
Use Cases:
-Meetings: The AI note taker captures all the important action points, decisions, and details from your meetings, allowing you to convert discussions into organized summaries or to-do lists.
-Lectures: Students can rely on the AI note taker to summarize key lecture points and organize class notes for more efficient studying.
-Personal Use: Organize your to-do lists, daily tasks, or personal thoughts with ease using the AI note taker’s advanced note-taking features.
Additional Benefits:
-Boost Productivity: Stay focused on what’s important while the AI note taker captures and organizes notes in real time.
-Customization: Edit your notes and transcribed content as needed, and tailor them with reminders, tags, or custom sections.
-Interactive Learning Tools: Create quizzes and flashcards directly from your notes using the AI note taker for more interactive and engaging learning.
-Multilingual Support: Take notes in over 100 languages with the AI note taker, making it an excellent tool for global use.
-Centralized Hub: Access all your notes in one place, with a clear and organized overview of your note-taking history.
NoteNinja requires premium subscription in order to use ai note taking features. Please purchase our yearly plan for $39.99 per year or $6.99 per week.
Privacy: https://www.appnation.co/privacy

bluejetty:00156092:ios.description:
Has your manager invited you to zignyl? If so, you've found the right app. Install it on your phone, and you'll find your upcoming shifts. You can even request time off and check your time punches!
***** Important: Only works if your employer is using zignyl! *****
(1) Check your emails and search for an email from zignyl.
That's the personal invitation you've received from your employer.
(2) Follow the instructions in the email to activate your account.
In this step, you'll be able to set your personal password.
(3) Finally, open the zignyl Team app and log in.
Use the email address where you've received the invitation.
Install the zignyl Team app to:
+ Easily access your upcoming work shifts
+ Quickly request time off
+ Securely check your time punches
+ Keep your personal information up-to-date
CHECK YOUR PERSONAL SCHEDULE
Tap the "Schedule" icon and you'll find all your upcoming shifts, even if you're working in several locations!
Find more details by tapping a single day or shift.
REQUEST TIME OFF
Doctor's appointment or family event? Tap a date in the calendar, then choose “Request Time Off” and fill in the blanks.
zignyl informs your manager automatically and you will be notified via email as soon as your time-off has been approved or not.
CHECK YOUR TIME PUNCHES
Make sure you're paid for what you've worked: Check the "Shift History" and compare at a glance the hours you had been scheduled vs. your worked hours according to your time punches.

Vscale is the physique tracker built for people who want to understand their body, improve it and prove their progress.
Get a detailed body scan, physique score, muscle ratings, body composition estimates, weight tracking, measurements, progress photos, goals and more in one app.
Stop guessing what is changing. Vscale turns your physique into numbers you can track.
YOUR PHYSIQUE, SCORED
See your physique broken down into an overall score and individual ratings across eight muscle groups.
Find your strongest areas, spot the muscles holding you back and see how balanced your physique really is. Explore insights into muscle development, symmetry, V taper, physique potential and more through a clear visual report.
SET GOALS AND PLAN YOUR PROGRESS
Whether you are cutting, bulking, maintaining or starting from scratch, Vscale helps you build your tracking around your goal.
Set a target weight, follow your projected timeline and get a personalised daily calorie estimate based on your body, activity and goal.
As your numbers change, your progress updates with you.
BODY FAT, LEAN MASS AND MORE
Body weight only tells you how heavy you are. Vscale helps you understand what that weight is made of.
See estimates for body fat percentage, lean mass, fat mass, BMI, FFMI and other useful body composition metrics.
Follow these numbers over time to see whether your progress is coming from fat loss, muscle growth or changes elsewhere in your physique.
TRACK WEIGHT, MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS
Keep your full transformation in one place.
Log your weight, record body measurements and save progress photos as your body changes. View your history on clear charts and spot progress that may be difficult to notice in the mirror.
Your scans, photos, measurements and goals stay connected, giving you a fuller picture than any single number can.
COMPARE SCANS OVER TIME
Every scan adds to your physique history.
Compare reports and progress photos to see changes in your muscle scores, body composition, weight, measurements and more.
See what improved, what stayed the same and where you should focus next. Even small changes become easier to notice when you can compare the numbers directly.
A DEXA SCAN IN YOUR POCKET
Get detailed body composition insights whenever you want, directly from your phone.
Vscale brings body fat, lean mass, fat mass, FFMI and more into one clear report you can revisit and compare over time.
No clinic appointment every time you want an update. Your physique data stays ready whenever you want to check your progress.
STREAKS, MILESTONES AND PERSONAL RECORDS
Real transformations come from staying consistent.
Build streaks, unlock milestones and record personal bests as you move towards your goal. Vscale keeps a history of the work you have put in, helping you see how far you have come.
The longer you track, the clearer your transformation becomes.
YOUR PHOTOS AND DATA STAY YOURS
Your physique photos and reports belong to your account. You can delete your account and associated data at any time from the app settings.
Your body is always changing. Vscale helps you see it.
Vscale provides estimates for fitness and progress tracking and is not a medical device.

bluejetty:00037395:ios.description:
With the Tonal mobile app you can be your strongest—from home, on your own schedule.
Tonal is the smartest home gym and personal trainer. Unlike traditional dumbbells, barbells, and exercise equipment Tonal uses advanced digital weight that continually adapts workouts so they’re most effective for you—all led by our expert coaches. Loved by beginners, exercise enthusiasts, and professional athletes alike, Tonal is reimagining the landscape of at-home fitness.
Get stronger, faster with the Tonal app 
- Join a program: No matter where you are in your fitness journey, Tonal has individual workouts and multi-week programs to help you reach your goals.
- Track your progress: See your strength grow. Tonal’s A.I. keeps track of your workouts, measuring your progress and breaking it down by muscle group and workout type. 
- Work out on-the-go: From high-intensity, to restorative yoga flows, Tonal has hundreds of workouts for you to try. Filter by focus, trainer, or time.
- Create your own workout: Work out your way with Custom Workouts. Choose your favorite movements, reps, sets, and advanced weight modes, like Burnout and Eccentric to maximize your results, then save for later.
- Get stronger, together: Connect with friends and stay motivated to get stronger while cheering on other members in the Tonal community. 
Tonal uses HealthKit to export your Tonal workouts into the Health app and to sync your weight and height.

bluejetty:00077820:ios.description:
ArcaBooks. Um novo app. Uma nova experiência.
O ArcaBooks é um aplicativo que permite a leitura dos livros digitais adquiridos no site ArcaCenter. Dentre os livros digitais você encontra uma biblioteca de diversos autores cristãos e em vários idiomas. Os temas são relacionados a: Auto-Ajuda, Vida Espiritual, Mulher, Finanças, Infantojuvenil, Biografias, Relacionamento, Pais e Filhos, entre outros.
O novo ArcaBooks veio com grandes mudanças e torna possível a criação de uma biblioteca de livros digitais cujo conteúdo contribui para o seu crescimento espiritual durante a sua trajetória de fé.
Confira os principais recursos do ArcaBooks:
- Escolha entre os modos claro e escuro
- Aumente ou diminua o tamanho da fonte
- Continue a leitura de onde parou
- Destaque os seus trechos favoritos com o marcador de texto inteligente
- Encontre o livro ideal com mais facilidade
- Faça o login uma única vez e mantenha-se conectado
- Leitura offline para quando estiver sem acesso à internet
Para ler seus livros comprados, acesse o app ArcaBooks com o mesmo login e senha da sua conta ArcaCenter. Ao abrir o app, os ebooks adquiridos estarão disponíveis para a leitura no app.
Deixe seus dias mais proveitosos com o novo ArcaBooks. Aproveite o momento e boa leitura!

Unleash your inner chef in one of the most exciting new cooking adventures of 2023. Prove that you can cook food fast, even when your restaurant is flooded with customers that need complex orders. Play Cooking Diner: Restaurant Game and experience one of the best blends of time management and food-making games. 
Test your cooking skills and see if you have it in you to complete all chef cooking game levels in this fun cooking adventure. Start cooking now!
◆ RESTAURANT COOKING ADVENTURE IN NEW YORK AND ROME
Start in a simple fast food place and prep hot dogs and milkshakes in a small unknown part of New York City. Complete the orders and satisfy all customer needs accurately as fast as possible. Then grow your name as a master chef and open burger shops, classy restaurants, BBQ places, and more! Collect all keys as you complete the levels and the needed targets to unlock the new city (Rome) and experience even more interesting cooking challenges in unique new restaurants.

+3 Customers
+30 seconds
2x Coins
Life Saver
Auto Serving
Crazy combo
Instant Cook
Burn Proofing
Candy Rain
◆ PLAY THE FREE COOKING GAME OFFLINE
Unlike most food restaurant games, you can play our food game offline anywhere, anytime. Enjoy the food cooking adventure while traveling, or whenever you want to save data and stay offline.

- time management cooking adventure with 1000+ levels.
- see target, rewards, and boosts for each level.
- make and serve the food on time.
- earn gems, coins, and boosts.
- earn more by completing combos.
- use your gems to buy boosts.
- benefit from our bundle deals.
- complete levels to unlock new restaurants.
- find all keys to unlock a new city.
- cupcake and candy delivery (can be upgraded).
- see the world map.
- pause the game and turn on/off sounds.
Whether you are in search of a serving game, hamburger cooking game, or food restaurant game, you have it all in Cooking Master’s unique food making adventure.
Download and play one of the top cooking games this year!

bluejetty:00027430:ios.description:
This is the Department of Home Affairs Tourist Refund Scheme (TRS) mobile application (the app).
The app will allow you to enter the information that is required to lodge a TRS claim. The app will save the information to your mobile device, allowing you to edit the claim over multiple sessions.
When you have finished entering your information it will be stored in a QR code on your device. This QR code is your TRS claim code. You must present your TRS claim code to an officer at the TRS counter on your departure from Australia.
If you successfully enter your claim details using this app, processing your claim at the TRS counter when you depart should be faster and you will be able to use a dedicated queue to lodge your TRS claim.

bluejetty:00128970:ios.summary:
Create your own adorable couple, dress them up with fantastic style, build, decorate, and design their home, adopt a loyal furry pet, and watch them experience cute moments together in this shrunk down house game & life sim!
Create Pocket
bluejetty:00128970:ios.description:
Create your own adorable couple, dress them up with fantastic style, build, decorate, and design their home, adopt a loyal furry pet, and watch them experience cute moments together in this shrunk down house game & life sim!
Create Pocket Lovers
- Customize your perfect couple with a character creator that lets you personalize their every detail.
- Skin color and hairstyles galore, pick and choose all the little things that will make them a reflection of everything that makes you special!
- Change their looks at any time with constant new clothes, hairstyles, and accessories to collect.
Build & Design Your Home
- Design and decorate your dream home with a colorful variety of furniture, wall decor, and flooring items.
- Expand your house, add different rooms and floors, such as a kitchen, a bedroom, and a garden to make your home feel complete.
- Go wild! Add your own movie theater, arcade, or even a fossil museum.
- Unpacking fever! You will never run out of new item combinations from the Amazing Store.
Lifestyle Sim
- Turn your life into “our” life with your couple; warm your heart as you cook, clean, and spend time as a new family.
- Adopt a furry animal companion! Nurture your dogs and cats, and treat them with special furniture for pets.
- In this life simulator, you can take your bae out to the park, fancy restaurants, or other surprising events (Did someone say “K-Pop Concert”?) for romantic - and sometimes hilarious - dates.
- Meet new friends and make your couple the most irresistible love birds of Pocket Town!
Share The Love
- Take screenshots of your favorite sets and styles with the game’s camera, and show your creativity off to your friends.
- Brimming with pastel colors, cute characters, and sweet animations, your creations are sure to catch everyone’s eyes!
Arcade Attractions
- Master the art of pancakes making, and balance your way into delivering boxes from our Amazing Store!
- There are more mini-games to come, so stay tuned for updates!
Is that the sound of birds in your garden? The fragrance of home-made pancakes? And new rooms to be filled of furniture of all kind? Enjoy an idle life simulation game where you are free to choose from a catalog of varied furniture and activities to do!
Welcome to the pocket-sized home of your dreams!

bluejetty:00099154:ios.name: GLP-1 Tracker • Pokii
bluejetty:00099154:ios.summary:
Pokii • GLP-1 Tracker for Shots, Pills, Weight, Nutrition, Water, Photos, PDF Reports & More
Stay on top of your GLP-1 medication routine with Pokii — your dedicated tracker for injections and pills, injection reminders, and personal healt
bluejetty:00099154:ios.description:
Pokii • GLP-1 Tracker for Shots, Pills, Weight, Nutrition, Water, Photos, PDF Reports & More
Stay on top of your GLP-1 medication routine with Pokii — your dedicated tracker for injections and pills, injection reminders, and personal health journal built for people taking Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound, Trulicity, Rybelsus, Retatrutide, and other GLP-1 medications.
Whether you're managing weight loss, type 2 diabetes, or tracking your tirzepatide or semaglutide doses, Pokii helps you personalize your care and never miss a dose.
Key Features
• Custom Medications:
Track any medication — not just the ones on our list. Add your own custom drugs, doses, and frequencies. Perfect for trial medications, compounded GLP-1s, or any off-label use.
• GLP-1 Tracker (Shots + Pills):
Log every GLP-1 dose with one tap — injections or oral meds. Supports all major medications and even those in trials, including Saxenda, Bydureon, CagriSema, Rybelsus, and Wegovy (pill).
• Shot Scheduler with Level Simulation:
Visually plan your next injection based on projected medication levels. Simulate future shots, adjust timing, and optionally update your dose frequency. It's the smartest way to schedule your next dose.
• Smart Shot Reminders:
Customize your injection schedule and get discreet, reliable alerts. Set a shot day timer to notify you when it's time to warm up your medication.
• Relative Check-Ins:
Track side effects, mood, appetite, and more — without needing to assign numbers. Just log how things feel relative to last time.
• Weight Trends & Dose Levels:
See your weight and projected GLP-1 levels side-by-side. Visual charts make it easy to understand your progress over time.
• Water & Nutrition Tracking:
Log daily water intake and nutrition alongside your GLP-1 routine. See how hydration and diet connect to your progress over time.
• Body Measurements & Progress Photos:
Record measurements and capture progress photos to document your transformation. See the full picture of your journey, not just the number on the scale.
• Color-Coded Charts:
See more at a glance with charts colorized by dosage or medication. Whether you're adjusting levels or switching between GLP-1s, the color coding makes trends and changes crystal clear.
• Highlighted Dose Day:
Never miss your next injection — a dotted highlight marks your upcoming shot on the calendar.
• Apple Health Sync:
Securely sync weight data with Apple Health. All your stats stay up to date, automatically, and are available in other health apps.
• Injection Site Picker:
Log where you injected using a visual body diagram — no dropdown menus or lists, just tap the spot.
• Highly Customizable:
From scheduling to check-ins, themes to chart styles — Pokii adapts to your routine, not the other way around.
• iCloud Backup & Device Sync:
Your data is backed up and kept in sync across iPhone and iPad. And yes, it works beautifully on iPad — not just a scaled-up iPhone view.
• PDF Reports:
Generate beautiful, comprehensive reports to save, print, or share with your doctor. Includes charts of your shots, weight, and projected levels, plus side effects, appetite, mood, injection site, and pain indicators. Fully customizable — you decide what to include.
Why Pokii?
Pokii was designed specifically for today's GLP-1 users — whether you're using semaglutide, tirzepatide, or exploring new medications. Unlike generic health apps, Pokii understands your routine and gives you the tools to stay consistent and informed.
This isn't just another weight loss tracker or diabetes journal. It's your modern companion for the GLP-1 journey — shots or pills.
Pokii is clean, modern, and thoughtfully designed to support your GLP-1 experience from day one.
Start your GLP-1 tracking today with Pokii.
Because consistency makes all the difference.

Word Jewels is FUN and 100% FREE!
••••• "Awesome in so many ways! First of all, there is no time limit on this game, so it's more relaxing than other word games. My favorite word game right now, definitely." --kenjer 
••••• "This is a great game. I didn't think I would ever leave Words with Friends! I like the challenge of this game!" --DaveyGN 
••••• "Great word game! Hours of entertainment, can't believe it's free" --Hibeam 
••••• "I love word games and this is one of the best I've played" --Kenjo megi 
YOU'LL LOVE WORD JEWELS! Check out the reviews! 
••••• "Can't believe this is a free app. Hours and hours of fun!" --Duanne1 
••••• "Love this game...you can play solo, unlike with WWF and having to wait for your opponent to take their turn!" --Former WWF follower 
••••• "Word Jewels Rocks!!!!" --Renee Caldarelli 
••••• "The best game ever! I'm addicted." --Donnajzb 
• Trace words to capture them in any direction, even crossing over your path! 
• No timers, so take your time and find the best words! 
• Beautiful graphics and animation! 
• Relaxing sound effects 
• Can listen to your own music while playing 
GO FOR A HIGH SCORE! 
• Score summary shows you how well you did 
• Compare your scores with the world using Game Center
WORD LOVE! 
• Huge English dictionary included to verify words even while not connected to the internet! 
(Word Jewels uses the YAWL word list, which has 264,097 words! Valid words must be 3 letters long and NOT be proper nouns, as is typical for most every word game.) 
• Automagic letter balancing, to help from getting trapped with a big ol' pile of consonants with no vowels, or with too many duplicates of the same letter in a group! 
• Improved auto-save code - go ahead and quit the game, take a phone call, send a text - when you come back, your game will be waiting for you! Works on both old and new iThings! 
• 32 Game Center Achievements to earn! 
Thanks for playing!

Venmo is the fast, safe, social way to pay and get paid. Join over 90+ million people who use the Venmo app today
SEND AND RECEIVE MONEY
Pay and get paid for anything from your share of rent to a gift. Add a note to each payment to share and connect with friends

BUY CRYPTO WITH AS LITTLE AS $1
Buy, hold, and sell cryptocurrency right on the Venmo app. New to crypto? Learn more with in-app resources. Crypto is volatile, so it can rise and fall in value quickly. Be sure to take it at a pace you're comfortable with³
SHOP WITH THE VENMO DEBIT CARD
Spend your money in Venmo everywhere Mastercard® is accepted around the globe — and earn cashback from some of your favorite spots. Terms apply: venmo.me/rewards⁴
VENMO TEEN ACCOUNTS
A debit card of their very own and a Venmo account to send money to trusted friends and family⁵. All with no minimum balance or monthly fee
DO BUSINESS ON VENMO
Create a business profile for your side gig, small business, or anything in between—all under your same Venmo account
MANAGE YOUR MONEY
Get your Venmo money in the bank within minutes using Instant Transfer⁶. Want your paycheck up to two days earlier* than your normal payday? Try Direct Deposit

bluejetty:00098694:ios.name: NoBurn - Reflux & GERD Tracker
bluejetty:00098694:ios.summary: Make reflux and GERD tracking easy. Log your meals & symptoms, uncover triggers, and get AI-powered insights to feel better, sleep better, and take control of your gut health. Feel like yourself again, end reflux uncertainty, and manage and
bluejetty:00098694:ios.description:
Make reflux and GERD tracking easy. Log your meals & symptoms, uncover triggers, and get AI-powered insights to feel better, sleep better, and take control of your gut health. Feel like yourself again, end reflux uncertainty, and manage and improve your reflux.
NoBurn enables you to easily:
- Scan your food in seconds to see its acidity, possible triggers, calories, and nutrition info.
- Track meals, snacks, drinks, and symptoms like heartburn, bloating, nausea, and more.
- Get personalized suggestions, recipes, and meal ideas from your AI reflux assistant.
- Track your symptoms, sleep, stress, and more over time.
- Join a supportive community, where you can get advice, share tips, and go through your reflux journey with others.
- Discover patterns, avoid triggers, and see your progress with smart charts, analytics, impacts, and reports.
- Complete recovery plans and improve your reflux through a structured approach.
- Add and log your medications & conditions like GERD, LPR, IBS, gastritis, or food intolerances.
- Browse reflux and GERD-friendly recipes.
- Browse a food database with reflux ratings and acidity, perfect for meal planning and following an acid reflux diet.
- Export your food scans and symptom logs in CSV format.
Sick of acid reflux or GERD? Want to start on the road to healing? Tired of foods bugging your stomach? Save yourself from the annoyance and time of doing things like trying to use notes to track your food or symptoms, having to ask the waiter about any meal you eat, and wasting money on food you can't actually eat. NoBurn includes food scanning, barcode scanning, a food database, and AI-powered manual entry.
No more second-guessing if your food will trigger reflux. No more awkward spreadsheets, confusing food journals, or stressful restaurant visits. Take the smart, straightforward approach to managing and improving your reflux, GERD, LPR, IBS, or related gut condition.
Our mission is to help everyone with reflux, GERD, LPR, and related conditions to feel and sleep better. NoBurn is powerful yet easy-to-use, ensuring all who have reflux or diet sensitivities can use it. Try the #1 app for acid reflux and gut health, with the best AI assistant for GERD.
Food scanning, symptom tracking, and most other features require a subscription. Consider subscribing through our free trial to explore all features and see what NoBurn can do for you!

Privacy policy: https://ascendant-support-faqs.notion.site/NoBurn-Privacy-Policy-211a970f15b880b38ecdfa267f4fe21a

bluejetty:00175925:ios.description:
Welcome to the delightful world of Bakery Stack, a sweet and savory adventure that combines the best of bakery games and stacking games! In this unique experience, you get to be the master chef, donut maker, and stack virtuoso all in one.As you dive into Bakery Stack, you'll find yourself in a cooking game like no other. Channel your inner food maker as you create delectable donuts that will leave your virtual customers craving for more. The game seamlessly blends the excitement of run race 3D with the art of stacking. Imagine a fast paced run race through the bakery, where your goal is not only to reach the finish line but also to stack the most delicious treats along the way. It's a race against time and a challenge for your stack games prowess.
Bakery Stack is not just about stacking games; it's a flavorful journey through the heart of a bustling bakery stack. Whether you're a fan of bakery games, a skilled donut maker, or simply enjoy the thrill of run race 3D, Bakery Stack has something special for you. It's a cooking game that satisfies your craving for both fun and challenge. Bakery Stack embarks on a delightful adventure where your skills in stacking games and cooking games will be put to the test. Get ready to stack, race, and create the most mouthwatering stacks in the bakery stack world.
Features of Bakery Stack Game:-
- Become the good pizza maker
- Learn maker and cake maker skills
- Enjoy cupcake baking in bakery games
- Unlimited fun run race on the long stack
- Cone cupcake maker in a Great pizza game
- Bake cupcake cones in running stack games
- Collect ingredients to earn a few extra bucks
- Collect all cooking foods Items from a stack
- Earn more cash & coins by making more foods

bluejetty:00080955:ios.description:
Bible Talk: Deepen Your Faith and Connect with Scripture
Deepen your faith and connect with scripture like never before with Bible Talk, the ultimate tool for Bible chat, daily prayer devotionals, Bible study, and spiritual growth. Bible Talk offers an AI-powered Bible chat that provides a unique, conversational experience, helping you explore biblical teachings, gain insight, and engage in meaningful reflection by allowing you to talk to the Bible.
Why Choose Bible Talk?
Bible Chat with Bible Talk: Ask questions, receive scriptural advice, and engage in thoughtful discussions with our AI-powered Bible chat.
Daily Devotions through Bible Talk: Find daily inspiration and guidance through personalized devotions and prayers.
Bible Study Simplified by Bible Talk: Easily search, read, and explore Bible verses with clear explanations to deepen your understanding of God's Word.
AI Bible Chat in Bible Talk: Get quick, accurate responses rooted in scripture to help guide you through life's challenges and questions about faith, love, and spirituality.
KJV Bible Access via Bible Talk: Explore and read the KJV Bible verses like never before.
Key Features of Bible Talk:
Personalized Biblical Guidance: Ask any question, and Bible Talk's AI will provide Bible-based answers and insights to support your spiritual journey.
Custom Prayers with Bible Talk: Create personalized prayers to start your day with intention and build a deeper connection with the Divine.
Verse Finder in Bible Talk: Search for specific Bible verses and explore their meanings in context to strengthen your understanding of scripture.
Daily Devotional Inspiration: Receive tailored daily devotionals from Bible Talk that inspire reflection and guide your faith-based decision-making.
A Beautiful, User-Friendly Experience with Bible Talk
Focus on your spiritual journey with Bible Talk's intuitive, aesthetically pleasing design that makes Bible study and daily devotions easy and accessible.
Subscription Plans for Bible Talk:
Unlock full access to all features of Bible Talk, including exclusive content, daily personalized insights, and the ability to ask unlimited questions with a weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription.
Free Trial
New users can start with a 7-day free trial to experience Bible Talk's premium features.
Payment
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase for Bible Talk.
Auto-Renewal
Subscriptions to Bible Talk automatically renew unless turned off in Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage Subscription
You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal for Bible Talk in your iTunes account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://bibletalkapp.com/privacy
Support: https://www.bibletalkapp.com/support

How to Play:
- Drag solitaire cards in the tableau to build sequences in descending order.
- If you uncover an ace card, place it first in one of the solitaire foundation piles.
- Start building sequences of the same suit in each solitaire foundation pile, from ace to king.
- You get notified if no more moves are left, before the end of the game.
- You can always end the Solitaire money game and the remaining time will be converted into bonus score.
- Complete the Solitaire money game as soon as possible and you have 3 minutes to complete and win a real money cash prize.
Features:

- Cash-out your earning securely using PayPal or 10+ way
- No Ads or any interruption during real money match.

- With Solitaire vie money you get three Undo moves.
- Enjoy nice mahjong! & smooth gameplay and pleasant music effects.
The solitaire money game is free to download. Note that Cash tournaments are not available in the following states: AZ, AR, IN, IA, LA, ME, MD, SC, MT & SD.

bluejetty:00087632:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00087632:ios.description:
Blur the ordinary. Keep the feeling.
A face caught in flash. A frame that moves just enough.
Neon dissolving into bokeh. Headlights leaving a trail behind.
Bluur Cam gives everyday photos the imperfect glow of a night worth remembering.
NIGHT, REMADE IN BLUR
Let neon dissolve into a cinematic glow. Add background blur and dreamy bokeh inspired by a wide-aperture lens, then give an everyday night shot a hazy, film-like aftertaste.
MOTION BLUR, MADE TO BREATHE
Add natural motion blur to running, cycling, dancing, skating, street scenes, traffic, and sports.
Blur the subject, blur the background, or let both move together for a frame that feels alive instead of frozen.
FACE BLUR FOR THE AFTER-PARTY GLOW
Soften a face without losing the feeling of the moment. Face blur brings back that loose, dazed, slightly imperfect after-party mood: flash-lit skin, a wandering glance, and a late-night snapshot that was never meant to look polished.
STAY CLEAR IN THE RUSH
Keep your subject in focus while the world around them drifts. Background blur and depth blur add distance and separation to portraits, street shots, and travel photos, so the eye knows exactly where to land.
BOKEH FOR CITY LIGHTS AND LATE NIGHTS
Turn neon signs, windows, street lamps, and distant headlights into glowing bokeh. Give night scenes the soft depth of a wide-aperture lens without losing their atmosphere.
FILM FILTERS WITH A LITTLE BEAUTIFUL DAMAGE
Bring back the texture of a photo with a history. Blend film grain, soft-focus diffusion, and light leaks for a warm, imperfect finish that feels intimate, tactile, and slightly undone.
Try black and white or two-tone filters when the mood calls for something quieter.
MORE WAYS TO SHAPE THE MOOD
- AI face blur, portrait blur, background blur, and depth blur
- Motion blur, bokeh blur, Gaussian blur, swirl blur, mosaic, chromatic aberration, and frosted-glass textures
- Film grain, soft-focus diffusion, light leaks, black and white, and two-tone filters
- Precise controls and high-resolution export
A photo does not have to be perfect to stay with you.
Give it a little blur, a little light, and a feeling worth remembering.
Download Bluur Cam and turn everyday moments into images with a pulse.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/motion-blur-effect-privacy/%E9%A6%96%E9%A1%B5

bluejetty:00149767:ios.description:
RadioLand tells you exactly which radio stations you should be able to hear, and shows you why. 
Using Longley-Rice terrain propagation modeling, RadioLand calculates FM, AM and NOAA Weather Radio reception from your current location or anywhere in North America, Bermuda and the Caribbean. Search by location, frequency, call sign, sports team or radio market.
 COVERAGE & SIGNAL 
Longley-Rice coverage maps for FM and AM stations. FCC protected contour and 40 dBµV/m contour overlays. AM day and night skywave coverage. Terrain profile view showing obstacles between you and the transmitter. Adjustable receiver height above ground level.
STATION INTELLIGENCE 
Interference analysis for co-channel and adjacent channel conflicts. HD Radio subchannel formats and slogans. NFL, MLB, NBA, and NHL affiliate listings and network maps. NOAA Weather Radio coverage.
BUILT FOR ENTHUSIASTS 
Apple Maps integration. List and map view with signal strength clustering. Stored Dials to save and reload your favorite locations. Search across the US, Canada, Mexico, Bermuda and the Caribbean.
No app covers radio signal reception in North America more thoroughly than RadioLand.

bluejetty:00121792:ios.name: Panasonic Image App
bluejetty:00121792:ios.summary: “Panasonic Image App” is an application that makes it possible to use your smartphone to remotely control the shooting and playback functions of a Wi-Fi-compatible digital camera/digital video camera, and to perform upload operations to SNS
bluejetty:00121792:ios.description:
“Panasonic Image App” is an application that makes it possible to use your smartphone to remotely control the shooting and playback functions of a Wi-Fi-compatible digital camera/digital video camera, and to perform upload operations to SNS (Social Networking Service) sites.
The following major functions are available with this application.
・You can watch the same image as on the Live View screen of your digital camera/digital video camera on your smartphone, and control shooting and other camera operations as with a wireless remote controller. (*1)
・You can play back still pictures and videos recorded using your digital camera/digital video camera on your smartphone. (*2) (*3) You can also copy them to your smartphone, and upload them to SNS sites. (*3)
Additional functions for digital cameras
・This app allows you to implement continuous connection with a digital camera that has Bluetooth function and make Wi-Fi connections and perform remote operation just with your smart phone. It also allows you to apply location information to recorded images and easily perform automatic transfer of images.(*4)
・You can make settings to automatically transfer still pictures recorded with your digital camera to your smartphone.
・You can add location information acquired with your smartphone to pictures recorded using your digital camera.
(*1) With DMC-SZ8/SZ9/SZ10/TZ55/TZ56/TZ57/TZ58/ZS35/ZS45, it is not possible to remotely record videos from a smartphone.
(*2) With DMC-FT5/GF6/LF1/SZ8/SZ9/SZ10/TS5/TZ37/TZ40/TZ41/TZ55/TZ56/TZ57/TZ58/ZS27/ZS30/ZS35/ZS45, it is only possible to play back still pictures.
(*3) Not supported on HC-X1000.
(*4) This function can only be used with devices that support Bluetooth 4.0 or above (Bluetooth low energy technology).
[Compatible Operating Systems]
　　iOS 16 – 26
[Notes]
・Bluetooth function can only be used with smart phones equipped with Bluetooth 4.0 and above (Bluetooth low energy technology).
・When using the location information recording function, note that high accuracy location information cannot be acquired with the iPod touch or the Wi-Fi version of the iPad that is not equipped with a GPS sensor.
・When using an iPhone or iPad that is equipped with a GPS sensor, be aware that continued use of the GPS function can lead to a dramatic decrease in battery capacity.
・In order to use the SNS upload functions or the Cloud Sync. Service, you must first obtain a service user ID for Panasonic’s LUMIX CLUB (free of charge).
・Continued use of GPS/Bluetooth running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
・The function to transfer images to an AV device can no longer be used. (Version 1.10.7 and later)
・The function to delete images can no longer be used. (Version 1.10.15 and later)
・The function of "Home Monitor" can no longer be used. (Version 1.10.19 and later)
・The function of "Baby Monitor" can no longer be used. (Version 1.10.19 and later)

bluejetty:00066243:ios.name: Rise of Kingdoms
bluejetty:00066243:ios.summary:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a
bluejetty:00066243:ios.description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.
▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!
Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.
Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.
Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!
Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.
Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.
Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!
RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/riseofkingdomsgame/

bluejetty:00037379:ios.description:
Universal TV Remote Control App turns your smartphone into a full-featured remote control for your TV.
No more searching for your physical remote — all the essential functions are now in one handy app.
Control TVs of all major brands using a Wi-Fi connection. Change channels, adjust volume, open streaming services, and even test your internet speed — all from your phone.
App Features:
– Wi-Fi Connection
Easily connect to your TV on the same network and control it wirelessly.
– Full Remote Control
All the standard buttons: volume, channels, number pad, joystick, touchpad, and menu — everything on one screen.
– Internet Speed Test
Quickly check your connection: download, upload, and ping — to ensure smooth streaming.
– Cast Media to TV
Share photos and videos from your phone to your TV screen — perfect for big-screen moments.
– Quick Launch of Services
Open streaming apps with a single tap from the app interface — no more navigating menus.
Subscription Information:
– The app offers subscriptions.
– Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
– The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and will identify the cost of the renewal.
– Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in your App Store account settings after purchase.
– Subscriptions can be canceled anytime in your Apple ID settings. All prices include applicable local sales taxes.
– If 3-day trial subscriptions are offered, they will automatically convert to a paid subscription unless canceled before the end of the trial period.
– Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Privacy Policy: https://jokorpoapp.com/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://jokorpoapp.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00063366:ios.description:
Sharpen your mind with a connect-the-block-style one-line brain training puzzle game.
A simple but addictive one-line puzzle game that’s completely free to play.
Your brain becomes more active the more you play.
During your commute, before you sleep… enjoy downtime with brain training.
The rules are extremely simple.
Just fill in all of the blocks using only one line.
Use hints for puzzles that are too hard to solve.
Hints are also free, of course.
4 levels of difficulty.
A whopping 2,000 puzzles.
Don’t get too cozy—the puzzles get harder as you go along.
One-line puzzles are mathematical problems with origins in the early 18th century. First posed in Königsberg, the original puzzle revolved around the town’s Pregel River.
Mathematical thinking is said to increase work efficiency and prevent aging.
Whether math is your bane or your forte, be sure to give this game a try.
You’re sure to get hooked on these puzzles!

bluejetty:00017369:ios.summary:

With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any video you want on your
bluejetty:00017369:ios.description:
Watch web videos, online movies, live TV streams and your personal photos, videos & music on your Amazon Fire TV. Enjoy the show on your big screen.
With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any video you want on your Amazon Fire TV (movies, TV shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and wait for the video link detection. The video link will appear below the browser. Tap it and the video will be sent to your big screen instantly! Streaming personal media from your device is also supported.
>>> Important Notes
* The app only works with an Amazon Fire TV or Fire TV Stick.
* iTunes movies and DRM-protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO Now are not supported!
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. It may also be neccessary to start casting multiple times until it works with specific videos.
* If a video is not working at all, please check the FAQ on the app startpage. If that does not help you, please drop us an email before leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for that website as soon as possible. 
>>> PRO FEATURES
* Remote Playbar: A remote control that allows you to fast forward or rewind videos while browsing. It syncs across all your iPads & iPhones that are connected to the same Fire TV. So your video can be controlled by different users in the same room.
* Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. 
* Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings. 
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Desktop Mode: Change the browser user-agent and cloak your iPhone/iPad as a desktop PC to load the desktop website instead of the mobile website. Please note that this will NOT enable video casting on websites that serve Flash videos in desktop mode.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
>>> A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPERS
Countless websites have been reported to us and we already support more than 90% of all videos on the internet. But we also know things can get even better. Your feedback and priorities will drive our work ahead, and you’ll see new features and more supported websites in our next app updates.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Amazon or any other trademark mentioned here. Amazon and all related marks are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates. This app was not created or endorsed by Amazon.
