bluejetty:00144083:ios.description:
The first Saint Seiya Themed Vertical Screen Idle RPG, "Saint Seiya: Legend of Justice" brand new version is released! Hades, the strongest god, has arrived! Log in to get him! Build the top underworld team to dominate the ultimate Sanctuary War!
Follow our official communities to learn more about anniversary events and win more rewards!
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/seiyaLoJ/
Discord https://discord.gg/saintseiya
[Benefits for New Players, Log in to Claim Powerful Gold Knight]
Keep logging in the game, then you can get a 5-star Gold Knight on the 2nd day and the powerful DPS 6-star Leo Aioria on the 7th day; complete the exclusive event for new players, and you can get the super supporter 5-star Aries Mû! Let's check more events in the game!
[Official Authorization to Revive the Original Manga]
Adapted from the original Saint Seiya manga with strict supervision! The classic plot of the Poseidon Chapter is reproduced. Go to the bottom of the sea with the Knights of Athena and challenge the Sea God Poseidon; rescue the Goddess and destroy the evil plan of the Sea Dragon Canon.
[Real-Time Fierce Battle, Burning Your Cosmo]
Play the first Saint Seiya themed vertical screen idle RPG "Saint Seiya" mobile game anywhere and anytime which shows you heart-beating battles with the 3D screen. Release the classic skills, Pegasus Meteor Punch, Rozan Rising Dragon Blow, and Flying Phoenix on your finger!
[Collect Knights to Create the Strongest Team]
The 88 Knights under the Goddess Athena assemble! Pegasus Seiya, Phoenix Ikki, Virgo Shaka and Gemini Saga are all here at your command. Marina Generals under the Sea God Poseidon also join the battle, such as Sea Dragon Canon, Siren Sorento and Kraken Isaac. Gather your favorite knights to form the strongest team for guarding the Goddess!
[Strategic Formation Turns Defeat Into Victory]
Collect Knights to get more options for your team! There are six elements of Water, Fire, Air, Earth, Light and Darkness, four types of Protector, Warrior, Assassin, and Skilled Knights, attribute restraint and control skills, there is no strongest knight but only stronger formation. Bronze knights counterattack gold knights, staged battle myths of turning defeat into victory!
[Classic Voices Redolent of Youth Memory]
Dubbed by dozens of Japanese top voice actors, Saint Seiya: Legend of Justice will awaken your youth memory, lead you back to the sanctuary, let cosmo burn again!

bluejetty:00182642:ios.description:
Ready to play Scopa?
Scopa Più brings one of Italy’s most loved traditional card games to your smartphone.
Play Scopa online for free against real players, challenge your friends at private tables, or relax with offline matches against the AI. Whether you’re a Scopa expert or discovering the game for the first time, Scopa Più offers the perfect balance between tradition and modern gameplay.
A Modern Take on a Classic Card Game
We’ve reimagined Traditional Scopa with:
Smooth animations
A clean, modern interface
Optimized graphics for phones and tablets
Designed for top performance anywhere, anytime — even on the go.
Competitive & Social Game Modes
• Real Online Multiplayer
Play live Scopa matches against thousands of real players.
• Tournaments & Championships
Test your skills in competitive tournaments with real-time rankings. Win trophies, unlock rewards, and prove yourself against players of your level.
• Social Lobby & Chat
Join the lobby, chat with opponents, and meet other Scopa lovers from around the world.
• Offline Mode
Play Scopa anytime against smart AI — no internet connection required.
• Private Tables
Invite friends and create custom matches with your own rules.
• Levels & Achievements
Climb the leaderboard and earn unique badges that showcase your Scopa experience.
Authentic Italian Cards – 16 Regional Decks
Choose from 16 authentic card decks, faithfully recreated to honor Italian tradition.
Popular Decks
Neapolitan, Sicilian, Piacentine, Milanese
Historic Regional Decks
Trevisane, Tuscan, Bergamasche, Bolognese, Bresciane, Genoese, Piedmontese, Romagnole, Sardinian, Trentine, Triestine
International Deck
French Playing Cards (Poker-style)
Go Gold – Premium Features
Upgrade to Gold and enjoy:
• No Ads – uninterrupted gameplay
• Unlimited Private Messages
• Custom Profile Picture
• Advanced Contact Management
Download Now – It’s Free
If you love online card games, download Scopa Più today and show your skills.
No registration required — start playing instantly.
Discover More Italian Classics
Explore other family-friendly classics by Spaghetti Interactive, including:
Briscola, Scopone, Tresette, Burraco, Ramino, Scala 40, Checkers, Chess, Solitaire and many more card and word games.
Website: www.scopapiu.it
Support: giochipiu+scopa@gmail.com
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

- Add multiple rowcounters to a project
- Import a pattern pdf or an image
- App remembers your last peek at the pattern
- Add pictures and reference photos to a project
- Add your yarn of choice
- Archive projects when needed
- Multiple languages supported

- Added French language with the help of Clémentine: merci beaucoup
- Added German language with the help of Judith: Vielen Dank
- Added Spanish language with the help of Josefa: muchas gracias
- Added Japanese language with the help of Yoko: どうもありがとうございました

Are you missing your language? Send us an email @ pocketknitting@rickfleuren.nl

Bayut KSA: Saudi Arabia's Premier Real Estate App
Bayut KSA brings a transformative experience to real estate search in The Kingdom. Whether you're looking to buy a cozy apartment in Riyadh, rent a spacious villa, or find a furnished apartment for rent, Bayut KSA offers unparalleled access to properties for sale and rent across Saudi Arabia.

Key Features of Bayut KSA:
Property Search: Easily find your next home or investment. Filter searches by location, price, and type—from villas to apartments, and everything in between.
Detailed Listings: Each listing is packed with essential details, high-quality images, floor plans, and exclusive amenities to guide your decision.
Favourites & Alerts: Save your favourite properties and receive alerts on new listings that meet your criteria, ensuring you never miss out.
Arabic Support: Full Arabic language support makes your search comfortable and effective, catering specifically to our local users.
User-Friendly Interface: An intuitive and sleek interface allows for effortless navigation and a smoother property search experience.
Contact Agents: Directly connect with professional real estate agents via phone, SMS, WhatsApp, or email to arrange viewings or get more details.
Property Insights: Stay ahead with updates on market trends and real estate news within Saudi Arabia.
Whether you're searching for an investment property or a place to call home, Bayut KSA simplifies it all. 
Dive into the real estate market with Bayut KSA and experience a seamless property-finding journey. Download the app for free today and step closer to finding your dream property!

bluejetty:00184710:ios.description:
PLAY as Mono, a little monkey who has to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies to find his brother and save the earth.
JUMP and RUN through exciting levels and discover breathtaking places with lots of hiding places.
Giant invaders have come from the outer worlds to conquest the earth, they spread corruption and slaved the animals from the earth, but they didn’t expect to clash with the Monkey bros. 
Mono needs to find his brother and save the world, with his assistant Doctor and your help to kick the Giants out of this planet.
Amazing features of Super Kong Jumper - Monkey Bros:
+ 64 well-designed levels
+ 7 amazing characters: Mono, Jim, Brother, Doctor, Wizard, Warlock and Viking
+ Fabulous animations and in-game graphics 
+ Different world themes
+ 8 challenging enemies
+ Game Services with tricky achievements and awesome leaderboards
+ Share your progress with that of your Facebook friends!
+ Easy touch game
+ Offline games - you can play the game without internet
Mono hangouts with his brother in the jungle, suddenly they hear an explosion of something entering the earth. The invaders are giants from the outer worlds and want to conquest the earth to build their new home here, they spread corruption in the jungle and slave the animals, brother can not stand and watch this happen and try to free the animals, but the Giants cast a spell on him too, capturing him and taking him to a unknown place. Mono is now solitaire and needs to follow the path of the statues from the ancient temple to find his brother and free the world. Don’t let it be his last day on earth, help Mono and kick the Giants out of this planet.

bluejetty:00176471:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey of ambition and decision-making in "Business Life," the ultimate life simulator that puts you in control of your destiny. Start from scratch and pave your way to success in this immersive simulation game that combines elements of exchange, crypto, business, and relationship management.
Build Your Business Empire:
Construct your business from the ground up. Make strategic decisions, invest wisely, and watch your company thrive. From small ventures to multinational corporations, the power is in your hands.
Exchange and Crypto Management:
Dive into the dynamic world of exchange and crypto. Monitor market trends, make informed choices, and build your fortune by navigating the volatile yet rewarding landscape of digital assets.
Relationships Matter:
Forge meaningful connections both personally and professionally. Your relationships impact your success, so nurture them wisely. Build a network of allies, partners, and maybe even find love along the way.
Skills and Development:
Sharpen your skills to stay ahead of the competition. From leadership to technical expertise, continuous development is key to unlocking new opportunities and overcoming challenges.
Life Choices and Consequences:
Every decision you make shapes your character's journey. Be prepared to face the consequences of your choices, whether it's a lucrative business deal or a personal relationship.
Immersive Life Simulation:
Experience a realistic simulation of life's twists and turns. Navigate through ups and downs, overcome obstacles, and celebrate your triumphs as you live out your entrepreneurial dreams.
Why "Business Life"?
Engaging Gameplay: Dive into a captivating blend of strategy, simulation, and decision-making.
Endless Possibilities: Explore a vast virtual world filled with opportunities and challenges.
Realistic Business Dynamics: Learn and adapt to the ever-changing landscape of the business world.
Social Interaction: Connect with friends, compete in business challenges, and collaborate on ventures.
Unleash the entrepreneur in you – download "Business Life" now and start building the life you've always dreamed of!
Feel free to customize this description to better fit the unique aspects and features of your game.

Defeat various monsters in the game, resurrect them to form your own army, and conquer each stage. Each battle requires unique strategies and controls, making the most of the necromancer's abilities.

- Skill Enhancement System: Upgrade the necromancer's magic skills and abilities with experience points earned during battles.
- Ability Upgrades: As the necromancer levels up, permanently enhance stats to unlock powerful magic abilities.
- Summoning and Equipment Enhancement: Summon the best weapons, armor, and accessories to make your necromancer even stronger. Equipment can be obtained through

Start your adventure and clear all stages in the necromancer world! The cute necromancer RPG roguelike game will continue to update for your adventures.
Enjoy the exciting necromancer roguelike game now!

bluejetty:00089214:ios.description:
The Ollie app makes caring for your dog’s health (and managing their meals) beautifully simple.
From real-time box updates to personalized health insights, everything you need to help your pup thrive lives right here — all designed to bring you even closer to the dog you’re obsessed with.
TRACK YOUR DOG’S WELLBEING
Stay in tune with your dog’s health through Ollie’s Wellbeing Score and regular health check-ins. Log updates for weight, digestion, skin & coat, and dental health to spot patterns early — and support a happier, healthier life, one check-in at a time.
MANAGE YOUR BOX IN SECONDS
Life happens. Adjust in just a few taps.
Reschedule a delivery, get a box ASAP, or delay an upcoming shipment with quick actions. Update recipes, portions, meal prep type, delivery frequency, or address — all without missing a beat.
PERSONALIZED PUP PROFILE
Everything about your dog, in one place.
View and manage their profile, including photo, weight, activity level, and more — because no two dogs (or plans) are the same.
ADD EXTRAS & TREATS
Feeling generous?
Top up your box with treats, supplements, and extras whenever you want. (Birthdays not required.)
STAY ON TRACK WITH TO-DOS
Consistency is key — and we’ve got your back.
Get helpful reminders and to-dos that make feeding, check-ins, and everyday care easier to stay on top of.
NEVER MISS AN UPDATE
Turn on push notifications to stay in the loop on shipping updates, delivery tracking, and account changes — so you always know what’s happening with your pup’s plan.
REFER A FRIEND
Share the obsession.
Invite friends to Ollie directly from the app and earn cash back on your next box when they join.
ORDER HISTORY & ACCOUNT CONTROL
Full visibility. Full control.
Review past orders, manage account details, and update preferences anytime — because caring for your dog should feel effortless.

bluejetty:00123762:ios.name: BVS Solitaire Collection
bluejetty:00123762:ios.summary: BVS Solitaire Collection is a multi-featured collection of 330 solitaire card games. All your old time favourites are included such as Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, Klondike, Tri-Peaks, Scorpion, Seahaven Towers, Accordion, Russian Solitaire,
bluejetty:00123762:ios.description:
BVS Solitaire Collection is a multi-featured collection of 330 solitaire card games. All your old time favourites are included such as Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid, Klondike, Tri-Peaks, Scorpion, Seahaven Towers, Accordion, Russian Solitaire, Monte Carlo, Forty Thieves, Flower Garden, Golf, Cruel, Yukon etc. It also includes a lot of unique solitaire variations not found elsewhere. And you can modify rules of almost any of the included games, thus creating your own solitaire variations. 
BVS Solitaire Collection can be played in both portrait and landscape modes. You can move cards with a single tap (in addition to drag and drop) that makes gameplay faster and easer. Hint button lets you examine the possible moves. When you’re stuck, you can use the unlimited Undos to come back and try another approach.
BVS Solitaire Collection is a universal app: buy once, play on iPhone, iPod and iPad! It will provide you with endless hours of solitaire gaming fun.
Features
* Universal App
* Landscape and portrait support
* Right and left handed layouts
* You can modify rules and create your own solitaire variations
* Single tap to move cards (in addition to drag and drop)
* Attractive smoothly scalable playing cards
* Excellent high quality backgrounds and card backs
* Hint button lets you examine the possible moves
* Long-press on any pile to see the type of this pile, the number of cards in it, and the building rules
* Autoplay on/off option
* Replay the same game
* Multi-level undo/redo
* Statistics
* Sound effects

bluejetty:00068920:ios.description:
Get free instant access to videos and programs on demand. The NTD app serves you with trusted news on the latest events in world affairs. The app features livestreams, 24-hour TV programs, original exclusive videos, and much more.
Watch important news anytime and anywhere. The NTD app gives you access to original award-winning content such as digital shorts, full-length shows, feature films and documentaries. Keep yourself up to date with the latest breaking news and top stories.
Download the NTD app to experience traditional independent news the way it should be.
MAIN APP FEATURES
(+) 24-hour TV Programs.
(+) Top Section: See all important news and hot topics in the US, China, and around the world at a glance, such as US election.
(+) Breaking News Alerts, top stories, and trending videos at your fingertips.
(+) Livestream: Watch live broadcast of major events in the US and around the world.
(+) Watch for free: original award-winning content covering digital shorts, full-length shows, feature films, and documentaries.
(+) Watch full episodes of your favorite TV shows including Crossroads and American Thought Leaders, featuring expert news analysis to help you break down and understand important news stories.
(+) Watch full-length episodes of China in Focus, fast compelling first-hand news and insight from China.
(+) Save videos and watch anytime.
(+) Share videos with your friends and family.
Terms of service: https://www.ntd.com/terms-of-service.html
Privacy policy: https://www.ntd.com/privacy-policy.html
TECHNICAL HELP AND ASSISTANCE:
We constantly improve the NTD app to ensure our readers have an excellent experience using it. If you have any questions/feedback, or experience any technical difficulties, please feel free to contact us at appsupport@ntdtv.com. 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
NTD is a New York-based global news and entertainment media, founded in 2001. Our content is based on the fundamentals of reporting based on fact and truth, creating a community centered around high impact, positive, brand-safe content. NTD is a non-partisan news source and we believe that it's the public’s right to know the truth, and so we strive to cover all major content happening to keep our viewers up to date with what’s happening in our world.
We bring humanity into everything we do and better understand who we are today by looking at history, culture, and tradition. We are inspired by timeless stories that promote universal values and humanity. We believe that if the stories and ideas we take in embody positivity, we can create change for a better future.
The human spirit is one of positivity, resilience, and hope. We believe this spirit needs fuel. That’s why we do our best to provide content that moves you, brings more light into your life, and helps you become a wiser, brighter person. If every one of us can foster a deeper understanding and compassion toward one another, this world will be a better place.

bluejetty:00078013:ios.description:
Struggling to compose emails and write replies to the messages in your inbox? Xemail is here to help you write emails 10 times faster!
Xemail is a smart AI email writer and generator that helps you write emails and letters, and generate replies in seconds. As a professional AI email writing assistant powered by ChatGPT API and GPT-4, Xemail leverages the latest artificial intelligence technology to craft professional, articulate, and engaging emails. Whether you're creating business emails, drafting a cover letter, or writing a WhatsApp reply, Xemail is your go-to solution.
Key Features of Xemail:
• Time-saving: Write an email in seconds and say goodbye to spending hours making a professional email. Xemail is quick, efficient, and hassle-free.
• Effortless drafting: Input your basic ideas, and let Xemail articulate them into well-structured emails.
• Advanced AI tool for email writing: Harness the power of AI to write emails. From formal business emails to friendly updates, Xemail adapts to your needs.
• Smart suggestions: Get suggestions for effective phrasing and tone, making your emails impactful and engaging.
• Personalized emails: Customizable templates cater to various themes - business, education, personal, and more. Get email examples and samples for job applications, reminders, out-of-office replies, introductions, promotions, and sales.
• Multiple language support: Our AI supports more than 50 languages, including Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, Dutch, Hindi, and Portuguese.
Xemail is the AI email generator and writing helper in your pocket for every occasion. With just a few clicks, you can create emails tailored to your specific context and audience. Also, you can learn how to write emails to improve your email writing skills. 
Business
We help you generate professional emails that reflect your brand's voice and ethos, ensuring effective communication with clients and colleagues. Whether crafting a follow-up email after receiving no response, composing compelling marketing emails, or initiating cold emails, Xemail can help you write them in seconds. It also provides a wealth of professional business email examples and samples to guide you. 
Job 
Need to send a resignation letter or follow up after an interview? Xemail has you covered. Our AI also assists in drafting emails for applying for a job, creating compelling cover letters and even generating personalized letters of recommendation. 
Personal Use
Our AI helps you create heartfelt personal emails, Whether you're expressing gratitude with a thank-you letter or conveying sincere sentiments in an apology email. Also, Xemail AI can help you compose messages and generate responses.
Download Xemail now on Apple Store and experience the future of email composition. Start using Xemail with a free trial.
Contact: support@xemail.ai
Terms: https://www.xemail.ai/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://www.xemail.ai/privacy.html
INFORMATION ON USING THE APP AND REGARDING SUBSCRIPTION
Xemail is free to download and use. However, to unlock the full range of features, you can choose from various subscription plans. When you opt for a subscription, the price is determined based on your country and displayed within the app. If you wish to continue your subscription, it will automatically renew for the originally chosen duration, charging your selected payment method, unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current term expires. You also have the option to disable the auto-renewal feature in your App Store account settings.

Plan high-protein, low-carb meals around your preferences
Explore whole-food recipes and log your meals
Explore protein-containing recipes
Track your daily habits and wellness observations
2. BUILD HABITS THAT LAST
Carnimeal focuses on small daily actions that create lasting change:
Meal planning reminders and daily check-ins
Habit streaks to reflect on eating habits
Lifestyle challenges that build routine
Guidance to end yo-yo dieting and stay consistent
You're not following a trend – you're creating a sustainable lifestyle.

No complicated shopping lists. No calorie counting. No restrictions that make you quit.
High-protein carnivore meal plans
Quick recipes you can make in minutes

Easy weekly planning that fits your life

Personalized meal ideas to match your goals
Clear protein targets and simple eating windows
Meal-planning information and daily tracking tools
Tools to record eating habits and reflect on cravings
Plan meals ahead with recipes and preparation guidance.
5. SMART TRACKING FOR REAL PROGRESS
See your transformation unfold with built-in trackers:
Weight & body progress
Habit streaks
Water intake
Daily meals & fasting windows
Carnimeal helps you stay aware, adjust when needed, and celebrate every milestone.

The coach is an AI assistant, not a human coach or healthcare professional. Responses are generated automatically and may be inaccurate. It provides general information and habit support, not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or emergency assistance.

bluejetty:00170056:ios.description:
Monitor. Track. Control. Secure. RV Halo creates an Internet of Things for RVs keeping you connected while on the road or at home.

Winegard Company is a trusted connectivity partner for designing and manufacturing the greatest range of world-class connectivity products and services, including WiFi and 4G LTE, satellite, broadband, video, and over-the-air technology for residential, commercial, and mobile applications. Founder, John Winegard, invented the multi-channel Yagi antenna and since its incorporation in 1953, Winegard has designed more than 1,000 antenna models and been granted more than 90 U.S. patents. The company's heritage includes recognition by NASA for contributions to the Apollo 11 mission, and the induction of founder John Winegard into the Consumer Electronics Association Hall of Fame.
Winegard's high-performance designs for TV, wireless, and cellular technologies are manufactured in the U.S.A. The company is developing technologies to create “smart hubs” that use cloud services to check on, manage, and control devices in RVs, boats, semi-trucks, and more. The Iowa-based facility totals 410,000 sq. ft. and includes a state-of-the-art testing, validation, and measurement center. Headquartered in Burlington, Iowa, Winegard has locations in Illinois, Indiana, Idaho and Oregon.

bluejetty:00079593:ios.description:
* What is Sea Drive?
Sea Drive is a marine and boating navigation application focused on charting, navigation, route building, track recording, tides, currents, and more! Our goal is to provide the best user experience for boaters on and off the water. 
Sea Drive provides FREE US charts! We believe that everyone should have the tools on the water to feel safe and know how to find their way home (or pull up to a restaurant).
* Who is it for?
Sea Drive is for all of you who love the water! If you spend time on sailboats, fishing boats, bowriders, wakeboard boats, kayaks, or canoes this app will quickly become your go to co-captain
* What are the features? 
**Offline Use
Sea Drive is meant to be used on the water and in the real world, that means cell service won't always be available. Charting, tides, currents, routing, tracks, GPS, compass, and more are all available without internet! 
** Free Chart Data (US)
Currently only US charts are available (and will always remain free thanks to NOAA and your tax dollars). As Sea Drive improves we will be adding other chart regions for free or as low cost as possible.
** Tides and Currents
Tap a tides or currents icons on the chart to view offline predictions (for years into the future) at over 3000 locations.
** Build and Navigate Routes
Build routes with easy to add waypoints, drag waypoints, delete waypoints, and give waypoints custom names. Export and share your routes with other boaters. Activate a route to see bearing (magnetic or true) to waypoints, estimated time to waypoints, and ETA at destination among other metrics. 
** Record Tracks
Review and playback previously recorded tracks.
** Create and Share Markers
Add notes and measure distances to markers.
** Basic Features
Location (GPS & Compass). Caliper tool. Display settings for custom chart options. Vessel details for hazard avoidance and route planning. Satellite and road map chart overlays.
** POI
We've integrated with marinas.com so we can show points interest directly on the chart for features like marinas, boat ramps, anchorage areas, inlets, locks, harbors and more.
** Weather
View weather forecasts for up to five days in the future including marine related weather like wind, gusts, swells, and wave information.
** Live Track Sharing
Create a live track share and send the link to friends. When imported, followers will see your current location and previous track directly on the Sea Drive app or website.
* We love feedback!
Sea Drive is built by boaters for boaters. This is just the start of our journey and we would like you all to be a part of it with us! Please provide any and all feedback!

bluejetty:00144396:ios.description:
ESHOT
ESHOT GENEL MÜDÜRLÜĞÜ MOBİL UYGULAMASI
İzmir Büyükşehir Belediyesi ESHOT Genel Müdürlüğü’nün geliştirdiği ESHOT Mobil Uygulaması ile İzmir otobüs ulaşımına ait tüm bilgilere hızlı ve güvenli bir şekilde erişebilirsiniz. 
Uygulama içerisinde bulunan “Arama” ekranı ile otobüs hat ve duraklara erişebilir, seçtiğiniz otobüs hattına ait durakları, otobüslerin anlık olarak hangi durakta olduğunu görebilirsiniz. Durak seçimini yaptığınızda durağa anlık olarak yaklaşmakta olan otobüsler ve duraktan geçen hatları listeleyebilirsiniz. 
Tamamen kişiselleştirebileceğiniz ESHOT Genel Müdürlüğü resmi mobil uygulamasında, seçtiğiniz hat ve durakları favori listenize ekleyebilir ve hızlı bir şekilde favorilerinize ulaşabilirsiniz. 
İstenilen otobüs hatlarına alarm kurabilmenize de imkan veren uygulamamız ile seçim yaptığınız hattın istediğiniz durağına, belirlediğiniz saatler arasında otobüs gelmeden kaç dakika önce bildirim almak istiyorsanız ayarlayabilirsiniz. 
“İzmirim Kart” menüsü ile kullanmakta olduğunuz İzmirim Kart’ınıza –TL yükleyebilir, bakiyesini sorgulayabilir, son kullanım ve son dolum bilgilerini görebilirsiniz. Dilediğiniz kadar İzmirim Kart’ınızı sisteme kayıt edebilir, bu kartlar için alarm kurarak bakiyeniz belirlediğiniz limitin altına düştüğünde bildirim alabilirsiniz. 
Uygulama içerisindeki “Yakınımdakiler” menüsü ile konumunuzun çevresinde bulunan durakları ve akıllı kart bayilerini, haritada ve liste halinde görebilirsiniz. Seçim yaptığınız noktaya yol tarifi alabilir ve durak bilgilerine ulaşabilirsiniz. Konumunuz dışında haritada seçtiğiniz herhangi bir noktanın çevresindeki noktaları da görebilirsiniz. 
“Adrese yakın duraklar” menüsünde; ilçe, mahalle, sokak numarası ve kapı numarasını girdiğiniz adresin çevresindeki duraklara erişebilir, “Önemli Noktalara Ulaşım” menüsünde İzmir’de bulunan eğitim, konaklama, sağlık gibi kategorilerde bir çok noktaya ulaşım imkanı sağlayabilirsiniz. 
Metro, İZBAN ve Vapur bağlantılı hatlarımızı istasyon ve iskele bazında listeleyebilir ve hat bilgilerine kolay bir şekilde erişebilirsiniz.
Kurumumuza ait duyuruları görebilir ve istek, öneri, şikayet menüsünden bize kolayca ulaşabilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00091888:ios.description:
Long ago, the Titans used the Chalk of Fate to occupy the Secret City with four different races and this powerful artifact has now been discovered! A secret archeological exhibition to display priceless Secret City artifacts becomes a dangerous game of finding hidden pictures in these search & find games when a daring thief steals a powerful artifact known as The Chalk of Fate from right under your nose! Now the chase is on, with twists and turns as unpredictable as the back-alleys of New York itself. Playing these adventure games, will you learn who stole the Chalk of Fate, and what do they intend to do with it? Crack the case to learn the truth in this reality-shifting hidden objects games Adventure!
· CHASE DOWN ANOTHER SECRET WORLD VILLAIN IN THE BONUS GAME!
Another artifact is in danger! Sakir asks you to deliver an artifact from his friend’s shop but when you get there you realize that it won’t be as easy as you thought. Will you be able to find the object and get the artifact without any victims in these mystery games?
· SEARCH MUSEUMS, EXPLORE HIDDEN LOCATIONS AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
Lots of unique achievements are waiting for you in one of the best hidden objects games. Search for the items hidden in beautifully drawn locations and explore the enchanting world of the Secret City in these hidden object mystery games!
· TONS OF PAINTINGS, COINS, AND MORPHING OBJECTS TO FIND!
Find all the collectibles to learn about the story behind the Secret City. The statuettes will tell you about the Titans that long inhabited this world. The hidden pictures will show you magical creatures, which one can discover in the universe of the secret city. 
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
Stuck while playing detective games? A useful accessible Strategy Guide will always come to help! It will help you solve any puzzle or mini-game, find all the hidden items in beautifully drawn scenes, and feel sure about what your next move will be.
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----

Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00063741:ios.description:
Most Likely To is a fun party game for adults. Ideal for house parties and all other gatherings where you want to insult each other while having fun together.
Rules:
1. Pass the phone around and read the statement out loud.
2. Everyone points to the person they think the statement suits best.
3. The person with the most fingers pointed at them does the punishment.
If you're feeling hardcore you can play with one drink for each finger pointed at you.
The sentences/challenges are divided into 8 different categories. If you don't want to talk about dirty stuff or relationship stuff, you simply don't use that deck. 
With that being said, keep in mind that this is the game for ADULTS; if you're too young or easily offended, this is not the game for you.
If you like the game show your love by rating it.
If you want to join other party monsters and see what else we got, find the King of Booze group on FB or IG.
Hope you have a blast.

bluejetty:00162035:ios.description:
Savin' reinvents and simplifies tax-free shopping in France. Shop, click and refund!
You live in Switzerland or outside the European Union for more than 6 months a year?
Let us guide you and save up to 14.5% on your purchases in France!
Savin' is a free and fully secure application that refunds VAT on your purchases in France. It's THE ideal solution to make great savings very simply:
**** Our experts are available to assist you and answer all your questions
**** A smooth and simple experience
**** The app is 100% secure and approved by French customs
**** Works in all shops in France (provided that the products purchased are eligible for tax exemption)
**** Adopt the tax refund reflex in your shopping habits and save an average of €381/year
GET YOUR VAT REFUND IN A FEW CLICKS
Step 1: Complete your profile
Bring your identity document and your best smile.
Step 2: Add your proof of purchase
Make your purchases in France for a minimum cumulative amount of €100 including tax. Add your purchases as you go along in the application and obtain your electronic tax-free form.
Step 3: Refund your purchases! 
Scan your form at the electronic terminal (PABLO kiosk) to validate your tax-free status before leaving the European Union.
Immediate refund in one of our partner exchange offices* or in a few days directly into your bank account.
THE ADVANTAGES OF SAVIN'
An unrivalled refund rate of 14.5%:
Low fees that guarantee a rate well above the market trend.
A quick and easy to use app:
We consolidate all your proofs of purchase onto one electronic form. Say goodbye to paper forms and waiting in the shop. You can manage your reimbursements independently directly on your smartphone.
Accumulate your "small purchases" for more tax relief:
Thanks to Savin', you can accumulate purchases made in all shops in France, regardless of the amount, to reach the minimum legal threshold of €100 including tax.
NEW: Get refund on your online purchases from French e-traders.
When finalizing the transaction, make sure you:
> choose a delivery in France. The address can be that of the relay point of your choice. 
Do not use the Savin' address as the delivery address.
> request an invoice made out to Sav'in Tax Free: 
11 chemin de l'industrie - 06110 Le Cannet, France - FR 595 0870 2677.
ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS
To use this service you must be:
- Not a resident of the European Union or a third country at the time of purchase
- A visitor to France for less than six months
- 16 years of age or older
- In possession of the goods purchased on French territory (minimum legal amount €100 including tax)
SECURITY IS OUR PRIORITY
- Service approved by French customs
- We guarantee the security of your information
- Access to the application is secured by a password
- Find our privacy policy here: https://savintaxfree.com/politique-de-confidentialite.html 
*Partner exchange offices management fees are not included

bluejetty:00157974:ios.description:
▶▶▶Experience Authentic MMA Action with the Official Mobile Game of ONE Championship!◀◀◀
Compete in fast-paced, real-time PvP battles featuring 20+ iconic MMA athletes. Strategize and react swiftly in this unique fusion of match3 puzzles and tactical fighting gameplay. Matches last just 2–3 minutes, delivering intense and thrilling action for fans of MMA, fighting, and match3 puzzle tactic games.
KEY FEATURES
► 20+ Iconic ONE Championship MMA Athletes – Battle with legends of mixed martial arts.
► Real-Time PvP Battles – Fast-paced fights lasting only 2–3 minutes.
► Unique Match3 PvP Mechanics – A never-before-seen fusion of match3, tactic and combat.
► No Weight Classes or Gender Restrictions – Create your dream MMA matchups.
► RPG Style Progression – Level up athletes and unlock new skills and abilities.
► Deckbuilding – Combine unlocked abilities with an athlete’s innate skills to create the ultimate deck.
► Smart Matchmaking – Face balanced fights against evenly skilled opponents.
► Collect Rare Skins – Customize your fighter with unique shorts, animations, and more.
► Climb the Leaderboards – Rise from Amateur to Legendary in a six-tier league system.
► Stunning 3D Graphics & Animations – Built on authentic MMA moves.
► Web3 Integration – Earn adrenaline points through gameplay and unlock exclusive real-life rewards via the Pro Arena questing platform.
► Web3 Extra Features – Enhance your athlete, earn adrenaline points, and trade on the Pro Arena secondary market.
► Challenge Friends – Take on your friends in direct PvP battles.

►►Collect, Customize, and Dominate the Leaderboards!
Earn rare shorts skins for your fighter, climb the ranks, and unlock amazing KO moves, victory celebrations, and fighter entrances. Customize your athlete to stand out in the arena and become the ultimate MMA champion.

Play 3 matches in the Daily League to unlock rewards or climb through a six-tier league system – starting from Amateur and reaching the prestigious ONE Legendary League for top-tier prizes.

bluejetty:00066433:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00066433:ios.description:
FIND DATES TO YOUR TASTE:
Fruitz is a dating app dedicated to helping you meet new people, who are looking for the same kind of relationship as you. With Fruitz you can cut straight to the chase with the security of knowing that you'll only match and meet with people who are on the same page. Whether you're looking for something serious, a date or two, or even just one night between the sheets - Fruitz has the fruits to help you directly express what you're looking for.
CHOOSE YOUR FRUIT: 
How many times have you swiped right on dating apps, only to realise that the person on the other end of the chat is on a completely different page to you? Yep, thought as much! That's why with Fruitz you state what you're looking for from the start, by choosing a fruit that represents the type of relationship you want: 
- Cherry: Cherry-pick the one for you 
- Grape: Have Grape dates, no headaches
- Watermelon: Find fruits with benefits 
- Peach: Or for one night between the sheets
SAY GOODBYE TO BORING CHATS:
Dating doesn’t have to be boring. On Fruitz you can start the chat on an interesting note, by choosing from hundreds of juicy opening questions. Some questions are wholesome and some will get you to reveal all your secrets...but that's usually how a great relationship starts, right? So, once you make a smoothie (a.k.a a match), you’ll definitely get to know them well before you meet them IRL.
TASTE THE BEST WITH FRUITZ PREMIUM:
With Premium you can access exciting features including: 
Unlimited likes - Swipe right until your taste buds are satisfied.
Pollen - Boost your profile to the top of other people’s baskets.
Daily Crushnotes - Increase your chances of matching & get exclusive juicy questions to help you make the tastiest first impression.
TASTE THE EXCELLENCE WITH FRUITZ GOLDEN:
With Golden you’ll get all the benefits of Premium, plus more sweet treats including:
Filter by fruit - Only see profiles with fruits to your taste.
See who’s picked you - Never miss a smoothie again, by seeing who’s picked you already.
Incognito Mode - Make yourself invisible to users you haven't liked yet.
EVERYONE IS WELCOME:
Fruitz is open to everyone and aims to be a safe space for all including those from the gay, trans, and the entire LGBTQ+ community.
----------------------------------- 
Fruitz is free to download and use. However, we also offer optional subscription packages including: a 6 or 12-month Fruitz Premium package, and a 3-month or unlimited Fruitz Golden package. Prices may vary per country and are subject to change without notice. Prices are clearly displayed in the app.
If you choose to purchase Fruitz Premium or Golden, payment will be charged to your iTunes account after the order has been confirmed. Your subscription will auto-renew and you will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
----------------------------------- 
We consider the security and privacy of our members very importantly. It is possible for you to prevent your Facebook contacts from seeing your profile. Every profile that would be reported by one of our members will be banned definitively and irrevocably from Fruitz. 
----------------------------------- 
Privacy: https://fruitz.io/privacy 
Terms of Use: https://fruitz.io/terms 
Contact: contact@fruitz.io

Your subscription will auto-renew and you will be charged within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.

bluejetty:00180168:ios.summary:
Become the Rink DJ this weekend
Connect your phone to the arena's PA system and control the full game atmosphere — pump-up songs, goal horns, penalty announcements and player name callouts, all from one app.
What you can do:
• 36 customiza
bluejetty:00180168:ios.description:
Become the Rink DJ this weekend
Connect your phone to the arena's PA system and control the full game atmosphere — pump-up songs, goal horns, penalty announcements and player name callouts, all from one app.
What you can do:
• 36 customizable song buttons with precise start times, organized by period
• Goal horn & siren soundboard — NHL and custom team horns included
• PA announcements: goals, assists, penalties, player names (English & Québécois)
• Apple Watch control — start/stop songs from your wrist
• Works with Apple Music or your local iTunes library (no Spotify yet)
Trusted by hockey parents in minor hockey leagues across Canada
"Hockey Dad" or "Hockey Mom" — this app is for every parent who'd rather be at the scoreboard table than freezing in the stands.
The must have app for ice hockey parents running music at the rink. Play goal horns, manage your playlist by period, trigger sirens and PA announcements — all from your phone. The perfect Dad or Mom Ice Hockey DJ with this app designed for all hockey enthusiasts.
- Transform the Rink Atmosphere:
Be the one setting the ambiance for the team and basking in the warmth as you manage the playlist. Connect with the scoreboard guru, offer to play music during the games, and watch the magic unfold! Did you know the scoreboard booth usually has a heater underneath its table? 
- Your Personal Ice Hockey DJ:
Introducing the "Ice Hockey Dad's Playlist" app – Craft the perfect playlist with designated start times for each song, and effortlessly connect your phone to the rink's audio system.
- Pump Up Your Team:
It's a hockey entertainment music manager and playlists maestro. Play pump-up songs, face-off anthems, and crowd power-ups to energize your team. With 24 pre-loaded songs and the ability to customize its 36 buttons with your own iTunes library.
- Team Spirit on Full Blast!
Full screen of your best team's horns! It comes included. Elevate the cheering experience with customizable horns, organs, and more.
- Personalize Every Moment:
With the power to reprogram every button and set individual starting times for songs, your DJ skills will shine. 
Even customize the "Horn" and "1min Left in the game" buttons, and I have added the latest feature to recall the previous song after a goal announcement. 
- Your Voice, Your Announcements:
In-App purchases offer the chance to quickly play announcements, penalties, and player roster names. Be the voice of the game, whether it's a crucial moment or a celebratory goal. Gregory Juster and Paul Orr lend their voices for regional variations, or choose my son's special announcements voice for added fun!
- Unlock Advanced Features:
Explore additional In-App purchases for penalty announcements, recording player roster names, and more. Record your own announcements, turning you into the ultimate rink DJ mic.
- Seamless Integration:
No need for iTunes Cloud Subscription – the app seamlessly integrates with your iTunes Local Library. Explore pre-loaded links to iTunes titles that will pump up your kid's team, or purchase up to 45 extra screens with 576 customizable buttons for an ultra extended playlist.
- Be the Pro DJ at the Scoreboard Table:
Disclaimer: Copyrighted songs are not included, but this latest version supports iTunes Cloud Music Subscription for song selection, or you can use your local iTunes library. Unfortunately, the application can't leverage Spotify as they declined the integration.
Download "Ice Hockey Dad's Playlist" now and revolutionize your experience at the rink. 
Become the ultimate ice hockey parent, setting the stage for victories and unforgettable moments. 
Your playlist, your game, your legacy!
The must have for Hockey Dad, Hockey Mom, Coach, and Team Manager
Leverage the app for Arena Music as Rink DJ and Game Ambiance for Youth Hockey
And if you want to announce your team's roster, and have all your kid's name played as they hit the ice, check its complementary app : RinkMix.

bluejetty:00186541:ios.summary: With the Juuva Builder app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-appr
bluejetty:00186541:ios.description:
With the Juuva Builder app, you can easily share your way to success with tools that create word-of-mouth buzz and complement belly-to-belly efforts! Connect with new contacts and interact with your team by sharing exclusive, corporate-approved tools. You’ll have a vast array of marketing materials like videos, images, and more—all right at your fingertips! The powerful, yet beautifully simple design, along with compelling tools, makes growing your business simpler than ever.  
Contacts: Choose how to sync and manage your contacts. Swipe to sort them by interest level. You can make connections, add notes, or check out the Contact Feed to see the tools you've shared and contact actions.
Tools: It has never been easier to share information about your products and opportunity via SMS text, email, or social media. Simply choose tools specifically designed to promote your business and share them with a contact. You'll receive a notification when contacts view a tool so you know exactly when to follow up! No data connection? No problem! Simply download tools such as videos in the app beforehand for offline playback.
Samples: There’s no better way than samples to allow prospects to experience your products and the benefits they deliver. Leverage the power of digital and physical with the ability to send product samples directly to prospects. Users receive notifications to help them follow up, and recipients receive emails to help educate them. Site visitors also have the ability to request a sample. Simple and powerful!
Feed: Keep track of everything you’ve shared and see what your contacts have viewed with notifications. You can even swipe notifications to mark them as a Reminder. News also brings all of the latest announcements and social posts from corporate straight to you in one convenient place!
Business: Access helpful links to build your business. 
Settings: Our simple Share Setup will help you upload a profile picture, define your 'why' in your bio, and add other info that will help contacts connect with you and learn more about your business and products. You can also configure notification preferences, watch QuickTips to learn about the app, and more.
***** Accessing the Juuva Builder app requires you to be a member of Juuva and Summit Success*****

bluejetty:00173615:ios.summary: Sweet Meet makes dating for singles easy and fun! Our online dating app lets you meet locals and go on dates with them in real life. You see couples dating whenever you leave the house and wish that could be you? Well, one of the perks of l
bluejetty:00173615:ios.description:
Sweet Meet makes dating for singles easy and fun! Our online dating app lets you meet locals and go on dates with them in real life. You see couples dating whenever you leave the house and wish that could be you? Well, one of the perks of local dating is that you get to make quick plans after chatting a little, without too much effort from either party. No need to drive for an hour or get train tickets to a different city. Go grab coffee with your date, catch a movie at the local theater or get dinner and drinks after work; no need to be on chatting apps for weeks in a row! 
Matching, chatting, setting up dates - as easy as they can be.
Sweet Meet is the dating app for relationship seekers. Today’s society may make you feel like wanting to find a family is silly or outdated, and you may have noticed that most chat apps are designed to find dates predominantly. At Sweet Meet, we value family and think you should be able to find yours. You can match with caring and amazing men on Sweet Meet and find a husband. Same goes for men! Start swiping find a wonderful woman you want to build a life with. Date with the intention to find a family! We promise you, even in this day and age, true love is not impossible to find. You could meet your soulmate today and build a real life fairytale with them! 
Create a fun social network.
We know making friends as an adult is not easy, when you’re out of school and everyone is busy with their own lives. That’s exactly why we’re here to help! Unlike other chat apps, on Sweet Meet, you can meet new people and find friends who match your crazy! Start chatting with your matches today, make fun plans and go on adventures with your new friends. What we forget sometimes, a soulmate doesn’t have to be a romantic partner. With a little help from our app, you can make new friends who can become family. 
All you need to do is download the app on your phone, set up your profile with your favorite photos and a little bit about yourself, and start swiping. Once you get a match, message them to break the ice and start getting to know each other. Feeling a connection? Use the momentum to set up a date that could possibly mark the beginning of something wonderful! But you don’t have to take our word for it. You’ve got nothing to lose, so why waste any more time? Your future partner or best friend could be only a swipe away!
Any town, any country – we embrace people from all over the world.
We securely store your personal data. Please read our privacy policy and terms of service :
https://sweetmeet.me/policy.html
https://sweetmeet.me/agreements.html

bluejetty:00092558:ios.description:
Train with Ash isn't just another fitness APP - its your personal body transformation coach, in your pocket. Designed specifically for woman who are done with quick fixes that never last, and failed weight loss attempts, this APP delivers real and lasting results.. Plus, join a one-of-a-kind community that supports you every step of the way so you’re never left wondering what to do.
Discover the TWA way and transform your body and lifestyle for good.
Your Training, Your Way:
- Tailored programs designed for your body, goals, and lifestyle.
- Flexible options to train at home or in the gym - as little as 3 sessions a week.
- Progression and exercise swaps to match your fitness level and preferences
- Video demos and step-by-step instructions to guide your every move
Nutrition Made Simple:
- Ditch the diets and embrace sustainable, personalised nutrition!
- Eat more, boost your metabolism, and enjoy the foods you love.
- Discover simple, family friendly recipes the whole family will love!! 
Track, Transform, Thrive:
- Weekly progress tracking with photos, and accountability tools like our unique green tick system so you stay on top of your goals!
- Stay accountable with weekly progress tracking, photos, and our unique green tick progress + accountability tracker.
Your Community of Support:
- Join a movement of over 20,000+ women who’ve transformed their body and lives with the TWA method.
- Be part of an empowering community that motivates and inspires daily.
- Real-time support and guidance from expert coaches - including Ash herself! 
Why Train With Ash?
Because this isn’t just about losing fat - it’s about transforming your mind, body, and habits for life. Backed by proven strategies, evidence based methods and expert coaching, Train With Ash gives you everything you need to succeed, even with a busy lifestyle. For so many women now, TWA has been the only approach that finally worked.
Your goals are closer than you think!

bluejetty:00015579:ios.description:
Are you looking for a quick and accurate mushroom identifier? The Picture Mushroom app is right for you!
Simply take or upload a picture of a mushroom, and the Picture Mushroom app will tell you what it is in seconds. The app will offer you several similar species to choose from, and you can find the most exact one by comparing the images. In the scanning result, you can learn lots of useful info including mushroom names, habitats, ways of identifying, and so on. This app will also warn you of some toxic mushrooms so that you can stay away from them to keep safe.
Moreover, the app has many articles about mushrooms, like ways of identifying mushrooms,mushroom-related stories, and more. With the Picture Mushroom app, you can learn the most trending topics in the field. 
Additionally, the app allows you to track your foraging sites for your next picking reference. It will recommend some seasonal mushrooms according to your location, and show the distribution map so that you can know what kind of mushrooms to pick and where to find them. You can also manage and share your identified mushroom with the in-app collection.
Whether you like to collect, study, or teach mushrooms, or just want to learn more about the world of mushrooms, Picture Mushroom is the right tool for beginners and advanced mushroom users.
Key Features:
- Fast and accurate ID of numerous species of mushrooms, fungi, and the like
- Full mushroom encyclopedia including all the info you need to know about mushrooms like name, habitat, identification method, toxicity, and more
- High-quality articles for you to know the trending topics in the field of mushroom
- Finely designed and user-friendly interface which allows you to easily identify, learn and share mushrooms
- Keep track of your foraging site for your next picking reference
- Recommend seasonal mushrooms of your place and show a mushroom distribution map
- Easily keep track of the mushrooms you’ve identified in your collection, and share your findings with your friends
About Picture Mushroom Subscription
- Subscription Name: Yearly Premium
- Subscription Duration: 1 year (7 days trial)
- Subscription Description: Users will get a 1-year Picture Mushroom Premium which includes unlimited mushroom IDs, free consulting with experts, numerous mushroom info, and no ads info views.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Terms of Use:

Privacy Policy:

Contact us:

Find out more about Picture Mushroom at:

bluejetty:00016729:ios.description:
Create beautiful mandalas with just a few simple strokes.
Mandalas: Drawing Studio turns every line you draw into a perfectly symmetrical pattern. Choose how many rotations you want, start drawing, and watch an intricate mandala bloom around the center. No artistic training required.
Focus on your drawing and let your creativity flow.
SYMMETRY DOES THE WORK
• Set your number of rotations and every stroke is repeated around the canvas instantly
• Mirror mode for perfectly balanced, reflected designs
• On-screen guides show your symmetry axes while you draw, and step aside when you don't need them
TOOLS THAT STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
• Brush, paint roller and eraser — that's all it takes
• Full-spectrum color picker with transparency support
• Adjustable line width and canvas background color
• A clean, modern editor designed for both iPhone and iPad
MADE FOR APPLE PENCIL
• Hover preview shows exactly where your stroke will land before you touch the canvas
• Squeeze your Apple Pencil Pro for a quick tool palette — switch tools and undo without breaking your flow
• Low-latency drawing that keeps up with your hand
TRUE VECTOR ARTWORK
• Every stroke is a vector, so you can zoom as deep as you like and your artwork never looks pixelated
• Export high-resolution images to share, post or print
• Export SVG vectors to use in Illustrator, Affinity, Figma or your cutting machine
WORK IN LAYERS
• Build up a piece in layers, and show or hide them as you go
• Undo and redo freely as you build up your drawing
YOUR FILES, YOUR WAY
• Your mandalas live in the Files app and iCloud Drive — open, rename, duplicate and organize them however you like
• No account, no sign-up, and it works completely offline
NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Draw whenever and wherever you want. There are no ads anywhere in Mandalas: Drawing Studio, and premium features — layers, HD image export and alternative app icons — are unlocked with a single one-time purchase. Never a subscription.
Mandalas: Drawing Studio is made by an independent developer, and every purchase goes directly into making it better.

Magalu App: Compre Online com Ofertas Incríveis!
Baixe o app Magalu e tenha um shopping completo na palma da sua mão!
Está procurando uma loja online para a compra de móveis e eletrodomésticos? Na Magalu você encontra tudo que você precisa para sua casa em um só lugar! Celulares, TVs, notebooks, roupas, livros, alimentos, bebidas e muito mais com ofertas imperdíveis e descontos exclusivos para compras no app.
Confira tudo o que você encontra na Magalu:
Seu lar completo:
Sala: Sofás, poltronas, racks, mesas de centro e muito mais para criar um ambiente relaxante e convidativo para receber amigos e familiares.
Quarto: Camas, colchões, armários, cômodas e mesas de cabeceira para um sono tranquilo e um quarto que seja seu refúgio.
Cozinha: Armários modulares, eletrodomésticos embutidos, mesas e cadeiras para uma cozinha funcional e que te inspire a criar pratos deliciosos.
Banheiro: Armários, pias, gabinetes e acessórios para um banheiro organizado, prático e com um toque de elegância.
Transforme sua casa em um lar dos sonhos com a Magalu!
Esporte e moda online para toda a família:
Complete seu guarda-roupa com roupas femininas, masculinas e infantis das melhores marcas. Encontre looks para todas as situações, do dia a dia a eventos especiais.
E se você busca roupas e artigos esportivos, na Magalu você encontra tudo o que precisa para praticar seu esporte favorito com estilo e alto desempenho. Equipe-se com roupas, tênis, acessórios e equipamentos das melhores marcas do mercado, tudo com preço de Black Friday ;)
Mantenha-se motivado durante seus treinos com celulares, fones de ouvido, smartwatches e outros dispositivos.
Mercado na palma da sua mão, com praticidade e economia:
Faça suas compras de mercado sem sair de casa! #TemNoMagalu alimentos, bebidas, produtos de limpeza e higiene pessoal com os melhores preços. Comprando no Magalu app você recebe suas compras no conforto do seu lar, rapidinho e com praticidade!
Acesse ainda a categoria de eletrodomésticos e eletrônicos e encontre tudo o que precisa para equipar sua cozinha e sua casa. Baixe e faça suas compras online!
Apaixonado por leitura?
Na Magalu, você encontra o livro perfeito para sua próxima aventura literária! Seja um romance emocionante, um suspense envolvente ou um clássico atemporal, temos opções para todos os gostos e idades.
Com opções para todos os gostos e idades, a Magalu garante que você encontre o livro perfeito para sua próxima aventura literária.
Aproveite as promoções do saldão online e renove sua biblioteca com títulos incríveis a preços imperdíveis.
Vantagens exclusivas do app Magalu para você:
Frete grátis em diversas compras: Economize ainda mais em seus pedidos!
Cartão Magalu: Zero anuidade para sempre e 2% de cashback em todas as suas compras online, inclusive na Black Friday.
Descontos e condições exclusivas: Aproveite ofertas especiais para quem compra pelo app.
Pagamentos facilitados: Pague suas compras via PIX, boleto ou divida em até 12x sem juros.
Navegação intuitiva: Encontre os produtos que você procura de forma rápida e fácil.
Compra segura: Tenha a tranquilidade de que suas compras estão seguras com diversas opções de pagamento.
Com a Magalu sua vida é mais fácil, com economia, praticidade e variedade!

bluejetty:00079052:ios.description:
Experience the fun of color therapy with this unique puzzle. Try the newest Color Puzzle game, perfect for relaxation, and enjoy the Wood Hexa Sort. Explore multiple levels in a game designed to relax you.
If you are looking for a game like the classic Water Sort or Ball Sort, Wood Hexa Sort is for you. Join Wood Hexa Sort, an addictive game that offers both challenge and relaxation with the task of sorting colorful hexas. Join in and get your brain fired up with colorful excitement!
Wood Hexa Sort - How to play the puzzle game:
・ Drag and drop to move hexa by simply tapping the same color
・ Only the same color can be moved at a time
・ You can only move a hexa onto another hexa if both hexas are the same color
・ Place hexa of the same color in a single stack
・ Solve logic puzzles with your color matching skills
・ Thousands of challenging color puzzle levels for hours of fun!
Are you bored? Wood Hexa Sort - puzzle game is everything you are looking for!

bluejetty:00064005:ios.description:
Don't settle for basic—try RingTune now and make your ringtone an extension of your personality with our ringtone maker!
A head-turning ringtone maker and striking themes—all in one app. STAND OUT from the crowd with RingTune!
Would you like to instantly know who’s calling? Customize your contacts with a unique ringtone for iPhone and contact posters.
Tired of ear-piercing alarm sounds? Choose one that will put a smile on your face first thing in the morning. Personalize your wake-up experience with our ringtone maker!
Feeling like the novelty of your device is fading? Reignite your iPhone experience by installing one of our eye-catching themes.
Key Ringtone Features:
– Extract audio from your videos to create a ringtone for iPhone.
– Use the ringtone maker tool to сreate a ringtone from your music on iTunes and in the Files app.
– Choose from a vast collection spanning from popular hits to quirky tunes. With our biweekly ringtone updates, you can always discover something new.
– Stay tuned for special holiday updates!
– Know who's calling and show people they’re special: assign a contact-specific ringtone and wallpapers.
– Enjoy recommendations: RingTune will whip up a ringtone compilation based on your taste.
– Browse categories: Top by country, OST, ASMR, Best of TikTok—you name it, it’s there!
– Save and edit your favorite ringtones, alerts, and alarm tones in the My Collection folder.
– Easily trim the best part of any track with the built-in mp3 cutter and turn it into your perfect ringtone.
– Turn your recordings into GarageBand ringtones in minutes—our built-in tutorial will guide you step by step.
Key Wallpaper Features:
– Depth Effect wallpapers: bring movement to your screen with our mesmerizing wallpapers with parallax effect.
– Vast gallery of striking themes with icons, widgets, and wallpapers for a total makeover
– Home Screen widgets with calendars, quotes, and stylish backgrounds—choose the one that suits your mood! 
– Categories for easy navigation
– Hypnotic battery charging animations
– Special holiday content updates
– Contact posters: share your unique look with contacts.
Discover a world of possibilities with our ringtone maker! Create a ringtone for iPhone or extract it from videos, freshen up your screen with wallpapers or widgets, and ensure each call is distinctive by setting contact posters. It's the perfect place to find custom notification sounds and ringtones for iPad as well.
RingTune fully supports iPhone SE and all iPhone 13 and 14 models.
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
– Subscription unlocks access to all the app’s features.
– Billed weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually based on the selected plan.
– Subscription with a free trial will be automatically renewed to a paid subscription.
– Payment will be charged by Apple at confirmation of purchase.
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings.
– Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://on5mobile.com/ringtonesfree/privacy/
Terms of Use: http://on5mobile.com/ringtonesfree/terms/

bluejetty:00178630:ios.description:
Avec l’application Le Figaro Sport, retrouvez 
> Le meilleur du sport en gratuit
> Football, rugby, tennis… Toute l’actualité sportive
> Les résultats en direct
> Les grandes rencontres racontées en live, minute après minute, par nos journalistes
> Les chiffres et les résumés des matchs de Ligue 1, en story, dès la fin de la rencontre
> Les statistiques-clés en infographies animées
> Le meilleur du foot et de ses légendes en vidéo
Suivez la Ligue 1, les plus beaux tournois de tennis, le tournoi des Six Nations, les championnats du monde de ski, le Top 14 ou encore notre sélection golf et F1 avec la rédaction. Découvrez les dernières infos du mercato, de Paris à Marseille.
En 2022-2023, nous vous emmenons suivre les grands événements sportifs, du Tour de France à la Coupe du Monde de football ou de l’US Open, ainsi que la préparation de la Coupe du Monde de rugby 2023 et des Jeux olympiques 2024 à Paris.
Bien sûr, les interviews, les analyses, les avis de la rédaction sont à lire toute l’année dans l’application Le Figaro Sport. 
■ Activez vos alertes personnalisées
- L’évolution des scores en temps réel, à la demande, avec nos alertes instantanées
- Les notifications des évènements majeurs.
- Personnalisez vos alertes en choisissant les sujets et auteurs qui vous passionnent.
■ Rassemblez vos favoris
Enregistrez vos articles pour les lire plus tard, et les retrouver même sans connexion.
■ Bénéficiez du meilleur confort de lecture: le mode sombre de votre téléphone vous suit dans l’application.
Rejoignez la conversation :
https://twitter.com/Sport24Team
https://www.facebook.com/sport24fr

Vous pouvez nous contacter à tout moment pour toute question ou remarque à l'adresse suivante: mobilite@lefigaro.fr
Actualités, jeux, cuisine, sport, télé... Découvrez toutes les applications du Figaro: https://applications-mobiles.lefigaro.fr/

bluejetty:00088938:ios.description:
Take control of your heart health with Smart Blood Pressure Monitor, the all-in-one app that helps you track key health metrics and make informed lifestyle choices. Whether you’re managing blood pressure, blood sugar, or focused on weight loss, Smart Blood Pressure Monitor provides actionable insights, personalized wellness tips, and heart-healthy recipes to support your goals. Designed for anyone committed to better living, Smart Blood Pressure Monitor is your trusted health companion.
Why Smart Blood Pressure Monitor?
• Easy Tracking: Monitor your blood pressure, blood sugar, weight, and BMI in one place.
• Stay Organized: Get reminders for medications, weight updates, and health checks.
• Family Health Management: Manage multiple accounts to track health data for family members.
• Insightful Reports: View trends with detailed charts and shareable reports for your doctor.
• Wellness Tips: Receive personalized nutrition, exercise, and health advice for optimal heart health.
Smart Nutrition & Wellness Support
Smart Blood Pressure Monitor also offers expert-recommended meal plans and recipes:
• Blood Sugar Control: Low-carb, diabetic-friendly recipes to help manage sugar levels.
• Weight Loss: Calorie-smart meals that support your goals without sacrificing flavor.
• Heart Health: Recipes rich in fiber, lean protein, and omega-3s for long-term heart wellness.
Features Users Love:
• Real-Time Insights: Know your health numbers and what they mean.
• Medication Reminders: Stay on track with customizable pill reminders.
• Family Account Management: Easily manage health data for yourself and your loved ones.
• Holistic Health: From blood pressure tracking to diet and fitness suggestions.
• Comprehensive Logs: Maintain a full history of your health records, all in one app.
Disclaimer:
Smart Blood Pressure Monitor is for tracking health metrics and wellness purposes only. It’s not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for medical concerns.
Smart Blood Pressure Monitor makes staying healthy simple and achievable. Join thousands of users and start your wellness journey with confidence today. Download Smart Blood Pressure Monitor now!

bluejetty:00120764:ios.description:
The 3D Salah Guide app is your ultimate, interactive tool to learn and perfect your prayer (Salah) with precision and ease. Whether you're a beginner or looking to enhance your practice, this app provides step-by-step, 3D visualizations of every Salah movement, ensuring you understand the correct posture, actions, and recitations.
Key Features:
Interactive 3D Visuals: Explore detailed 3D models that demonstrate each step of the Salah prayer, from the opening Takbir to the final Tasleem. Rotate, zoom, and view the movements from all angles to gain a clear understanding.
Detailed Step-by-Step Instructions: Learn the correct sequence of actions, from the standing position to prostration, with easy-to-follow text and voice instructions in multiple languages.
Audio Guidance: Listen to clear, high-quality recitations of all prayer positions and supplications, helping you master pronunciation and memorization.
Real-Time Prayer Mode: Follow along with a real-time prayer mode that guides you through each step of the Salah in sync with your actions.
Customizable Settings: Choose your preferred language, voice, and display options to tailor your learning experience.
Prayer Time Notifications: Get timely reminders for your daily prayers, ensuring you never miss a Salah.
Learn at Your Own Pace: Whether you want to practice one movement at a time or follow along with a complete prayer, the app allows you to progress at your own speed.
Perfect for Muslims of all ages, the 3D Salah Guide app empowers you to strengthen your connection with Allah through a deeper understanding of Salah. Download now and take your prayer experience to the next level!

bluejetty:00147230:ios.description:
Lolo is an easy food tracker. Just tell Lolo what you eat in plain text and it will track your food and keep your calories in check. No more complicated drop-down lists and food databases. Just an easy chat helping you get in shape.
Lolo is flexible, it can follow your special diet: fitness, diabetes, pregnancy or another condition. Just inform Lolo about your special requirements when setting up the profile.
LOLO FOODBOT SUBSCRIPTION WITH A FREE TRIAL
Access to the Lolo FoodBot app is offered on a subscription basis. In order to use the app's services, you will need to subscribe to any of the available plans.
Lolo FoodBot App Subscription offers

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
* If you choose to subscribe, the payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
* Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the same price.
* You can manage your subscription at any time and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings.
* Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases an LChat subscription.
Terms of service
https://foodbot.lolohere.com/storage/LoloFoodBotTerms.pdf
Privacy Policy
https://foodbot.lolohere.com/storage/LoloFoodBotPrivacy.pdf
DIETARY GUIDELINES
Our application, Lolo, utilizes various elements, including body metrics, gender, and lifestyle factors, to provide an accurate estimation of your daily caloric and nutrient needs. These calculations are based on models referenced from reputable health and nutritional organizations.
For calorie calculations, we use the Mifflin-St Jeor Equation, which has been determined as the most reliable by the American Dietetic Association. You can find more about it here: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/bwp
For nutrient targets, we adhere to the guidelines established by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and the U.S. Department of Agriculture. These guidelines provide comprehensive recommendations for an overall healthy diet, offering proportions for macronutrients, vitamins, and minerals. Get more information here: https://www.dietaryguidelines.gov 
Please note that the calculations provided by our app are estimations and should not replace advice from healthcare providers or certified nutritionists. Always consult a health professional for advice tailored to your specific needs

- Ice cream Fitness

bluejetty:00073876:ios.description:
Maize is your key to the front door of the farm-to-table food scene. Now, when you find the table, you can also find the farm and everything behind it.
Whether you follow a carnivore diet, paleo diet, Whole30, keto, or vegan lifestyle—or simply want to eat clean—Maize helps you discover the most nutritious, healthy, and fresh food across the U.S. We feature verified regenerative producers, transparent sourcing, and nutrient-dense ingredients from local food systems rooted in sustainability and trust.
Explore whole foods from trusted farms and small producers, including grass-fed, pasture-raised meat and dairy, organic produce, sourdough, and more. From White Oak Pastures in Georgia to Forage Kitchen in Wisconsin, Maize connects you to the best of local and sustainable food.
Our mission is to help foodies, locavores, and everyone in between embrace healthy regional cuisine through authentic farm-to-table experiences. We provide one simple app to explore farm-to-table restaurants, markets, coffee shops, co-ops, farm stands, CSAs, and more—all aligned with sustainable farming practices and transparency.
Maize is more than a directory—it’s a lifestyle tool for those who care about regenerative agriculture, real ingredients, and supporting local food systems. Whether you’re a seasoned carnivore or just exploring the GoCarnivore lifestyle, Maize helps you find what’s fresh and real.
FREE FEATURES:
- Discover local food and drink nearby or search in any U.S. city with limited results.
- Use our interactive map to visualize where to eat, shop, and support.
- Scan Maize touchpoints at businesses to see sourcing details and verified origins.
- Search with autocomplete for detailed results across food and product categories.
- Filter by business type, from restaurant to grocery store to farm stand.
- View rich business profiles that list local food sourcing and sustainability practices.
- Access hours, directions, and quick links to websites, menus, or online ordering.
- Look for Maize badges verifying regenerative practices and transparency.
- Save and revisit your favorite farm-to-table spots and local markets.
LOCAVORE FEATURES (In-App Subscription Required):
- Full access to 2,000+ verified local food businesses and products nationwide.
- Expand your search radius and explore by category: Eat, Shop, Drink, or Producer.
- Browse the new “Maize Table” feed to share and discover local food creations.
- Tag local farms, creameries, butchers, or CSAs in your posts and track your impact.
- Use the “Where to Find” list to locate specific local food products and producers.
- Check in at businesses and leave helpful tips for other users.
- Become a top patron at your favorite local spots based on activity.
- View your full profile with activity stats, most visited farms, recent check-ins, and display name.
- Customize your profile with a photo and share your local food journey.
FEATURED BUSINESS TYPES:
Farm, Producer, Creamery, Restaurant, Café, Bakery, Grocery Store, Co-op, Farmers Market, Farm Stand, Food Cart, Coffee Shop, Brewery, Winery, Cidery, Butcher Shop, CSA
OUR MISSION & IMPACT:
Maize simplifies access to nutritious, clean, and ethically sourced food—built to support sustainable communities and regenerative ecosystems. We know food labels can’t tell the full story. That’s why Maize helps you find real transparency, local flavor, and food that fuels your body and supports your values.
We make it easy to eat healthy, gain energy, and live well by connecting people to pasture-raised beef, carnivore-friendly foods, paleo staples, and local produce—all grown with care and intention. Maize is built around the belief that healthy food starts with healthy soil—and we invite you to explore, support, and co-create the future of food with us.
Privacy Policy:
https://maize.app/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Maize-Privacy-Policy-2.0.pdf
Terms & Conditions:
https://maize.app/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Maize-Terms-Conditions-2.0.pdf
