bluejetty:00075482:ios.name: Piraeus app
bluejetty:00075482:ios.summary: Piraeus app offers a modern everyday banking experience, with simplified navigation and quick access to the features you use most. Designed to help you manage your finances easily and securely, it allows you to initiate and complete your da
bluejetty:00075482:ios.description:
Piraeus app offers a modern everyday banking experience, with simplified navigation and quick access to the features you use most. Designed to help you manage your finances easily and securely, it allows you to initiate and complete your daily transactions in fewer steps.
For users with devices running iOS 26 or later versions, the app supports the new liquid glass design, delivering an even more modern and engaging user experience.
From the home screen, you can access key banking features through smart shortcuts (Quick Actions), while the new central Hub enables easy navigation across all sections of the app. In addition, the new “+” button provides fast access to frequently used actions, such as transfers, payments and bill settlements, directly from the home screen.
Your transaction history is now consolidated and available through “Recent activity – View All”, “See all Activities”, or “Transactions” under the “More” shortcut on the home screen. Scheduled transactions are also available within the Transfers and Payments sections.
The “Piraeus in the spotlight” section presents personalized suggestions designed to enhance your banking experience, while “Our stories” features short articles on topics of general interest.
Accounts & Time Deposits
Through the Menu and the “Accounts & Time Deposits” section, you can view your account balances and detailed transaction activity for each account. You can also open a new account or create a new time deposit directly through the app or add a beneficiary.
Cards
Through the Menu and the “Cards” section, you can manage your debit, credit and prepaid cards. You can view balances and transactions, make card payments, temporarily block cards, issue new cards, manage spending limits and access additional card management features.
Loans
Through the Menu and the "Loans" section, you can view information about your loan products and apply for an e-loan. 
Insurance
Through the Menu and the “Insurance” section you can view information about your insurance products and purchase new ones. 
Investments
Through the Menu and the “Investments” section, you can view information about your investment products and purchase new ones. 
Security Management
-Set up security features for Quick login (4-digit PIN or biometric authentication for compatible devices).
-By activating the app’s notifications, the extraPIN code is automatically received and submitted by your device when authentication is required for your mobile app transactions. You simply confirm the transaction using your quick login, saving time with increased security.
For any further information, or assistance in your banking experience, you can contact us through: supportebanking@piraeusbank.gr. Alternatively, you can use the contact form available in your Profile.
The service is provided under the current restrictions on capital transfers.

bluejetty:00121163:ios.description:
Device System Service – System Information & Performance Monitoring
Device System Service is a professional iOS application that provides detailed insights into your device’s hardware, network, memory, and storage. The app helps you monitor system performance, optimize resource usage, and ensure smooth operation.
 Key Features
Hardware Information
 • Detailed specifications of your device’s model, processor, and GPU
 • Battery level and status monitoring
 • Biometric authentication support (Face ID, Touch ID)
 • Display size, brightness, and other screen-related details
 Network Status
 • IP address, Wi-Fi, and mobile network information
 • Internet connection check and speed data
 • Ping hosts or IP addresses to verify connectivity and response time
 • Local network insights and diagnostics
Memory Usage
 • Detailed breakdown of memory usage (used, active, inactive, free memory)
 • Real-time memory monitoring with interactive charts
 • Performance tracking and optimization suggestions
Tools
The new Tools tab provides powerful built-in diagnostic utilities for advanced network analysis.
 • Ping
Verify connectivity to any host or IP address and check network responsiveness in real time.
Ideal for troubleshooting reachability and latency issues.
 • LAN Scan
Discover active devices connected to your local network.
Quickly identify IP addresses and detect available hosts within your subnet.
 • Port Scan
Scan open TCP ports on a target device to analyze running services and network exposure.
Useful for diagnostics, testing, and infrastructure validation.
Storage Management
 • Total storage and available space display
 • Breakdown of space occupied by files and apps
 • Visual representation of disk usage with modern UI elements
 Settings & Privacy
 • Remove Ads – One-time purchase for a completely ad-free experience
 • Manage Consent – GDPR/CCPA compliance options
 • Ad Personalization – Customize ad preferences based on privacy policies
Modern & User-Friendly Experience
 • Dark Mode support for a comfortable viewing experience
 • Interactive visual elements, graphs, and bars for easy interpretation
 • Optimized for both iPhone and iPad
System Service Widgets – Overview
The System Service app is designed for iOS system monitoring and now features three useful widgets that display key system information in real-time.
Available Widgets:
Device Information Widget
 Displayed Data:
 • Device name
 • Battery level
 • iOS version
 • Local (LAN) and external (WAN) IP addresses
 Usage:
This widget provides a quick overview of your device, making it especially useful for developers, network administrators, and power users.
Disk Usage Widget
 Displayed Data:
 • Disk usage percentage (circular progress bar)
 • Used storage amount (GB)
 • Total storage capacity (GB)
Usage:
This widget allows you to instantly check how much storage is available on your device. It’s particularly useful when managing large files or installing new applications.
Memory Usage Widget
 Displayed Data:
 • Memory usage percentage (circular progress bar)
 • Used memory amount (GB)
 • Total memory capacity (GB)
Usage:
A great tool for monitoring background app memory usage, helping optimize device performance.
How to Add the Widget?
1. Long-press the home screen.
2. Tap the ”+” icon in the top-left corner.
3. Scroll down to the System Service widgets.
4. Select your preferred widget size.
5. Tap “Add Widget.”
Why Use It?
• Provides quick system data access
• Helps optimize storage and memory usage
• Easily accessible—no need to open an extra app
Download and try it now!

bluejetty:00136856:ios.description:
Reimagine storytelling with Storytime AI – now with enhanced read-along video capabilities, perfect for kids and children! Our innovative educational app not only lets you create AI-powered personalized kids books but also enables you to bring these stories to life through engaging AI videos. With Airplay, effortlessly stream these educational videos to your TV, offering hours of guilt-free, educational screen time for children in a curated playlist fashion. 
Empower your children to embark on a literary journey like no other. Input your details, and watch as our AI weaves them into beautifully illustrated children's books and read-along-videos that foster a love of reading for your children. Read books on your own, or use our read-to-me narration. Convert these creations into interactive read-along kids videos, providing an educational and entertaining experience for young minds, fostering a love for reading.
But that's not all. Dive into our Discover page, which grants free access to an ever-growing digital library full of AI books and AI videos for kids. This treasure trove of narratives, with global representation from many languages, invites you to remix content with your own personalized characters, plot, setting, theme, or image style. Additionally, include keywords to use the app as a vocabulary building educational tool. With Storytime AI, explore stories that promote cultural and social learning while sparking a love of reading in children.
Storytime AI is a premier example of responsible AI use, serving as an educational tool for parents, educators, and storytellers. Start your adventure with a complimentary book credit and see where your imagination takes you in the world of AI Books and AI Videos. Should you crave more, our Premium subscription unlocks a realm of advanced features and customization options for both books and videos. Plus, our referral program offers additional free credits and trial access for friends.
Every story crafted in Storytime AI is an adventure waiting to be discovered. Ignite your child's imagination, foster educational growth, and experience the world of AI-powered storytelling like never before.
Storytime AI app is fully localized in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, and Dutch. Additionally, you can create books and videos in the following languages: Hindi, Italian, Dutch, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Catalan, Russian, Icelandic, Romanian, Welsh.

Welcome to Lupio!
Here, we open a door to a world of infinite creativity and fun. Whether you're looking for a source of inspiration or simply want to unwind, Lupio offers you a vibrant array of experiences. Let's enjoy this lively journey together and explore more possibilities!
Lupio – Pet Travel Social Platform
Discover pet‑friendly journeys and connect with pet travel lovers worldwide!
Lupio is a community built for people who travel with pets. Share your on‑the‑road moments, find pet‑friendly hotels and activities, learn tips from experienced owners, and make friends who love traveling with their furry companions.
Key Features:
Pet Moments: Capture and share trips with photos and videos
Community Interaction: Follow, like, comment, and build friendships
Travel Exchange: Discover itineraries, tips, and pet‑friendly guides
Topic Discussions: Join themed threads and Q&A
Pet‑Friendly Hotels: Browse cards and detail pages quickly
Personal Profile: Showcase journeys, achievements, and badges
Private Messaging: Chat with friends and event organizers
Highlights:
Clean, elegant UI with smooth interactions
Rich, practical content for planning pet trips
Safe social environment with moderation
Multiple media formats supported
Smart surfacing of interesting content
Age Rating: 12+
Whether you are a seasoned pet traveler or planning your first trip, Lupio offers a welcoming community to explore the world with your pets.

bluejetty:00067689:android.name: Turnip - Talk to friends
bluejetty:00067689:android.summary: Turnip, a place to connect with friends, followers and join communities you like. Create your own community groups for friends, family and followers. Talk with them over voice chat, share large photos and videos, host watch parties. Turnip
bluejetty:00067689:android.description:
Turnip, a place to connect with friends, followers and join communities you like. Create your own community groups for friends, family and followers. Talk with them over voice chat, share large photos and videos, host watch parties. Turnip lets you attend, listen & participate in live events and contests of your interest about your favourite books, movies, video games, sports, TV shows, music, technology & win prizes.
Be close to the people you love. With Turnip you can hangout, stay in touch with your friends and followers.
Host watch party - Enjoy hosting & participating in watch parties to watch movies, music, YouTube videos together.
Talk on voice call - With voice chat feature you can invite and talk with more than 16 people at once and works on weakest network connections with low latency. Join on a group voice call with your friends whether gaming or to speak casually.
Share moments - Send text messages, photos, videos, music, stickers, and GIFs, files, documents with your friends on the group chat to share interesting and fun moments. Upload and download large files, photos, videos upto 2GB and share with other people in the community.
Follow communities of your interest
Explore your interests and join any community; whether your interests range in Youtube, celebrities, finance, music, sports, gaming or your own school or college club, you can follow & talk directly with influencers and like-minded people.
Participate in live events and contests
Participate in events and contests, talk to similar minded people over text chat messages and voice call from the comfort of your home. Join anime discussions, sports opinions, pop culture debates, share your music, stories or perform comedy in open mic nights. Win cash prizes and giveaways by participating in contests.
Attend fan-events, talk-shows and radio sessions
Join live event rooms ranging from fun events, to meetups with your favourite influencers. Meet, talk and chat with your favourite youtubers, influencers and celebrities. Listen to social radio events covering trending topics, news updates and gossip.
Create communities for your followers
Run communities with audio, chat rooms and interact with fans, viewers, teammates, friends and family.
Talk to your followers with voice chat or chat about the latest youtube video, answer queries, share advice or post daily updates.

Welcome to RP Grand, a world where you write your own story!

Guns and sidearms - get different weapons and sidearms and upgrade them, from shotgun and katana to minigun and chainsaw!
Backpack + Chests - get random equipment and organize it in your backpack.
Merge + Craft - merge items into gold versions and craft them into more powerful items & weapons. Begin with a shotgun and finish with a nanoblade launcher!
Full 3D action and backgrounds - enemies attack from different directions, backgrounds are different and deep, there are diferrent bioms, different daytime and even weather!

Hardcore action - blast zombies into pieces, burn them wih flamethrowers, throw grenades and cut them with lasers. Rockets roar as they accelarate, molotov's burn the ground, minigun bullets ricochet from the walls! It's much better then just throw icons into casual 2D goblins!
So what's up? Embark on an adventure through a land overrun by zombies and aliens. Stand up and fight, heroes!

bluejetty:00167619:ios.summary: From the developers of the highest rated Yoga App, Down Dog, Pilates gives you a brand new workout every time! Unlike following pre-recorded videos, in this low-impact full body mat workout built around exercises that strengthen the core, P
bluejetty:00167619:ios.description:
From the developers of the highest rated Yoga App, Down Dog, Pilates gives you a brand new workout every time! Unlike following pre-recorded videos, in this low-impact full body mat workout built around exercises that strengthen the core, Pilates keeps things fresh and keeps you motivated with endless content and lots of customizable settings so you can build a practice you love.
BEGINNER FRIENDLY
Start in the comfort of your own home at our Beginner 1 Level and begin your pilates journey - no fancy props required!
TARGET, TONE, AND STRENGTHEN
Enjoy increased total body strength and flexibility. Improve balance and posture through exercises that strengthen the core and back. Sculpt gorgeous lean muscle and add definition to your arms, abs, butt, and legs through exercises that isolate and tone. 
CHOOSE VOICES 
Select your favorite instructor and be guided by a voice you love. 
DYNAMIC CHANGING MUSIC
Pick the type of music you love, and we supply beats that support where you are in your pilates routine, whether you're warming up, building heat, or cooling down.
BOOST FEATURE 
Select a primary and a secondary boost to focus your practice on specific muscle groups. Vary up your routine by rotating through them all. 
LIKED AND EXCLUDED POSES 
"Like" poses to increase the probability they will appear in your practice. "Dislike" poses and they will never appear in your practice. 
TRANSITION SPEED
Design a pace that works for you by controlling the amount of time you'll move between one exercise and another.
HOLD LENGTHS AND REPS
Decide whether you'll move quickly through an exercise or stay awhile and feel the burn by varying the length of your static holds and number of reps.
COOLDOWN OPTIONS
Customize whether you'll sweat until the very end or finish off your practice with stretching and relaxation.
MULTIPLE LANGUAGES 
In addition to our English speaking voices, all pilates practices are available in many other languages! 
SYNC BETWEEN DEVICES
Automatically syncs across all your devices.
"This practice was great. The transitions were very clear and I was able to do all the exercises with just a little bit of difficulty. What I really liked was that the instructor gave instructions in detail like when to squeeze the abs and when to imagine a wall behind you when you're standing. I found that really helpful." - Mara
"Omg I LOVED IT! I do Pilates all the time (weekly) at home. This was the best session I’ve taken maybe ever! You guys did it again! Great job DDApp" - Molly
Integrates with the Apple Health app!
Down Dog's terms and conditions can be found at https://www.downdogapp.com/terms
Down Dog's privacy policy can be found at https://www.downdogapp.com/privacy

bluejetty:00155221:ios.description:
Start your day off on the right foot with Unbed. Say goodbye to snooze buttons and procrastinating in bed. Wake up feeling refreshed and productive so you can achieve more in your mornings and especially in your day.
• Turn your alarm off by tapping your phone on your Unbed block to ensure that you get out of bed in the morning. Say goodbye to mornings wasted in bed and achieve more.
• Perfect for heavy sleepers, as your phone will ring and vibrate until you turn off your alarm only by tapping your phone on your Unbed block.
• Create habits for your bedtime and morning routines. Every evening you will get a notification for your bedtime to remind you to schedule your alarm for the next day. Creating a bedtime habit of going to sleep at the right time, while also making sure that you don't sleep longer than needed in the morning and start your day off on the right foot.
• Recommended for:
- Those who tried multiple ways of fixing their sleep schedule but remain unsuccessful
- Those who want to have a solid bedtime and morning routine for better sleep
- Those who want to achieve more during their days
- Those who don't want to waste their time in bed anymore
In order to use this app, you must have an Unbed block. You can purchase yours here: https://unbedapp.com
The Unbed block is a device that is needed for this app, as you schedule and stop your alarms from ringing by tapping the Unbed block.
Your privacy is very important for us and because of this, we do not track any of your usage on our app. For more information, you can visit our Privacy Policy: https://unbedapp.com/policies/privacy

bluejetty:00157769:ios.description:
Struggling with erectile dysfunction, low libido, or control? Sequoia helps 79% of men feel better in just 21 days - naturally, with a science-based 21-day plan. Start for free. No awkward clinics, no meds. 
Take control of your sexual health with Sequoia - the all-in-one app to improve erections, stamina, libido, and overall intimate wellness. Whether you're facing erectile dysfunction (ED), premature ejaculation (PE), or simply want more energy in bed, Sequoia is here to help.
Built by doctors. Powered by science. Used by over 50,000 men.
Trusted Worldwide
• Partner of the United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) in reproductive health
• Member of the World Association for Sexual Health (WAS)
• Partner of the University of Rome Tor Vergata
• Partner of the Invitro medical laboratory
• Partner of the Meta Clinic
Why Sequoia Works
SCIENCE-BASED HEALTH TEST
Understand your body and performance better with the IIEF - the gold-standard test in male sexual health. Get instant, personalized insights.
21-DAY PERSONALIZED IMPROVEMENT PLAN
Follow a structured, medically-backed routine to improve erections, boost sexual stamina, increase testosterone, and enhance control — no pills, no side effects.
KEGEL WORKOUTS FOR MEN
Strengthen your pelvic floor to improve erection quality, orgasm intensity, and endurance. Fully guided and proven by research.
EDUCATION & DAILY ARTICLES
Learn from doctors and sexual health experts. Topics include libido, testosterone, ejaculation, performance anxiety, relationships, and LGBTQ+ well-being.
TRACKING & INSIGHTS
Log symptoms, energy, erections, mood, and over 80 other factors. Spot trends and track your growth week by week.
DAILY CALENDAR & STREAKS
Visualize progress. Build healthy routines with reminders and a motivational calendar designed to keep you going.
AGE-SPECIFIC CHECK-UPS
Stay ahead of common issues with health screening guidelines tailored to your age - including prostate, hormone levels, and more.
PRIVATE ONLINE CONSULTATIONS
Have questions or concerns? Chat discreetly with certified doctors - no appointments, no waiting rooms.
MONTHLY REPORTS
See clear, visual reports of how your sexual health and habits are improving over time.
SMART REMINDERS
Never skip a session. Sequoia keeps you consistent with subtle nudges designed to build lasting habits.
Start Free - No Credit Card Required
Get your personalized plan instantly. Explore workouts, articles, and tools — and see results before you commit to anything.
Sequoia is for men of all ages — from 18 to 70+ — who want to optimize their performance and confidence discreetly, safely, and effectively. No spam. No shame. Just results.
Download Sequoia and start transforming your sexual health today.
DISCLAIMER: Sequoia is not a diagnostic tool or substitute for medical care. If you experience urgent symptoms, consult your healthcare provider immediately.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Sequoia offers optional subscription plans that unlock full access to exercises, content, and tracking tools.
• Payment charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation.
• Auto-renews unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage your subscription in iTunes account settings.
• Unused trial time is forfeited upon subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://sequoia.health/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sequoia.health/terms-of-use

The Garden magazine is the most-read gardening magazine in the UK.
Every month, over 600,000 RHS Members rely on The Garden to provide them with gardening advice, inspiration and news. Now The Garden is available digitally for the first time on The Garden app.
This app includes a daily selection of the best of the RHS including the weekly Gardening With The RHS podcast, information about RHS Shows and RHS Gardens and a full monthly version of The Garden.

Not an RHS Member? Install the app and enjoy the best of the RHS, including the weekly Gardening With The RHS podcast.
App highlights:
- The latest RHS advice on anything from pruning to seed sowing via houseplant watering.
- Gardening inspiration from inside and outside the RHS, including RHS Gardens.
- News about anything from RHS Shows to our groundbreaking work in horticultural science.
- The Gardening With The RHS podcast
- Highlights from the monthly magazine.
- For existing RHS Members: The Garden monthly magazine.
App features:
- Daily updates from the RHS.
- The Garden monthly magazine available on the 22nd of every month.
Full terms of use can be found at https://www.rhs.org.uk/membership/membership-terms-conditions
Our privacy policy can be found at https://www.rhs.org.uk/privacy

bluejetty:00081087:ios.description:
With MyView, customize zone(s) settings to receive timely alerts and avoid getting stuck outside during inclement weather. Plus, manage and share access with other caregivers.
Key Features
View a real-time, map-based locator:
See the real-time location of your child’s school bus based on your customized Alert Zone. Receive email or push notification alerts when the bus is approaching an Alert Zones and when bus arrives or departs from the school.
Streamline parent and district communication:
Through the MyView application, districts can send messages to parents regarding substitutions, delays, closures, etc. 
Share and manage access with other caregivers:
Invite other caregivers to receive alerts. Manage their access to specific days, child and bus route.
Protect their Privacy:
To access MyView, parents and caregivers need a unique access code from the school district. They must also know their student’s private ID number. 
Know when there is a bus substitution:
If the school districts make a bus substitution, MyView will automatically update with those changes.

bluejetty:00175182:ios.name: JusTalk Kids - Safe Messenger
bluejetty:00175182:ios.summary: JusTalk Kids is a kid-friendly voice and video calling and instant messaging app designed to keep children safely connected with family, friends, and classmates. All communications are encrypted to ensure privacy and protection from strange
bluejetty:00175182:ios.description:
JusTalk Kids is a kid-friendly voice and video calling and instant messaging app designed to keep children safely connected with family, friends, and classmates. All communications are encrypted to ensure privacy and protection from strangers or inappropriate content.
Beyond chat and calls, JusTalk Kids offers fun, creative tools like educational videos, a doodle board, and a text editor to encourage imagination and learning — all in a safe digital space.
Key Features
• Parent-Approved Friend Management
Children can only add friends with parental approval. Parents receive instant notifications for all friend requests and can easily approve or reject them — ensuring kids only connect with trusted contacts.
• Safe Voice & Video Calling
JusTalk Kids supports high-quality 1-on-1 and group voice/video calls with features like call recording, real-time doodling, live effects, and interactive games — making conversations fun and meaningful, even at a distance. Center Stage helps keep kids naturally centered during video calls, making family chats and group calls feel more focused.
• Dual Capture Video Calls
Kids can show themselves and the world around them at the same time with Dual Capture. Share drawings, toys, activities, and special moments with family and friends to make video calls more fun and engaging.
• Video Call Effects
Make video calls more fun and expressive with creative backgrounds, filters, and playful appearance effects. Kids can blur or transform their surroundings and add face effects such as glasses, hats, animal ears, and more. Save a preferred effect for future video calls.
• Stories
Stories offers fun picture books with audio narration, making story time more engaging for kids and families. Kids can enjoy standalone stories and serialized book series, build vocabulary, spark imagination, and develop reading habits through educational, family-friendly content.
• Sticker Store & Custom Stickers
Kids can discover fun sticker packs in the Sticker Store or add custom stickers to make their chats more expressive and personal.
• Group Polls
When kids, family, or friends need to choose a time, activity, or plan together, polls help everyone share opinions and decide quickly in group chats.
• Walkie Talkie (Push-to-Talk)
Send quick voice messages instantly by pressing and holding — no call needed. A fun, hands-free way for kids to stay in touch with friends and family.
• Smart Content Monitoring
Sensitive images or videos are automatically flagged and blocked. Parents are notified and can review the content to decide what’s appropriate, helping children safely navigate online communication.
• JusTalk Parent Account
Manage your child’s app remotely: approve friends, monitor activity, and customize settings — all from your own JusTalk app.
• Creative Messaging & Sharing
Kids can send text, photos, voice messages, GIFs, drawings, stickers, files, and more. They can also share life moments by posting creations like art, stories, and music — all within a safe, closed environment.
• Educational Content on Kidstube
Explore a growing library of kid-friendly videos including science experiments, crafts, and learning activities — curated to spark curiosity in a safe, ad-free space.
• Full Privacy & Data Protection
Every message and call is encrypted. JusTalk Kids never shares your child’s personal data and gives parents full control over app access and content exposure.
Terms of Service: https://kids.justalk.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://kids.justalk.com/privacy.html
We’d love to hear from you! Contact us at: kids@justalk.com
*Data charges may apply. Please check with your mobile provider.

bluejetty:00175583:ios.description:
Experience Deep Sleep with ZenTones
Experience the perfect blend of nature's tranquility and soothing ambient sounds with ZenTones, the all-in-one green noise app designed to help you achieve deep and restful sleep.
Immerse yourself in a symphony of calming sounds, including green, white, brown, and pink noise, carefully crafted to create a serene environment that lulls you into a peaceful slumber.
Color Noise Collection to Sharpen Your Focus & Wake up Fresher
Green Noise - Escape to lush forests, tranquil meadows, and gentle rain showers as you unwind with the harmonious melodies of nature. Let the soothing sounds of rustling leaves and flowing streams transport you to a state of blissful relaxation.
White Noise - Offers consistent sounds such as a hair dryer, airplane, clothes dryer, vacuum, and fan noise for relaxation or focus. Drown out distracting noises and create a peaceful ambiance with gentle white noise. Perfect for masking disruptive sounds, it helps you focus, concentrate, and find solace in moments of tranquility.
Brown Noise - Dive into deep relaxation with the enveloping and warm tones of brown noise. This rich, low-frequency sound helps create a cocoon of calmness, promoting a serene atmosphere for unwinding after a long day.
Pink Noise - Experience the delicate balance between white and brown noise with the soft, gentle whispers of pink noise. Its evenly distributed frequencies provide a soothing backdrop that helps you achieve a deeper and more refreshing sleep.
Ambient Sounds: Enjoy the soothing sounds of wind, rustling leaves, birdsong, and the comforting crackle of a fire. Ideal for creating a peaceful background during rest or reflection.
Water Sounds: Relax to the calming audio of rainstorms, ocean waves, gentle waves, and the soft splash of lapping water. A proven remedy to help with insomnia and restless nights.
Isochronic Tones: Tap into brainwave entrainment with isochronic tones available at 2.5Hz, 4Hz, 5Hz, 8Hz, 10Hz, and 20Hz—engineered to enhance focus, meditation, and deep rest.
Binaural Beats: Includes precisely tuned frequencies such as 2.5Hz, 4Hz, 5Hz, 8Hz, 10Hz, and 20Hz—ideal for brainwave syncing, deep meditation, and relaxation sessions.
Solfeggio Frequencies: Unlock the benefits of healing and balancing tones at 174Hz, 285Hz, 396Hz, 417Hz, 432Hz, and 528Hz. Each frequency is known for its unique wellness properties.
Nature Sounds: Immerse yourself in natural audio like beach sounds, campfire sounds, night sounds, ocean sounds, rainforest, and thunderstorm sounds. These timeless classics bring nature to your ears, anytime you need calm.
Features
 .
Timer That Fits Your Night: Choose how long you want the sound to play—whether it’s for a 20-minute nap or through the entire night. The timer takes care of the rest so you can relax without thinking about when to stop it.
Build Your Own Sleep Mixes: Save your favorite sound combos or try our Smart Mix feature for automatically blended playlists. Everything plays seamlessly, without any distracting loops or sudden breaks—just smooth, calming audio all the way through.
Support for ADHD & Focus Issues: Struggling to concentrate during the day or settle your mind at night? Our specially tuned frequencies are made to help users with ADHD stay grounded and focused.

Refer to our privacy policy for any other issues - https://wonkru.co/app-privacy/
Refer to our terms of service for any other issues - https://wonkru.co/terms/
Please note:
For using the premium features, a valid in-app purchase is necessary. The payment will be charged to your iTunes account once you confirm the subscription. The subscription gets automatically renewed. However, you can manage the auto-renewal option by using the account settings after making a purchase.

bluejetty:00131846:ios.summary:
Defter Notes is loved by academics, students, teachers, researchers, journal keepers, knowledge workers, designers, architects, engineers, writers, and anyone who thinks best with their hands and eyes. 
It’s built for people who see ideas
bluejetty:00131846:ios.description:
Defter Notes is loved by academics, students, teachers, researchers, journal keepers, knowledge workers, designers, architects, engineers, writers, and anyone who thinks best with their hands and eyes. 
It’s built for people who see ideas as living things: connected, evolving, and worth exploring.
Think without boundaries
Defter Notes gives you an infinite canvas for spatial thinking. Drop ideas anywhere. Draw connections. Expand as far as your thoughts take you. Enjoy pure creative flow.
Capture ideas your way
Whether it starts as a quick sketch, a handwritten note, or a PDF you’re diving into, Defter Notes adapts to your process. Write, draw, or type; then move, link, and layer it all together. Your ideas stay flexible and alive.
Work the way your brain works
Move items freely. Zoom in and out of context. Build hierarchies of Spaces that let you go deeper into your projects. Defter Notes stays out of the way so your focus stays on thinking.
Top features
* Stacks for deep work: Ideal for reading, studying, or comparing multiple resources.
* Deft movement with gestures: Drag pages or extract text directly out of PDFs.
* Cross-reference and multitask: View, resize, and reorder documents side by side.
* Handwriting and text tools: Combine pen, pencil, marker, and text boxes using Apple Pencil or Scribble.
* Fluid editing: Double-tap any item to edit or share.
* Intuitive navigation: Use the mini-map, navigation bar, gestures, and select tool to move effortlessly through infinite spaces.
* Supports links and files: Drop in PDFs, images, URLs, and attachments right onto your canvas.
Join the community: https://discord.com/invite/GjS5tJSmBW

Privacy policy: https://www.defternotes.com/touprivacypolicy

bluejetty:00162042:ios.name: SilentBoy Prison Escape Sim 3D
bluejetty:00162042:ios.summary:
SilentBoy Prison Escape Sim 3D is a deep, story driven prison escape game built around survival, stealth, and difficult choices. You do not play as a hero. You play as a child forced into a system that does not care if you live or die.
You
bluejetty:00162042:ios.description:
SilentBoy Prison Escape Sim 3D is a deep, story driven prison escape game built around survival, stealth, and difficult choices. You do not play as a hero. You play as a child forced into a system that does not care if you live or die.
You are a young boy abandoned by his parents and sent into a harsh prison environment. You enter with nothing. No power. No protection. The prison tests you from the first step. Every mistake has consequences. Every sound can expose you. Every wrong decision can end your escape.
This is not a fast action game. This is a thinking game. You must observe your surroundings and plan each move. Guards follow strict patrol routes. Prisoners watch your behavior. Some want to harm you. Some want to use you. Some are victims like you.
The prison is divided into dangerous sections controlled by old and violent inmates. These prisoners rule with fear. Some attack on sight. Some block important paths. Others offer help but only if you prove yourself. Trust is risky. Choosing the wrong ally can trap you forever.
Stealth is your main tool. Running makes noise. Noise attracts guards. Guards react fast and punish hard. You must move slowly. Hide in shadows. Time your steps. Watch patterns. Learn when to move and when to wait.
Your progress depends on careful exploration. Keys are hidden in risky places. Some are guarded. Some require solving environmental puzzles. Locked doors block your escape and force you to think. Sometimes logic opens a path. Sometimes timing matters more. When stealth fails, you may need to break locks, but doing so increases danger.
Combat exists but it is not your strength. You are weak. Fighting is risky and limited. You should only fight when there is no other option. Survival depends on intelligence, not force.
As you move deeper into the prison, the environment changes. Lights flicker in broken hallways. Doors slam shut behind you. Alarm systems react to careless movement. Each area tells a silent story of suffering and control. The prison feels alive and hostile at all times.
Saving innocent prisoners plays an important role. These characters remember your actions. Those you help may later guide you, distract guards, or unlock new paths. Ignoring them may make your journey harder.
The difficulty increases steadily. Guards become more alert. Enemies adapt to your behavior. Puzzles grow more complex and demand patience. Rushing always leads to failure. The game rewards players who observe, plan, and adapt.
SilentBoy Prison Escape Sim 3D respects serious players. It challenges your thinking. It tests your patience. It forces you to make hard choices with real consequences.

İnternetsiz okey oyunları denince akla gelen isim tabii ki Alper Games! İnternetsiz okey indir ve internetsiz okey oyna doğrudan eğlencenin kalbine adım at! İster 101 Okey İnternetsiz HD oyununu ister Klasik okeyi tamamen internetsiz oynayabilirsin.

Klasikleşmiş oyun hamlelerinden sıkılmadınız mı? İşte karşınızda gerçek oyuncu kalitesinde yapay zeka deneyimi. 101 Okey oyunu ve Klasik Okey oyunu için en önemli konulardan biri yapay zekadır. 101 Okey ve Klasik Okey oyunlarının en önemli konularından biri ise donmadan oynayabilmektir. Alper Games olarak yaptığımız geliştirmeler sayesinde cihazınız hiç donmuyor, ısınmıyor ve şarjınız uzun süre gidiyor.

listings.name: 101 Okey HD-İnternetsiz YüzBir
listings.description:
İnternetsiz 101 Okey ve Klasik Okey – tek uygulamada

Türkiye’nin en sevilen iki okey oyunu, 101 Okey (Yüzbir) ve Klasik Okey, aynı uygulamada ve tamamen internetsiz. Uçakta, metroda, internetin olmadığı her yerde indir ve hemen oyna.

【İki Oyun, Tek Uygulama】
101 Okey’in stratejik derinliği ile Klasik Okey’in hızlı temposu bir arada. İstediğin zaman modlar arasında geçiş yap; iki oyunun kurallarını da bilen bir okey ustası ol.

【Tamamen İnternetsiz】
Bağlantı gerektirmez. Uygulamayı aç, masaya otur, taşları dağıt. İnternetsiz okey oynamanın en kolay yolu.

【Gerçek Oyuncu Gibi Oynayan Yapay Zeka】
Rakiplerin ezbere hamle yapmaz. Yapay zekamız eldeki taşlara, atılan taşlara ve oyunun gidişine göre karar verir; gerçek bir okey masasındaki gibi dikkat ister. Hamlelerini düşünmen gerekecek.

【HD Görseller ve Akıcı Oynanış】
Yüksek çözünürlüklü taşlar, net ıstaka ve gerçekçi animasyonlar. Telefon ve tablette düşük pil tüketimi ve takılmadan oynanış için optimize edildi.

【Skor Tablosu】
Her el sonunda puanın güncellenir, sıralaman değişir. Kendi rekorunu kır, sıralamada yüksel.

【Ücretsiz】
Alper Games’in diğer oyunları gibi bu oyun da ücretsiz indirilir ve oynanır.

Hemen indir, İnternetsiz 101 Okey ve Klasik Okey ile oyunun keyfini çıkar.

Remote Smart Control – Professional Printing
bluejetty:00071781:ios.description:
Bringing 3D Printing from the Workshop to Every Home
From fingertip control to creative realization, we deliver stable and intelligent experiences that connect every maker’s present and future.
Remote Smart Control – Professional Printing Without Limits
● Start prints anywhere, monitor progress in real time, pause/resume/cancel jobs remotely, and fine-tune core printing parameters.
● Receive automatic alerts when prints finish, with professional analysis reports to help makers optimize with data.
● Compatible with Kobra S1C/Kobra 3/M7/Kobra 2 Pro/Plus/Max/M5/M3 Premium/Photon P1/Kobra X/Kobra S1 Max to unlock the full performance of every device.
Cloud Collaboration – Unlock Your Creative Space
Free dedicated cloud storage for safely backing up and managing your print files. Sync seamlessly across devices, keep your creative library online anytime, and free up local storage.
Model Ecosystem – From Inspiration to Creation in One Tap
● Extensive curated model library covering figurines, home decor, education, industrial prototypes, and more for fast, precise matching.
● Slicing zone provides pre-tested, ready-to-use files—new users skip complex setup, while professionals accelerate iteration.
● A creator community is gradually taking shape to encourage original design sharing, so every idea can be seen, reused, and grown.
Full-Scale Support – Your Partner from Beginner to Pro
Built-in help center and step-by-step tutorials cover everything from setup and calibration to advanced parameter tuning. Smart answers for common issues help new users get started quickly and support professionals in mastering advanced skills.
We believe 3D printing should not be limited to a few.
Anycubic – built on stable, intelligent experiences, guided by an open, symbiotic ecosystem – making creative freedom accessible to every home and every workshop.

bluejetty:00072718:ios.description:
Goodbye missed messages and scheduling spreadsheets. Breakroom Chat’s team messaging and scheduling app is the most simple, capable, and affordable solution to manage your team!
From McDonalds to hair salons, businesses of all sizes use Breakroom Chat to help unify team communications, manage employee schedules, and streamline operations. Keep your team updated and communications flowing, with simple tools for day-to-day employee engagement to strengthen your company’s culture and lower employee churn. 
Read why thousands rely on Breakroom Chat’s business chat and scheduling features:
"The one thing that's been the bane of my existence as leadership is how do I communicate effectively with everybody? I really see Breakroom Chat being a fantastic tool." - Eric Hougland (Director of Operations, Argos, 75+ employees)
UNIFIED TEAM MESSAGING
- Send important messages, images, and videos to everyone
- Create 1:1 or group conversations with specific team members such as Managers or Shift Leads
- Keep your team connected without sharing sensitive information like phone numbers
- See who's read important messages
- Get reactions and acknowledgement from your team with work-appropriate emojis
SCHEDULING & SHIFT COVERAGE
- Create a schedule in minutes from your mobile device or the computer
- Distribute work schedules that everyone can see from the app
- Allow your team to request coverage and swap shifts
- Automatically notify team members when shifts are published or changed
TIME OFF & AVAILABILITY
- Team members can make time off requests straight from the app
- Time off requests are sent to managers and owners for approval
- Allow your team to submit their availability to make scheduling easier
ANNOUNCEMENTS
- Share updates with your team in just a few clicks
- Separate important information from daily messages using Announcements
- Restrict who can send announcements to just admins and managers
COMPLIANCE & CONTROL
- Add and remove team members from your organization
- Delete inappropriate content
- Grant admin and manager permissions to others in your organization
FILES & RESOURCES
- Share files such as employee handbooks and training materials with your team
- Keep your team updated with information about the business
We offer in-app purchases of auto-renewing subscriptions for Breakroom Chat. Breakroom Chat offers unlimited access to chat, scheduling, invitations, and more. The subscription renews month-to-month and is purchased in-app. You can easily cancel anytime, online, 24 hours a day. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. To avoid renewal, you must turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before your subscription ends. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings.
Privacy policy: https://www.breakroomapp.com/privacy
Terms of service: https://www.breakroomapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00098626:ios.summary:
Italian Brainrot: Animals Quiz throws you headfirst into the chaotic and hilarious universe of Italian Brainrot — the ultimate meme quiz game where speed, madness, and pure brainrot energy collide!
There are three wild game modes waiting f
bluejetty:00098626:ios.description:
Italian Brainrot: Animals Quiz throws you headfirst into the chaotic and hilarious universe of Italian Brainrot — the ultimate meme quiz game where speed, madness, and pure brainrot energy collide!
There are three wild game modes waiting for you:
Classic Mode – Guess the correct character image based on a name like Bombardiro Crocodilo or Trippi Troppi. Four meme images, one right answer.
Emoji Mode – Can you figure out Lirili Larila or Chimpanzini Bananini using only a string of emojis? Tap the meme that matches the clue!
Zoom Mode – Identify the character by looking at a zoomed-in part of a meme. Is that Boneca Ambalabu’s tutu or Burbaloni Luliloli’s nose?
Test your reflexes and brainrot instincts in every mode — all with a built-in speedrun timer to push you to the limit.
You’ll meet all the unforgettable Italian Brainrot characters, from the iconic Tralalero Tralala to the chaotic Tung Tung Tung Sahur, and the unstoppable Brr Brr Patapim. Recognize Bobritto Bandito and Ballerina Cappucina in the heat of the moment? How about U din din din din dun and Bombombini Gussini?
Each character returns again and again to challenge your brainrot memory. Cappuccino Assasino might trick you in Classic Mode — and again in Zoom! Trippi Troppi and Lirili Larila might throw you off with emojis, while Chimpanzini Bananini shows up just when you think you’ve mastered it.
Get ready for wild visuals, unforgettable sounds, and a nonstop barrage of Italian Brainrot energy. Whether you're in love with Boneca Ambalabu, jamming to Tung Tung Tung Sahur, or stuck on Burbaloni Luliloli, there’s always another ridiculous question waiting.
This is speed. This is chaos. This is Italian Brainrot. This is meme quiz madness. Are you ready to rot?

bluejetty:00038802:ios.name: Autism ABC App
bluejetty:00038802:ios.summary: ABC App is the first app entirely dedicated to the world of autism and special education, designed and developed for educators in this field and parents of autistic children. Excellent for both entertainment and therapy hours. The core poin
bluejetty:00038802:ios.description:
ABC App is the first app entirely dedicated to the world of autism and special education, designed and developed for educators in this field and parents of autistic children. Excellent for both entertainment and therapy hours. The core points of the app are:
• Results: Our App is able to make your child achieve results, thanks to games and activities designed for this purpose.
• Simplicity: The App is also accessible to those who are not familiar with technology: simple, effective and functional!
• Flexibility: Content suitable for all ages and all levels of autism! 
Updates: New activities with each app update to increase and renew learning and fun!
• Artificial Intelligence: The app automatically monitors user activity during use and increases or decreases the level of difficulty according to the data collected.
• Sharing: One of the most ambitious aims is to collect data in a completely anonymous way and make it available both to the users themselves and to third parties for research!
All our products are developed taking into account educational methodologies and exploiting the concept of "reinforcement", a tool that involves children in view of something they want. 
In recent times, with the advent of technology, tablets and smartphones have become recreational devices for children of all ages. In the context of the autism educational method these devices are often considered as a reinforcement, therefore presenting cognitive activities through the electronic device is not seen as a task to be performed but as something pleasant.
ABC App exploits this aspect to its advantage, offering a wide range of activities to children that can transform their emerging skills into learned skills in a pleasant and natural way. 
The available activities range from purely playful and entertaining to those aimed at developing different cognitive or even motor skills.
For each activity there are several levels of difficulty. The App, in a completely automatic way, increases or decreases this level by analysing the child's behaviour: the difficulty will increase if children succeed in the activity in a confident way or will decrease if they encounter too many obstacles and difficulties.
Another aspect of the educational method is measurement: data must be collected. Data collection allows us to understand whether a specific activity is effective. The App tracks the child's results for each activity, making them available through easy-to-read graphs and indexes. Moreover, all this data is automatically processed and stored (completely anonymously) on a central server. Thanks to this database the guardian/parent/educator will be able to compare the user's results with an average figure referring to all children of the same sex and age for the selected activity.
The App is addressed to families, educators and therapists. It is developed so that you can manage different profiles, one for each child/user. In this way an educator or a therapist will be able to use the App with multiple users, keeping for each of them the difficulty levels, the progress for each activity, the data and the usage statistics.
Terms of Use: http://lollipapps.com/termini-condizioni.html
Privacy Policy: http://lollipapps.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00138349:ios.description:
Discover the DoYogaWithMe app – your complete yoga companion, offering hundreds of high-quality classes for all levels, anytime and anywhere. Whether you're just beginning your yoga journey or looking to deepen an advanced practice, our app provides the tools, guidance, and community to support your growth.
Led by experienced and passionate instructors, including Fiji McAlpine and David Procyshyn, our diverse library includes Vinyasa, Hatha, Power, Yin, Restorative yoga, guided meditations, breathing exercises, and more. Classes range from gentle and therapeutic to strong and energizing, with durations from 10 minutes to over an hour.
Enjoy curated programs like Yoga for Beginners, Yoga for Runners, and 14-Day Challenges, or explore classes based on your mood, goals, or time available. Whether you're looking to build strength, improve flexibility, relieve stress, or simply move more mindfully, there's something for everyone.
With seamless streaming and downloadable content, you can practice anywhere—at home, on the go, or in nature. Track your progress, save your favorite classes, and connect with a global community dedicated to wellness and self-care.
DoYogaWithMe is built on the belief that yoga should be accessible to all. That’s why we offer many classes completely free, with the option to subscribe for access to premium content and structured programs.

Multi factor authentication app helps you to ensure your online accounts are much safer. Two Factor Authentication (2FA) which generates Time-based One-time Passwords (TOTP) and Hash-based one-time password (HOTP).
With 2FA, potentially compromising just one of these factors will not unlock the account. So, even if your password is stolen or your phone is lost, the possibilities of someone else getting your second factor information is pretty low.
-Two Factor Authentication

- Encrypted Backup
Your 2FA information is backed up with encryption so you can access it safely if you lose your information or switch to a new device
- Access from all your Devices
Authenticator app allows you to access your tokens across All your Apple devices
- Support thousands of Online accounts
Authenticator app supports thousands of accounts including Microsoft, Google, Binance, Salesforce, Amazon, Gmail, Instagram, Apex and more...

bluejetty:00093770:ios.description:
First State Bank of the Ozarks is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with First State Bank of the Ozarks:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the First State Bank of the Ozarks app, you must be enrolled as a First State Bank of the Ozarks digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00071011:ios.description:
Idiom Master(成語達人) is a casual puzzle word game. Learn more about idioms and improve your literary skills during the game, which is fun and educational and leads you to play in the pleasant world of idioms.
Rules explanation：
The game interface consists of a crossword area, a word selection area, and a hint area. Under the existing text hints, fill in the scattered words in the word selection area below into the 9x9 crossword area above to form the correct idiom. Complete all the idioms in the crossword area to win the game!
Game features：
-Levels of play: a variety of ways to play, increasing difficulty patterns
-The rules are easy to follow and easy to operate
-A large number of words and levels, so you will never get tired of playing
-Light music, is perfect for relieving stress and soothing the brain
-Several hints to help you pass the game quickly
-招財進寶, daily login, so you have endless rewards
-Learn and never get tired: review vocabulary and learn new idioms anytime, anywhere
-Delicious food: collect food while playing and learn about the culture of local food
Combine idioms and solitaire games. It is an idiom crossword game that is both fun and learning, and the operation is simple and easy to understand. Both men and women, young and old, can quickly get started, come to challenge their idiom vocabulary, and see who is the real into the person!

A truly tribute to the great classics like HeroQuest, D&D and all the titles that defined an era of

bluejetty:00033496:ios.name: Fitenium: AI Workout & Gym Log
bluejetty:00033496:ios.summary:
FITENIUM app is the application and online community for GenAI-powered training and injury prevention.
At FITENIUM app, you will be able to craft your truly personalised workout using Generative Artificial Intelligence or find a training p
bluejetty:00033496:ios.description:
FITENIUM app is the application and online community for GenAI-powered training and injury prevention.
At FITENIUM app, you will be able to craft your truly personalised workout using Generative Artificial Intelligence or find a training program reviewed by a Human Certified Coach. You will be able to plan and track your own workout program. 
FITENIUM is a Truemed qualified company. This means that your payments could be eligible for HSA/FSA reimbursement. Qualify here: https://app.truemed.com/fitness/qualify/tm_qual_vabfzbjmat.
*Your first workout with FITENIUM*
Choose how you want to train - We know that each person likes to train in a different way, that's why at FITENIUM we provide you with an option for each case.
Create your workout - Choose create your workout if you want to plan your training program by defining your sessions, exercises and reps for each workout.
Find your workout - Choose Find your personalised training program if what you are looking for is a custom workout according to your level, available equipment, goals and frequency, etc.
Track your workout - Choose Track your workout if you want to define exercises, reps and weights that you are going to train in your session. If you train with a coach, we recommend it.
*Your injury alerts*
Access your health profile - Tap on the heart icon that appears on your personal profile screen to access your private health profile.
Meet your digital twin - At FITENIUM you have a visual digital twin that represents your localised state of fatigue in real time as you train and recover.
Avoid injuries while training - Thanks to your digital twin, we are able to analyse your data and send you personalised alerts about where and when you are at risk of injury, based on your workouts.
*Track your progress*
Review your personal bests - In FITENIUM you have a section in your profile with all your personal bests according to the exercises you have tracked during your training.
Visualize your evolution - For each exercise you will have an evolution graph in which you will find your progress in the time range of your selection.
Analyze your exercise history - In FITENIUM you can access the history of repetitions and weights for each exercise. You can use this information to program and adjust your sets while you are training.
*Track your weight*
Follow your body weight - Measure your weight daily at your health profile. In FITENIUM you will be able to visualize a chart with your progress and easily enter new weights.
*Your heart rate while you train*
Your heart rate working out - Connect FITENIUM to any wearable synced with Apple Health or Google FIT to track your heart rate during your workouts. This will enable you to follow your exercise intensity and plan your workouts better.
Your heart rate evolution - You might check the evolution of your average heart rate across your workout sessions at your progress charts in your health profile.
*Never miss a workout*
Your workout awaits you - Want to change a song on Spotify? Want to drop a message to someone? Receive a call at the gym? NO PROBLEMO since FITENIUM will always keep your training session open as long as you don't finish or cancel it.
*Create a training habit with FITENIUM*
Transform your training into a digital experience - Share your sessions with the rest of the community, adding photos and videos to the exercises and reps of your workout.
Visualise your workout- Swipe left on each post to find the muscle fatigue visualisation of each shared workout.
Track your weekly streaks - At each user's profile picture, you will see the number of weeks in a row they have been tracking their training with the FITENIUM app.
*Connect with friends*
Invite your friends - If you know other friends who you think would like to train with you using FITENIUM, you can easily invite them from the invite screen.
Terms of use: https://fitenium.com/en/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00017082:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00017082:ios.description:
Orlando’s on the run! 
Chased by the Queen’s army. Lost. Defeated. This fallen king is no one’s idea of a hero. The world itself is working against him. He's a failure; just trying to survive.
But wait! With friends in unexpected places, perhaps his cause is not lost. After all, villain or hero, it’s all a matter of perspective, right?
Return to the magical world of Roterra, where “up” is relative and you may need to walk across the ceiling or down a wall to find your way. Rotate, flip and spin specially marked cubes to shift the ground and reveal pathways. With new environments, harder puzzles, and new characters, Roterra Extreme will provide hours of expert puzzling fun!
Take your time and plan your moves: in this perception-challenging world, things are rarely as they seem, and the correct path is often not the most obvious one. In this jumbled world you may need dozens of moves to complete the path and escape the maze, but don't worry about getting stuck: just flip a cube to find a new way out.
---GAME FEATURES---
▪ 35 Challenging Puzzles over 10 levels
▪ 5+ hours of gameplay
▪ The Puzzles are the Story: change your perspective to find the path
▪ No Ads, No Timers, No IAP
▪ No Internet needed to play
▪ Prequel game, Roterra, Featured in Game of the Day and 5 Collections
Not recommended for iPhone 5S, iPhone SE or iPad Air
---STORY OF ROTERRA---
Once upon a time, a daring princess defied stereotypes and took her fate into her own hands. Roterra is inspired by ORLANDO FURIOSO, a 16th Century poem about love, power and perception.
In Roterra, Princess Angelica must turn cubes to transform dead ends into doorways, toggle switches to reveal staircases and bridges, and even flip the world on its head to find the path and overcome the obstacles set in her way. The puzzles tell the story of a young girl, at first tentative with her newfound magic, growing empowered as she escapes from increasingly difficult mazes created by her power-hungry brother, Orlando. 
Traversing the cube-shaped puzzle world of Roterra to regain her rightful place as Queen, Angelica discovers that sometimes the journey matters more than the destination, stereotypes are not to be trusted, and often the only way forward is to change your perspective.
Roterra Extreme™ continues the story from Orlando’s perspective as he runs for safety when his plan to get rid of Angelica falls through. This time, the mazes are created by the world of Roterra itself, punishing Orlando for stealing his sister’s magic. Orlando’s journey is hard and frustrating; his “helpers” are often not very helpful and the world’s magic takes every opportunity to turn him around and block his path. He even finds himself hallucinating as he becomes increasingly more panicked and lost. Where Angelica’s story is one of triumph and self-discovery, Orlando’s only concern is escaping pursuit and finding a safe place to regroup.
Learn more about Angelica, Orlando and the 16th Century poem, ORLANDO FURIOSO, that inspired the game at playroterra.com
Need help? Find answers to common questions in our FAQ: https://playroterra.com/faq
Want to share feedback, report a bug, or get a hint? Send an email to support@dig-itgames.com.
Roterra™ is produced by Dig-iT! Games®, an independent, woman-owned game studio in Bethesda, MD
Follow Roterra online at:
Web: https://playroterra.com
Twitter: @playroterra
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/playroterra

bluejetty:00064034:ios.summary: Welcome to the all-new Sacramento Kings + Golden 1 Center app, providing the ultimate interactive fan experience. Get even closer to your favorite team by earning rewards, participating in fan challenges, ordering food and drinks, tracking
bluejetty:00064034:ios.description:
Welcome to the all-new Sacramento Kings + Golden 1 Center app, providing the ultimate interactive fan experience. Get even closer to your favorite team by earning rewards, participating in fan challenges, ordering food and drinks, tracking games and advanced stats on the players, managing your tickets and more. 
Enhancing the innovative combination of team and venue app, the latest design features a more personalized experience, enabling your content and experiences to be customized to your location, preferences and engagement. 
● ROYALTY PASS + FAN CHALLENGES
Compete in Fan Challenges with tasks like attending games, watching broadcasts and engaging with the Kings through trivia and more. Earn rewards on your Royalty Pass including free food and drinks, gear from the Team Store, custom Kings jerseys and autographed items! 
● ORDER FOOD AND DRINKS
Don’t miss a minute of the action! Browse menus from Local Eats stands, enjoy safe and secure contactless payment, skip lines and pick up your food and drinks on your schedule. 
● TRACK THE TEAM
Inside Golden 1 Center or around the world, stay on top of the action with live play-by-play, access to TV and radio broadcasts* and advanced stats on individual players and the entire team. Sync the schedule to your calendar, analyze upcoming opponents and have access to the latest news. 
● VIRTUAL COWBELL
Kings fans are best-known around the league for being loud and proud. Now you can always do your part with the Virtual Cowbell!
● MANAGE TICKETS
Quickly access and manage all of your tickets from within the app. Transfer to friends, add to your wallet and have them ready to easily tap and go at the entrance to Golden 1 Center. 
● PLAN YOUR EXPERIENCE
Discover upcoming concerts and other events, check the traffic and secure your parking in advance or reserve a ride to and from the event. Whatever you choose, let the app help make your experience frictionless. 
● SHOP KINGS GEAR
The latest styles and collectibles are at your fingertips. Shop official gear and special offers from the Kings Team Store. And if you’re at a game, opt for in-seat delivery and we’ll bring it out to you.
● AUCTIONS
Game-worn items, tickets and unique fan experiences can be yours by placing bids on Kings Auctions. 
● CHAT WITH SLAMSON
Let Slamson serve as your virtual concierge. He’s got info and videos on your favorite players, in-depth arena support, way-finding and more!
*Access to broadcasts may be subject to your location and availability from your cable provider.

bluejetty:00149768:ios.description:
A custom music app built for Orangetheory coaches & Studios by FITRADIO!
Getting the music right for one person is a science, getting the music right for a group of diverse members is an art form. It requires research, high quality curation, and data analysis. It requires communication with members, coaches, franchisees, and stakeholders.
FITRADIO has been working with Orangetheory studio owners and coaches for over two years to analyze what works in the Orangetheory studio. We have used this data to create the new Orangetheory Radio app.
Custom Stations
Quickly find all the best mixes FITRADIO has to offer that pair perfectly with Orangetheory workouts.
A song for everyone
Our mixes are curated with songs from many different genres so everyone in class will hear something they love. Trust us, we got you! Every mix in the custom Orangetheory Radio tab has been tested in a studio setting to ensure you can feel confident before pressing play.
Backed by Data
We utilize data from users, gyms, coaches, and specific workouts to better understand what artists, formats, and tempos work best for Orangetheory workouts.
Download the app now to get started!
- Title of service: Orangetheory Radio Premium
- Length of subscription: 1 Month
- Price of subscription: Varies Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings in the App Store app after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
- Orangetheory Radio allows users to share workout data with HealthKit and CareKit and helps close activity rings on the AppleWatch 
For more information check out our Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and Health App Information Disclosure here:
https://www.fitradio.com/tos.html
https://www.fitradio.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00163600:ios.description:
Life as a new parent can be demanding, and you need all the help you can get to focus on what really matters; enjoy the precious time with your baby.
Do you often ask yourself the following questions?
• Which side did baby feed on last?
• What did my partner give my baby for lunch?
• How much did baby eat compared to previous weeks?
• How long was the midday nap?
• What time did the little one wake up?
• Who changed diaper for baby?
• What was the last weigh-in?
Keep track of all the details for your baby’s activities either logged by you, your partner, grandparents, nannies, or friends. Get 100% real-time synchronization and immediate feedback through notifications when activities are logged.
Breastfeed, pumping, bottle, solids, sleep, diaper tracking, training and developing routines for one or multiple babies. Mjello Baby helps you to keep full track of your baby’s development.
KEY FEATURES
• Invite unlimited number of caregivers
You need all the help you can get! We know that taking care of a baby can be stressful. That’s why you can invite all the caregivers you like with instant access. Revoking access from a caregiver is also as easy as inviting. You have full control.
• Log unlimited number of activities and real-time synchronization
Whether you or one of your caregivers logged an activity – the information will be synchronized immediately between your devices. Notifications will notify you as soon as an activity is logged by other caregivers.
All activities allow to add notes for extra details.
• Feed Tracking
Choose how you will feed your baby (breast vs bottle). Track how long your nursing sessions are and the time between the feeds. Perfect for both feeding on demand and schedules. Once baby grows record solids and details of what type of food was eaten.
• Pump Tracking
Keep a log of how much you breast pump and which side was most recently used.
• Sleep Tracking
Record your baby's day time and night time sleeping patterns. Ideal for establishing and sticking to your baby’s sleeping routines.
• Diaper Tracking
Record your baby's wet or dirty diapers and even the size. Add notes when your baby uses a diaper or a potty once you start toilet-training. 
• Baby Growth Tracking
Monitor your baby’s growth by tracking height, weight gains and head size on charts developed by World Health Organization (WHO) Child Growth Standards.
• Daily Activity Timeline
What has your baby been up to today? And what about yesterday? Get a map out of your baby’s routine in a calendar.
• Detailed stats and graphs
The stats in each section will help paint the full picture of your baby’s development. Track the weekly progression of all activities enabling you to compare averages and trends (up- and downtrends).
Are you ready to become super charged? Download now and focus on what really matters!
MJELLO BABY PREMIUM
• View activities beyond 72 hours
• Get statistics and analytics insights
• Access baby growth plan
• Add and track unlimited no. of babies
• Securely backup data in the cloud by creating an account, and much more!

Your account will be charged for renewal at the total subscription price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions and auto-renewals may be managed or canceled via your iTunes Account settings. Any unused portion of free trial is forfeited after purchase. Special introductory offers only apply to first billing term.

bluejetty:00091083:ios.name: Merge Ville: Match Puzzle Game
bluejetty:00091083:ios.summary: Merge Ville is an awesome mobile game that offers a super creative adventure experience. In this game, you follow the story of Olivia, a talented fashion designer who returns to her cute hometown, Lakeview, to reconnect with her dad, Jacob.
bluejetty:00091083:ios.description:
Merge Ville is an awesome mobile game that offers a super creative adventure experience. In this game, you follow the story of Olivia, a talented fashion designer who returns to her cute hometown, Lakeview, to reconnect with her dad, Jacob. While Olivia is totally stoked to be back in Lakeview, she's also got the tough task of creating a new clothing collection that will be the talk of the town.
But finding inspiration for her designs isn't easy. That's where you come in! As Olivia's spirit, you'll go along with her on her journey to explore the town and find the inspiration she needs. You and Ryan, Olivia's childhood friend, will uncover the secrets of Lakeview and meet a bunch of cool characters along the way.
With its amazing graphics, immersive gameplay, and captivating storyline, Merge Ville is sure to keep you entertained for hours! So why wait? Download Merge Ville today and join Olivia and Ryan on their exciting adventure through Lakeview!
As you play, you'll have the opportunity to merge different items to create new and exciting things. This is a big part of the game and it lets you unlock new stuff to decorate Lakeview. Plus, the gameplay is easy to understand and enjoyable for all ages. The game's graphics are also super colorful and charming, which makes the game even more fun. Overall, it's a great choice for anyone looking for a fun and engaging way to spend their time.
But wait, there's more! Merge Ville has a captivating storyline that follows Olivia and Ryan's adventure in Lakeview. As you progress, you'll unlock new characters and locations to decorate and renovate. This feature keeps the game fresh and exciting, and it gives you a reason to keep coming back for more.
The best part of Merge Ville? It offers endless possibilities for decorating, allowing you to create your vision of the perfect town. Whether you want a cozy cottage or a bustling city center, you can let your imagination run wild as you merge items and decorate with your unique style. With so many options available, you can spend hours customizing your town to your heart's content.
In conclusion, Merge Ville is a standout mobile game that combines merge gameplay with city decoration. Its charming storyline, easy-to-understand gameplay, and endless decorating possibilities are sure to appeal to players who love creative adventures and casual games. So why not join Olivia and Ryan on their exciting adventure and experience the joy of Merge Ville for yourself? We can't wait to see what you come up with!

bluejetty:00187474:ios.description:
Outlook lets you bring all your email accounts and calendars in one convenient spot. Whether it’s staying on top of your inbox or scheduling the next big thing, we make it easy to be your most productive, organised and connected self.

- Focus on the right things with our smart inbox - we help you sort between messages you need to act on straight away and everything else.

- Share your meeting availability with just a tap and easily find times to meet with others.

- View and attach any file from your email, OneDrive, Dropbox, and more, without having to download them to your phone.
- Open Word, Excel, or PowerPoint attachments to edit them directly in the corresponding app and attach them back to an email.

- Type a few words to have Copilot* jump-start your writing with an outline or draft
- Before sending off your email, use Coaching with Copilot* to get tips and suggestions that help improve the overall tone, sentiment, and clarity

--

bluejetty:00045042:ios.description:
What is AVR BASE? 
AVR Base is the fastest growing and soon to be the most advanced app for Mountain Bikers and Cyclists! This comprehensive community platform allows riders of all disciplines to discover and create groups and clubs, organise rides and events, share information easily, access biking resources, buy and sell gear and book shuttles, tours, and rentals. Connect with local riders and cyclists globally.
Developed by riders for riders, AVR Base offers unparalleled convenience for accessing community news, trail details, gear news, and travel resources, all intuitively accessible at your fingertips. AVR Base empowers individuals and entire communities to dive deep into the world of mountain biking and cycling.
Our technology fosters real-world connections, bringing clubs and like-minded individuals together seamlessly. Group Rides, Social Events, Races, Festivals, and Expositions: Looking for a group ride or race in your area or somewhere you're visiting? Want to organize a social event? Use our Event/Ride calendar and Explore Map to discover and share local happenings. Our streamlined group
Clubs:
Whether you're starting a club or managing a large group, AVR Base simplifies building and managing clubs. You can organize events, manage memberships, and communicate directly, making engagement and coordination effortless.
Travel and Venue Information:
Curious about open bike parks, lift pass prices, or available shuttle services? Find all the necessary details for your biking trips in a standardized, easy-to-navigate format.
Newsfeed:
Tired of mainstream social media? AVR Base offers a dedicated space for riders, focusing on gear, group rides, and race updates without the clutter of ads and off-topic content. Engage with your community both locally and globally.
In-App Messaging:
Communicate with riders worldwide through our integrated messaging system, designed to streamline event and group ride coordination without the hassle of setting up multiple chats.
In Summary:
AVR Base is a dynamic ecosystem where biking enthusiasts and professionals can create and join activities, follow updates, build clubs, trade gear, share insights, book services, and enhance their skills.ride organisation tools make posting ride details like a pro quicker than sending a text.
