bluejetty:00175669:ios.name: MONOPOLY GO!
bluejetty:00175669:ios.summary: Hit GO! Roll the dice! Earn MONOPOLY money, interact with your friends, family members and fellow Tycoons from around the world as you explore the expanding universe of MONOPOLY GO! It’s the new way to play the classic board game - board fl
bluejetty:00175669:ios.description:
Hit GO! Roll the dice! Earn MONOPOLY money, interact with your friends, family members and fellow Tycoons from around the world as you explore the expanding universe of MONOPOLY GO! It’s the new way to play the classic board game - board flipping cleanup not required in these fun board games!
Take a Break!
Escape, enjoy, dream, scheme, gain rewards and stay in touch with this newly reimagined twist on MONOPOLY online games! Let everyone’s favorite zillionaire, Mr. MONOPOLY, guide you through new boards themed after world-famous cities, fantastical lands and imaginative locales. Each adventure begins with a roll of the dice - whether you're a board game beginner or one of the strategy masters, there's fun to be had for everyone!
So MONOPOLY GO!
· Experience classic fun and visuals with gameplay fit for your phone! Collect Properties, build Houses and Hotels, pull Chance Cards, and of course, roll the dice to earn that MONOPOLY Money!
· Play with your favorite game Tokens such as the Racecar, Top Hat, Battleship, and more. Earn more tokens as you go to keep the win going in these board games!
· See classic MONOPOLY icons like Mr. M, Scottie and Ms. MONOPOLY come to life, and brand new characters too!
Your Family Table!
· Help or hinder! - Play dice & pick a card - You and friends can earn easy money with Community Chest and co-op events! Or heist their banks to help yourself get to the top. Don’t feel bad – that’s just how the dice roll!
· Collect and trade story-filled Stickers with friends and family around the world and in our MONOPOLY GO game! Facebook Trading Groups! Complete gorgeous, sticker albums to win huge rewards! The more Stickers you collect, the closer you get to candy sweet exclusive bonuses and limited-edition collections!
Features!
BUY & BUILD YOUR WAY TO THE TOP
Collect Property Tile Sets to build Houses and upgrade your Houses to Hotels to get even more rent from friends! All you have to do is hit GO and roll the dice! Build your empire and be lord of the board! Whether you're in it for casual fun or to prove you're one of the true masters of the game – the board awaits!
ENJOY THAT CLASSIC MONOPOLY ATMOSPHERE
Roll the dice to enjoy the classic game of MONOPOLY. Featuring familiar faces such as MR. MONOPOLY, familiar spaces such as jail (womp womp!), Railroads, Properties, Tokens, and familiar elements like drawing the perfect lucky card and more!
PLAY WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY
Get social! With a variety of fun games, you can play with friends around the world to take full advantage of new multiplayer mini-games such as Community Chest – where you and friends take a break from mischief and work together for fun and rewards!
NEW OPPORTUNITIES EVERY DAY
Play Tournaments, the Prize Drop plinko mini-game, the Cash Grab mini-game and follow our Events for big rewards. New Events run every hour, there are new ways to play and win every day! Compete in every tournament to climb the ranks. Keep an eye out for our time-limited games, perfect to challenge even seasoned tournament champions and MONOPOLY masters alike. Every roll of the dice counts - will it land you bonus money, a valuable Sticker, or a big build upgrade in new lands from a candy factory to Martian land?!
MONOPOLY GO! is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money. Internet connection is required to play the game.
The MONOPOLY name and logo, the distinctive design of the game board, the four corner squares, the MR. MONOPOLY name and character, as well as each of the distinctive elements of board and playing pieces are trademarks of Hasbro, Inc. for its property trading game and game equipment. © 1935, 2023 Hasbro.

Terms of Service: http://scopely.com/tos/

bluejetty:00177789:ios.description:
The first official game on everybody's favorite BabyRiki cartoon! We know how important it is for caring parents to help their kids be healthy, clever, and, most importantly, happy. That's why we've prepared something very interesting for them! Krashy, Chichi, Rosy, Wally, and Pandy, your favorite characters, are waiting for the smallest curious players to play and discover our incredible world together!
Teach your kids new skills and foster love for challenging tasks with the cartoon's characters and their hobbies:
- HEALTHY LIFESTYLE. Do sports with restless Krashy! Football, tennis, basketball, and other activities are waiting for boys and girls!
- IMAGINATION. Try out clothes with Rosy! Dresses, sunglasses, hats - you pick what your little fashionista wears!
- ATTENTIVENESS. Make your own garden with Chichi! Plant berries, vegetables, and even flowers, look after them and keep them away from pests! Gardening also teaches kids to be responsible.
- FINE MOTOR SKILLS. Cook with Pandy! Show your kids what tasty and wholesome foods there are! Cooking is an engaging activity, enjoy your meal!
- CREATIVITY. Draw with Wally! Pick tones and color pictures with the most creative BabyRiki character! The Sun is waking up, it's a new shiny day! Download our minigames for your kids to learn and to play!
Games for kids are indispensable helpers in emotional and intellectual development. All of them are full of new facts, safe, and interesting for boys as well as girls. Eye candy graphics, easy, intuitive and balanced interface accompanied by engaging tasks will appeal to kids from 0 to 3 years old, and will be appreciated by their caring parents!
Learning, running, always smiling, BabyRiki time!

Power Planner is the ultimate homework planner and school organizer for students, featuring cross-platform cloud sync, automatic reminders, and a powerful grade calculator.

Stay on top of your schedule, keep track of your assignments, and never miss a due date again—whether you're on your phone or your computer.

CRITICAL FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
- Class & Schedule Tracking: Effortlessly manage your semesters, class times, and room locations.
- Assignments & Exams: Quickly add tasks and exams, and get automatic reminders before things are due.
- Grade & GPA Calculator: Input your scores and know exactly where you stand with automatic weighted GPA calculation across multiple semesters.
- Cross-Platform Sync: Access your planner from computer or mobile with an optional online account.
- Widgets: See your upcoming assignments and classes right from your home or lock screen!

FREE TO USE:
Power Planner is fully featured, ad-free, and 100% functional for free.

GO PREMIUM (One-Time Purchase):
If you want to unlock its full potential, a single one-time in-app purchase unlocks premium features across all your devices forever:
- Add more than 5 grades per class
- Manage unlimited semesters
- And more!!

bluejetty:00083470:ios.description:
carVertical is a VIN check and VIN lookup app that provides detailed car and motorcycle history reports. Buying a used car? Check the vehicle history before you pay and avoid expensive surprises.
Enter a VIN to review available mileage records, accident and damage history, theft records, taxi use, historical photos, ownership changes, price history, and other important vehicle information.
HOW DOES IT WORK?
Find the VIN on the vehicle title document, dashboard, body, or motorcycle frame. Enter the VIN in the carVertical app. Get a detailed vehicle history report and compare the records with the seller's claims.
WHAT CAN A REPORT INCLUDE?
If available, carVertical reports may include mileage history, damage records, theft checks, previous use, historical photos, price changes, ownership changes, service-related details, equipment information, and other facts that help you understand a vehicle's past.
WHY CHECK VEHICLE HISTORY?
Mileage rollbacks, hidden damage, previous accidents, theft records, and poorly maintained vehicles can cost thousands in repairs and create safety risks. A car history check helps you make a more confident decision before buying, selling, or inspecting a used vehicle.
Use carVertical for VIN lookup, vehicle history reports, car history checks, damage history, mileage checks, theft checks, historical photos, ownership details, price history, service records, equipment details, and used car research before you buy.
Download carVertical and check a VIN before your next used car purchase.

Saved the same picture twice? Have a whole bunch of screenshots that you've never bothered to delete? Worry not! Just tap a button and we'll clean it all for you!

Sometimes our contact lists look like a complete mess - duplicate contacts, contacts with no names, several entries for the same person... Our app will allow you to keep such issues in check and resolve them easily!
- Privacy booster

bluejetty:00026128:ios.name: TimeSignal Alarm clock
bluejetty:00026128:ios.summary:
This alarm will wake you up with sounds and time chimes that you can't ignore.
Doorbell...can you ignore it?
Repeated Doorbell...can you ignore it?
It will repeatedly tell you the elapsed time at one-minute intervals.
It will also tell you
bluejetty:00026128:ios.description:
This alarm will wake you up with sounds and time chimes that you can't ignore.
Doorbell...can you ignore it?
Repeated Doorbell...can you ignore it?
It will repeatedly tell you the elapsed time at one-minute intervals.
It will also tell you the time on the hour and at times divisible by five.
--------
It's simple to use.
Just set the alarm time and close the app.
When the time is up, you will be notified by voice.
The alarm will continue to ring for 30 minutes if you leave it alone,
so start the app to stop the alarm.
The way to stop the alarm is to match the pictures.
Match the pictures, top and bottom as a pair.
Match all three pairs and wait 2-3 seconds.
A button to stop the alarm will be displayed.
Please note that the alarm will not stop if you match the same pictures in a horizontal row.
You can change the difficulty of the picture matching.
You can also set it to stop with one button.
You can check the difficulty of the game in a test.
It would be helpful if you could check the operation once before using the alarm.
You can register up to eight alarm settings.
It is convenient to set the times you frequently use in advance.
Notes about this app:
※ Uses the voice notification function of the iPhone/iPad itself.
If you do not allow notifications,
the alarm function will end when the app screen is closed.
This app sleeps according to the iPhone settings, so the app will essentially be unusable.
※ Sleep is disabled when the alarm stop screen is displayed.
Please note that no sound will be heard if you are in silent mode or have the notification function of the iPhone/iPad suppressed.
※ If you leave the alarm on the lock screen for 30 minutes, the next alarm will not sound.
In that case, please launch the app.
(The next alarm will be automatically reset when the app is launched.)
Don't expect music from this app.
There is no music at all.
The time signal of this app is not suitable for any purpose other than as an alarm.
It is a powerful alarm, but it only sounds for 30 minutes.
Humans sleep in 90-minute increments, with deep and light sleep alternating, and an alarm app cannot wake you up during deep sleep with sound alone.
If you really want to wake up at that time, it would be helpful to use multiple alarms so that you are aware of it before the time you want to wake up.
If you want to wake up 30 minutes earlier than usual, it would be helpful to go to bed 30 minutes earlier than usual.
*To Apple Watch users
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please select the Notifications tab from the Watch app on the iPhone home page and set it so that "T.Signal Alarm" notifications are not forwarded to your Apple Watch.
If this is not set, notifications will be forwarded to your Apple Watch and the app will not work properly.

Don't expect music from this app.

There is no music at all.

The time signal of this app is not suitable for any purpose other than as an alarm.

It is a powerful alarm, but it only sounds for 30 minutes.

Humans sleep in 90-minute increments, with deep and light sleep alternating, and an alarm app cannot wake you up during deep sleep with sound alone.

If you really want to wake up at that time, it would be helpful to use multiple alarms so that you are aware of it before the time you want to wake up.

If you want to wake up 30 minutes earlier than usual, it would be helpful to go to bed 30 minutes earlier than usual.

*To Apple Watch users

We apologize for the inconvenience, but please select the Notifications tab from the Watch app on the iPhone home page and set it so that "T.Signal Alarm" notifications are not forwarded to your Apple Watch.

If this is not set, notifications will be forwarded to your Apple Watch and the app will not work properly.

Shanghai Rummy, aka California Rummy is a form of contract rummy or phase rummy where you play 7 hands (or phases.) You try to play all your cards and get the lowest score.
K9 Shanghai Rum is a puppy-themed version where you play against 3 AI opponents.

bluejetty:00062485:ios.description:
*** Pay once & Play forever + receive FREE updates! No ads and no IAP ***
Have a MAGIC-ally good time in the new My Little Princess kingdom! We’ve opened a new location for you to explore and the wizard and his elves have so much to show you – visit the wizard’s cave, help the elves around the garden, seek out the hidden mini game – you can even grow your very own baby dragon!
When you download My Little Princess : Wizard, you can add new characters and clothing to ALL the other My Little Princess games. Maybe the wizard would like a tour of the princess’ castle? If you have all three games, your characters can move between all of them!
Features:
- New hidden mini game – can you find it? How long can you fly?
- Magical blue rocks to test out and discover what they can do
- Many new rooms and fun locations to plan fun adventures in!

- Move between other My Little Princess games! By connecting all of the My Town games, we are encouraging kids to build an infinite number of new adventures.
- We update our older games every month, so please wait for the updates to connect these games to My Little Princess. 
- If you are just starting out with My Town, no worries! You can create your own characters inside My My Little Princess.
- The ability to save your progress and pick up where you left off next time you open the app
- Multi-touch Feature: Play with your friends and family on the same device!
If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible in My Little Princess!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP

The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com or visit us on the MY TOWN Facebook page and twitter!

bluejetty:00074623:ios.name: Ease Applications Messaging
bluejetty:00074623:ios.summary: Ease allows patients to invite family members and loved ones to receive text, photo and video updates on their status throughout the hospital experience in a safe and secure app. A HIPAA compliant communication app, Ease is designed to impr
bluejetty:00074623:ios.description:
Ease allows patients to invite family members and loved ones to receive text, photo and video updates on their status throughout the hospital experience in a safe and secure app. A HIPAA compliant communication app, Ease is designed to improve patient satisfaction and increase transparency with updates used to educate and inform families on the patient’s status. Family members and loved ones will be able to view all Ease updates for 60 seconds of screen time before it disappears, and all content is never stored on a device. Improving patient satisfaction, communication and reducing anxiety has never been easier. Ease is freedom from the waiting room. 
The Ease App uses 5G, 4G, LTE or WiFi connections (when available). Within the app, patients are able to add the family and friends they want to keep informed and relaxed throughout their medical procedure or hospital stay.
Encrypted texts, photos and videos are sent at the direction of the patient’s medical team. In order to receive Ease updates, your medical provider must be signed up for the Ease program. 
Key Features of Ease
- Complimentary to patient, family and friends
- Real-time Updates - never lose sight of your loved one
- Customizable Messages - open communication reduces anxiety
- Communications disappear after 60 seconds - nothing stored on mobile devices
- Patients select preference of update content - receive just texts, texts and photos or texts, photos and videos
- 256-bit encryption - we take security seriously
- HIPAA compliant - protecting patient privacy
We want to hear from you.
To find out availability in your area please email us at support@easeapplications.com or visit easeapplications.com
Ease works on virtually all carriers and networks but some carrier limitations may apply. Available for tablet devices as well.

bluejetty:00024425:ios.description:
Petrol Ofisi
The renewed Petrol Ofisi mobile app welcomes you with its fresh look and multiple features. Keep track of special offers, get insight on up-to-date fuel prices, find the nearest Petrol Ofisi station, and make your payments easily without getting out of your vehicle by using the Petrol Ofisi Mobile Pay & Go feature. The Petrol Ofisi iOS app is now in the palm of your hand with its special features and exclusive campaigns.
Exclusive Petrol Ofisi Offers
To benefit from the campaigns offered by Petrol Ofisi, all you need to do is download the app on your mobile phone and register as a member. In addition to all the current Petrol Ofisi campaigns, you can also explore personalized offers and special discounts by registering your license plate. Save on fuel and win surprise awards by taking advantage of the special deals offered by various banks and credit cards.
Nearest Petrol Ofisi Station at the Tip of Your Finger
Running out of fuel? Thanks to the "Where is the station?" feature, now you can instantly view the closest Petrol Ofisi station, create a route to the station nearby, and fill up your tank in the blink of an eye. Before arriving at the station, make sure to check the Petrol Ofisi price list for spot-on fuel prices.
Pay & Go with Petrol Ofisi Mobile App
Wouldn't it be great to pay for your fuel without getting out of your car? Courtesy of the Petrol Ofisi mobile app, now you can! With the help of the Petrol Ofisi Pay & Go feature, make your payment via the app, complete the payment with the credit card linked to your account, and simply - go!
Info on Current Fuel Prices
Use the Petrol Ofisi app for up-to-date prices of different types of fuel. Select the city and district you are in and get the full list of Petrol Ofisi fuel prices including VAT.
Experience Comfort & Innovation
The features of the renewed Petrol Ofisi mobile app do not stop here. Get access to timely news from Petrol Ofisi, find inspiration for your journey in the Road Trip Songs list, or give feedback on the station you have recently visited via the Station Evaluation feature.
In order to get in contact with customer services, fill in the Petrol Ofisi contact sheet on the app or simply tap the "Call Customer Hotline" button. All the answers to your questions about Petrol Ofisi are in the FAQ section. Remember to never use the app while driving!

bluejetty:00177604:ios.summary: O app Província é a maneira mais simples, prática e segura de você acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na escola. Esqueça as ultrapassadas agendas de papel, você pode utilizar seu celular e ter acesso ao diário de seu filho em tempo real e
bluejetty:00177604:ios.description:
O app Província é a maneira mais simples, prática e segura de você acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na escola. Esqueça as ultrapassadas agendas de papel, você pode utilizar seu celular e ter acesso ao diário de seu filho em tempo real e onde estiver!
Com o app Província você tem todas as funcionalidades necessárias para acompanhar o dia a dia de seu filho na palma da sua mão:
* Diário: acompanhe as atividades realizadas pelo seu filho. Como estava a sua participação nas brincadeiras e tarefas? Ele estava animado? Brincou com os coleguinhas? Fez todas as refeições? Comeu bastante ou pouquinho? Fez pipi?
* Recados: envie um recadinho diretamente para o professor de seu filho ou para a diretora da escola e seja avisado quando receber uma resposta.
* Calendário: verifique o dia e o horário das atividades realizadas pela escola. Seja avisado assim que receber um novo convite e receba um lembrete quando uma atividade estiver próxima. Informe sua participação aos professores aceitando ou rejeitando os convites.
* Medicamentos: informe ao professor os medicamentos que seu filho está tomando, em que horário eles devem ser ministrados e em que dosagem. Encaminhe junto uma foto da receita médica.
* Dados: informe os dados mais importantes sobre seus filhos. Quais são as suas alergias? Qual o seu plano de saúde? Quais são as pessoas autorizadas a buscá-lo? Qual o seu aniversário?

bluejetty:00046955:ios.summary:
Com o novo App Metalcred, você tem acesso diversas funcionalidades na palma de suas mãos a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar com facilidade e segurança. Possibilitando assim um canal de atendimento mais próximo com você cooperado(a).
O App
bluejetty:00046955:ios.description:
Com o novo App Metalcred, você tem acesso diversas funcionalidades na palma de suas mãos a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar com facilidade e segurança. Possibilitando assim um canal de atendimento mais próximo com você cooperado(a).
O App Metalcred está cada vez mais completo para que você possa aproveitar as diversas soluções que sua Cooperativa oferece!
Confira as principais facilidades do nosso novo App:
· Consultar informações de cadastro do perfil. 
· Simular e Solicitar empréstimos pelo celular de forma facilitada nas seguintes modalidades: Crédito Consignado, Crédito Pessoal, Antecipação 13º salário, Antecipação de Férias, Antecipação do IR, Emergencial e Energia Solar. 
· Acompanhar as solicitações de crédito realizadas, efetuar assinatura de contratos, e consultar as documentações pendentes.
· Consultar saldo total do valor de participação da cota capital.
· Acessar a carteirinha digital de sócio. 
· Receber notificações com informações e notícias da cooperativa
· Fale conosco: acesso aos meios de contato, telefone, WhatsApp, ir para Metalcred (endereço), e-mail. 
· Informe de rendimentos, consultar o informe de rendimentos para declarar o IR 
· Acessar o estatuto da cooperativa
Para primeiro acesso: Após instalar, clicar em “Primeiro Acesso” inserir suas informações pessoais e cadastrar uma senha de acesso;
Para acessar: Utilize a senha que foi configurada para o uso do aplicativo, também é possível realizar o acesso com Touch ID ou Face ID nos dispositivos compatíveis com este recurso.
Baixe agora e aproveite!
Crédito sujeito à aprovação. O recebimento do valor está condicionado às contratações realizadas em dias úteis, após aprovação em análise de crédito e efetivação assinatura eletrônica do contrato de empréstimo, em conta-corrente do cooperado ou via transferência bancária (TED) para outra instituição informada pelo cooperado.

bluejetty:00186135:ios.summary:
Edit and typeset LaTeX, Plain TeX and Markdown on your iPad or iPhone, no internet connection required, using Texifier, formerly known as Texpad.
Texifier is a LaTeX editor designed for straightforward navigation, editing and typesetting o
bluejetty:00186135:ios.description:
Edit and typeset LaTeX, Plain TeX and Markdown on your iPad or iPhone, no internet connection required, using Texifier, formerly known as Texpad.
Texifier is a LaTeX editor designed for straightforward navigation, editing and typesetting of projects of any size. Open a LaTeX root file, and Texifier will scan it, open any referenced files, extract the document structure for display in the outline view, and configure the typesetter according to the packages and tools used by your document.
Texifier's editor comes with a choice of themes, syntax highlighting, autocomplete of commands, including those defined in your document, and autofill for \cite commands, \ref commands and others. The powerful sidebar can show you a summary of your document structure allowing you to navigate through large multi-file projects with ease. Additionally Texifier's outline lists all labels, figures, tables, todos and it contains a powerful search function that can search and replace across your entire project using either normal text searches or regular expression searches.
TexpadTeX - Texifier's internal, no internet connection required, typesetter comes with PGF drivers, Native Fonts extensions, a Unicode and more, allow it to support almost any LaTeX package available. TexpadTeX also integrates a BibteX tool and a Makeindex compatible indexer for documents that require those tools. The integrated bundle manager takes care of downloading, installing and updating LaTeX packages for you, giving you access to almost the entire LaTeX ecosystem without using any more space on your device than needed.
TexpadTeX can run in Live mode, updating the output as you type, so you never need wait for a typeset to finish again.
For the rare cases of documents that are not compatible with TexpadTeX, you can use our free cloud typesetters. This is fully integrated into Texifier so press typeset, and Texifier will run the typeset in the Cloud, presenting the results just as if they were typeset on your device.
After all typesets, any errors in your document are organised in a table of issues. Tap on an issue to jump directly to the offending line of LaTeX source, or the line in the original log if you wish to read the original output.
Texifier works well with Files App, allowing you to store and work on your documents wherever you wish. On top of that Texifier Connect is directly integrated into Texifier for working across devices and collaborators.
Texifier supports Markdown along with LaTeX. Edit your document in Texifier's syntax highlighting editor, browse the document by outline, then when you press Typeset, the document will be transparently converted and typeset by LaTeX (using a standard template), giving you the informal ease of Markdown with LaTeX's ability to create beautiful and high quality PDFs. Likewise Plain TeX users can edit and typeset their documents in Texifier.
Features:
- Universal binary for iPhone and iPad, optimised for the latest generation of devices.
- Typeset LaTeX to PDF on your iPad and iPhone without need for an internet connection
- Support for LaTeX, Plain Tex and Markdown
- Navigate easily through even the largest projects using the Outline view
- Search all files by string or regex with the global search view
- Browse the typeset errors and warnings either as a raw log, or with the errors and warnings table view.
- Texifier's editor autocompletes commands, and autofills commands such as \ref{...} or \cite{...}
- Use iOS Files app to edit documents in any storage that supports file or folder access
- Instant Live typeset using Texifier's built in TexpadTeX typesetter
- The onboard typesetter supports virtually any LaTeX package or font, including, but not limited to: Beamer, Tikz, Fontspec, Koma Script, e-TeX, graphicx, pgfplots, AMS, RevTeX, Babel, Bibtex and Indices.
- Free typesetting through our secure cloud servers gives you access to all packages in the latest TeXLive distribution.

bluejetty:00146970:ios.description:
** THIS APP WILL NOT FUNCTION WITHOUT HARDWARE. This is the companion app for 2023 & newer Tempur® Sleeptracker-AI® Smart Bases. ONE OF THESE DEVICES IS REQUIRED TO USE THIS APP. **
POWERED BY SLEEPTRACKER-AI®: BETTER SLEEP
Learn about your sleep - and improve your sleep - with nothing to wear or charge!
This is the companion app for the Tempur® Sleeptracker-AI® Monitor which makes your bed a smart bed. The Sleeptracker-AI® system is the first cloud-based, non-invasive IoT sleep optimization solution powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and integrated into the smart home.
The app provides detailed daily sleep graphs and sleep metrics derived from accurately and continuously monitoring the sleeper’s respiration rate, heart rate, and movements throughout the night. Easy-to-understand sleep graphs visually distinguish between periods when you were in REM sleep, light sleep, deep sleep, or awake. The AI Sleep Coach delivers personalized tips and insights to help you improve your sleep every night.
AI SLEEP COACH
The AI Sleep Coach, powered by the Sleeptracker-AI® Artificial Intelligence Engine, provides effective, easy-to-implement, personal sleep tips based on a comprehensive analysis of individual sleep patterns.
RESPIRATION AND HEART RATE MONITORING
The Sleeptracker-AI® system monitors both respiration and heart rate accurately through the night for deeper sleep analysis, with your data displayed as easy to read charts in the app.
SLEEP CYCLE ALARM
Optionally select white noise that gently fades away after you've fallen asleep, then set a sleep cycle alarm that will help you Wake Up at the Optimal Time™ in your sleep cycle so you wake up refreshed and more energized.
AUTOMATIC SLEEP MONITORING
If you choose to record your sleep automatically, there’s nothing to do and nothing to wear. Optionally receive a notification in the morning when your sleep results are available and a daily email with your sleep summary and AI Coach insights.
APPLE HEALTH
Share your Sleeptracker-AI® sleep data to the Apple Health app.
The Sleeptracker-AI® system reports the following sleep-related statistics each night:
- REM sleep, light sleep, deep sleep, awake time
- Time at which you fell asleep and woke up
- Number of times awoken during the night
- Continuous respiration rate
- Continuous heart rate
- Sleep quality metric (scale of 0-100)
- Sleep efficiency (time spent in bed vs. total time asleep)
- Time it took you to fall asleep

bluejetty:00185629:ios.description:
DMB Hub from antsmarching.org: if you're a DMB fan, you must have this app. Version 4.0 is a ground-up redesign of the whole thing.
The Hub is your home base. Live show alerts, On This Day history, trending forum threads, breaking news - everything happening in the DMB world, in one feed. Open it daily to see what's new.
Live show mode. DMB Hub knows when a show is happening. Follow the setlist in real time, right down to your Lock Screen, place your ShowFlow votes song by song, and dig into stats as each song drops. It's the best way to follow a show you're at - or one you wish you were.
Tour Central is where it gets deep. The band's entire live catalog - every year, tour, song, venue, and setlist - built for browsing, with Advanced Search to find any show fast. Tap a show and you're in: setlist, stats, posters, fan photos, ticket stubs. Upload your own from the show while you're still in the parking lot.
Song details that matter. Tap any song on any setlist and get the full picture - how many times played, last performance, show gap, tour rarity, fan sentiment. When was this song last played? Has it ever been played at this venue? Is a liberation coming? All right there.
Your DMB journey. Log in with your Ants account and track your show history, attendance, and personal stats. See which songs you've never caught live, which venues you've hit the most, and how you stack up against friends in Head-to-Head mode - or the entire Ants community. Share your DMB Story - a personalized narrative of your history with the band.
Hub Stubs. Earn achievement Stubs based on the shows you've seen and your tour superlatives, and watch your progress toward the next one.
Passport. Collect stamps at venues on show nights, then hunt down hidden spots with the compass in Hunt Mode. Fill your pages and climb the leaderboard.
The Setlist Game. Predict what the band will play, compete with friends, and form leagues. Get your picks in from anywhere - no more rushing home before the deadline. Season standings, all-time stats, and bragging rights included.
Trivia. Play solo, challenge your friends, or join live hosted Trivia events and answer against the clock.
Made for every iPhone, including a two-column layout on the open iPhone Duo.

bluejetty:00092434:ios.description:
IMPORTANT: This app is only for Kia vehicles with Kia eServices (formerly UVO eServices). If your vehicle is equipped with Kia Connect, UVO luxe, or UVO eco, please download the Kia Access pp: 
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kia-access-with-uvo-link/id1280548773
NOTE: If you have the 3.4.2 or earlier version please delete the App and install the new App version 3.7.0 from this page.
Stay informed and prepared wherever you go with Kia eServices. Kia eServices is a Kia America telematics service for select vehicles without built-in connectivity (no remote capabilities). 
Using your smart phone, Kia eServices can provide the following features:
1. Vehicle Diagnostics: Diagnose whether problems exist within major vehicle systems. If an abnormality exists, you can call Kia Roadside Assist or schedule a service appointment with your Kia Dealership directly from the vehicle or using the UVO app.
2. Roadside Assist: Contact Kia Roadside Assistance Program with just a click.
3. MyPOIs: Synchronize your POIs list from your Kia owner account with your vehicle’s navigation system.
4. Parking Minder: Save your vehicle’s parked location where the vehicle parked and navigate to it later, or send the location to a friend.
5. My Car Zone: Create records of when your vehicle is traveling faster than a set speed, starts driving later than a set time, or enters a set restricted area
6. Trip Info: Analytics of your monthly driving habits such as total driving distance and average speed.
7. Dealer Appointments: Request service appointments at a dealership of your choosing.
For more information about Kia eServices, visit https://owners.kia.com/us/en/about-uvo-eservices.html 
*To use Kia eServices, you will need a Kia vehicle equipped with Kia eServices, have registered a Kia owner account at owners.kia.com, and a compatible smart phone. You can check your vehicle and phone compatibility at https://owners.kia.com/content/owners/en/uvo-availability.html/
For help on your Kia eServices system, contact the Kia Connect call center at 1-844-886-9411 or https://ksupport.kiausa.com/ConsumerAffairs

bluejetty:00138685:ios.description:
Body tracker & progress pics compare tool for fitness & health. 
Track progress pics for fitness challenges, 75 hard, gym transformations or weight loss before & after photos.
Line up perfect shots, stay consistent with reminders, and turn daily photos into time-lapse videos or GIFs.
Whether you’re starting a fitness journey or documenting a full body transformation, PhotoJourney helps you track progress with photos and see real change over time.
Why people love PhotoJourney
- Progress pics made simple: Create a “journey” for tracking daily photos.
- Same angle, every time: Ghost Mode and camera guides help you get identical framing every shot.
- Clear before & afters: Compare side-by-side photos or swipe to reveal even the smallest changes.
- Stay on track: Streaks and optional photo reminders keep your progress recorded.
- Share your progress: Export HD time-lapse videos and GIFs of your journey.
How it works
- Start a Journey: Set one up for things like 75 Hard, weight loss or just daily selfies.
- Set your schedule: Hourly, daily, or weekly — whatever fits your routine.
- Capture consistently: Use Ghost Mode and guides to capture perfect shots (thirds grid, selfie lines, body templates) with optional countdowns.
- Compare change: See progress instantly with side-by-side or swipe comparisons.
- Share your wins: Export before & afters or full time-lapses in seconds (HD video or GIF).

- Streaks and reminders for daily photo habits
- Date stamps and overlays to keep your timeline clear

- Show daily, weekly or monthly updates – 75 hard photo a day or full year progress

- Hair growth tracking

- Home renovation and plant timelines
Capture. Compare. Transform.
Make progress photos the most motivating part of your routine, with before & after tools and time-lapses that prove your hard work.

bluejetty:00126489:ios.description:
Is the air safe to breathe today?
Whether you're going for a run, heading to work or looking after your family, My AQI Air shows you the air quality right now, wherever you are. Get the AQI (Air Quality Index) and pollutant levels from the monitoring station closest to you, or for any city you search.
WHY PEOPLE USE MY AQI AIR
Real-time AQI and pollutants
Track PM2.5, PM10, ozone (O3), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), sulfur dioxide (SO2) and carbon monoxide (CO), plus temperature, wind, humidity and pressure.
The nearest trusted sensor
If your town has no sensor, the app shows data from the closest one available.
Search and save your places
Check the AQI in the cities that matter to you, for family, travel or work, and save them to your favorites.
A clear, health-based color scale
Know at a glance what the number means, from Good to Hazardous.
Helpful for asthma, allergies and sensitive lungs
Decide when to open the windows, go for a run or wear a mask.
Share with friends and family
Send the air quality to the people you care about in a few taps.
Protective gear
The Gear tab suggests masks and other equipment to reduce your exposure to pollution.
WHAT THE COLORS MEAN (US EPA scale)
• 0–50 Good: little or no risk
• 51–100 Moderate: acceptable, but unusually sensitive people may be affected
• 101–150 Unhealthy for sensitive groups: sensitive people may feel effects
• 151–200 Unhealthy: everyone may begin to feel effects
• 201–300 Very unhealthy: health alert, everyone is more likely to be affected
• 301+ Hazardous: emergency conditions for everyone
WORLDWIDE COVERAGE
Thousands of stations in 100+ countries, including:
USA (New York, Los Angeles), India (Delhi, Mumbai), China (Beijing, Shanghai), Thailand (Bangkok, Chiang Mai), Japan (Tokyo), South Korea (Seoul)
UK, France, Mexico, Brazil, Pakistan, Vietnam, Indonesia, Canada and more.
Whether you're checking for smog, haze or dust, My AQI Air has you covered.
PREMIUM (optional)
• No ads
• Home screen and lock screen widgets
• Expanded map with more sensors around your locations
Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Air quality data is for information only and is not medical advice.

bluejetty:00017832:ios.summary: Send money into, out of and across Africa, get paid like a local, and spend globally, all from one app. Eversend is the cross-border money account: a multicurrency money app built for Africans and the diaspora, with over 1.6 million registe
bluejetty:00017832:ios.description:
Send money into, out of and across Africa, get paid like a local, and spend globally, all from one app. Eversend is the cross-border money account: a multicurrency money app built for Africans and the diaspora, with over 1.6 million registered users and over $1 billion moved.
Send money at real exchange rates with the fee shown before you confirm, hold 16 currencies plus USDC and USDT, and pay online with a virtual dollar card. Whether you're sending to family, getting paid for international work, or shopping globally, Eversend makes money across borders simple and affordable.
Send Money in Every Direction
Sending home is one direction. Eversend runs all three: into Africa from the UK, US and Europe; out of Africa, from naira, shillings or cedis to USD, GBP and EUR bank accounts; and between African countries, on routes like Kenya to Nigeria and Ghana to Nigeria that most services skip. Send to bank accounts and mobile money in 18 countries. Mobile money payouts land in about a minute, measured over our last 90 days of transfers, and the rate and fee are shown before you send, so the amount on your screen is the amount that arrives.
Virtual Dollar Cards for Global Spending
Create a virtual USD card in seconds and shop online anywhere: subscriptions, ads, travel, marketplaces. Cards start at $0.99, every fee is published upfront, and you can fund them from any currency or stablecoin at the rate on your screen. Freeze and unfreeze instantly from the app.
Your Own USD & EUR Accounts
Get paid like a local with personal USD and EUR account details. Clients and platforms pay you by normal domestic transfer, and one clear fee is shown before the money moves: perfect for freelancers, remote workers and businesses. Funds land in your Eversend wallet, and you convert to your currency when you choose.
Hold 16 Currencies & Stablecoins
Hold and exchange 16 currencies plus USDC and USDT in one place. Receive stablecoins and convert to local currency in minutes, or use them to fund your card. Every conversion happens at a rate you see and accept first.
Licensed, Secure, and Trusted
Eversend is licensed by the Bank of Uganda, registered with FinCEN (US) and FINTRAC (Canada), with central-bank remittance approvals in Kenya and Zambia. Customer funds are safeguarded and segregated. Digital assets are secured by Fireblocks. Every transaction is protected with two-factor authentication, and cards can be frozen instantly.
Which countries can I send money to?
Eversend sends to 18 countries, to bank accounts and mobile money, including Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, Ghana and Rwanda.
Can I send money from Africa, or between African countries?
Yes, and this is rare. Send out of Africa from Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda or Ghana to USD, GBP and EUR bank accounts, and between African countries on routes like Kenya to Nigeria, straight from the app.
Does Eversend have a virtual dollar card?
Yes. Create a virtual USD card in seconds and spend online worldwide, with every fee published upfront.
Can I receive USD and EUR?
Yes. Get your own USD and EUR account details and receive payments by normal domestic transfer, with one clear fee shown before the money moves.
Does Eversend support stablecoins?
Yes. Hold and convert USDC and USDT, and use them to fund cards or send money.
Download Eversend and verify your identity in minutes. Join over 1.6 million registered users moving money without borders.
Questions? support@eversend.co

We have done everything possible to
bluejetty:00128892:ios.description:
Anti Mosquito Repellent brings together mosquito repellent sounds, adjustable low frequency sounds and practical tips to help keep annoying mosquitoes away.
How do I use the app anti mosquito repellent?
We have done everything possible to simplify and make the app as user-friendly as possible, so that everyone can use it.
You will find 3 sections on the main screen. 
1.- The first one allows you to access the tool, which plays sounds or low frequency ultrasounds. Therein you can choose the mosquito sound frequency you like and once you have selected it, you will have to push the button Turn on. When you want to stop playing the mosquito killer sound you just have to push the button again to turn it off.
2.- The second one is a collection of tips and tricks, which will scare mosquitoes. Therein you will find different remedies and techniques, which will hopefully help you to repel the mosquitoes.
3.- Mosquito Activity: Check the estimated mosquito activity in your area and get helpful local information before heading outdoors.
Main characteristics of the mosquito repellent app:
- The app includes a low-frequency sound tool that lets you try different mosquito repellent sounds and frequencies. The sounds you can choose will have frequencies 8kHz, 10kHz, 12kHz, 14kHz, 15kHz and some more up to 21 and 22kHz, so that you have different frequencies you can try out. Those sounds are also commonly known as “anti mosquito sounds”.
- We have also created a great help section where we will give you some advice and tips on how to kill mosquitoes, mosquito bites, mosquito traps, homemade bug repellents or natural insect repellents and different remedies, which will explain you how to scare mosquitoes.
Premium Features:
- Mosquito Activity Today: Discover the estimated mosquito activity near you and check useful local information before going outside.
- Remove Ads: Use the app with a cleaner, smoother and uninterrupted experience.
- Exclusive Frequencies: Try extra anti mosquito sounds, high-frequency tones and experimental mosquito repellent frequencies.
- Auto Stop Timer: Choose when the sound should stop automatically.
We would like to expand the best mosquito repellent app with new sections and more information, like information about the different types of mosquitoes that exist (tiger mosquito, normal mosquito, anopheles, etc), possible diseases that could be transmitted, etc. For this reason, we look forward to your help, so if you liked our mosquito control app, a positive review will help us to keep improving and updating the app.
Information note: The effectiveness of low-frequency or high-frequency sounds for repelling mosquitoes has not been scientifically proven. Results may vary, and this tool should be considered a complementary feature rather than a replacement for proven mosquito protection methods.
This app has been created by Reticode. The commercial use of any content included in this app without prior authorization is prohibited.
Privacy policy: https://reticode.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://reticode.com/terms/terms-of-service-mosquitos.html

bluejetty:00117655:ios.name: FF IV: THE AFTER YEARS
bluejetty:00117655:ios.summary:
FINAL FANTASY IV: THE AFTER YEARS is available on iPhone, iPad!
With a full 3-D remake, FINAL FANTASY IV: THE AFTER YEARS can now be played as never before. Take part in the epic sequel that unfolds many years after the events of FINAL FAN
bluejetty:00117655:ios.description:
FINAL FANTASY IV: THE AFTER YEARS is available on iPhone, iPad!
With a full 3-D remake, FINAL FANTASY IV: THE AFTER YEARS can now be played as never before. Take part in the epic sequel that unfolds many years after the events of FINAL FANTASY IV. Classic characters make their return alongside several new heroes, such as Ceodore, son of Cecil and Rosa.
- Ten Playable Tales
Begin your journey with "Ceodore's Tale." Complete it to unlock the tales of six additional characters, which can be played in any order, and then return to the core story with "Kain's Tale," "The Lunarian's Tale," and "The Crystals." A total of ten tales in all, and all contained in FINAL FANTASY IV: THE AFTER YEARS.
- Active Time Battle
Take control of exhilarating combat made possible by the non-stop action in Square Enix's iconic battle system.
- Lunar Phases
Feel the moon's presence in combat, as its waxing and waning influences the potency of attacks and abilities of all combatants. Lunar phases cycle naturally with the passage of in-game time, or when resting at an inn, tent, or cottage.
- Band Abilities
Combine the strength of your party members to awesome effect with Band abilities that can be unlocked through in-game events or by leveling your characters' Affinity.
- Minimap
Keep an eye on your current location and nearby surroundings, or tap for quick access to the world map.
- Game Center Support
Step up to meet all-new challenges offered by dozens of achievements.
- Widescreen Support
Enjoy fullscreen display on iPhone 5, iPhone 5s, and iPhone 5c.
STORY
Seventeen years have passed since the war's end, and the son born to King Cecil and Queen Rosa of Baron has grown into a young man. Prince Ceodore has enlisted in the airship fleet known as the Red Wings, eager to meet the expectations demanded of his blood and station. Yet once more another moon has appeared in the sky, and with it vast hordes of monsters intent on destruction. The brief peace enjoyed by the Blue Planet now stands threatened under the shadow of impending catastrophe.

bluejetty:00130254:ios.description:
Everything you need to create images with AI!
Do you want to unblur, restore, and enhance any photo? Want to generate AI baby dance videos? Wondering what your future baby might look like? Or animate your own pictures? Try this app now! The AI Photo app can create amazing HD art photos using advanced AI technology — all in just one tap.
In addition, our app offers a wide range of features, including face aging, AI filtering, face-swapping, colorizing, photo-repairing, photo-retaking, and more. AI Photo uses cutting-edge AI technology to transform your photos and generate artistic images within seconds. It’s the ultimate tool for creating fun, surprising, and beautiful visuals.
Key Features:
► AI Photo Enhance
Whether you’re capturing old photos or uploading selfies, you can turn blurry images into crystal-clear HD photos with just one tap.
► AI Hairstyle Changer
Upload a selfie and instantly preview different hairstyles and hair colors. Try short cuts, long waves, curls, braids, bangs, and more to discover the look that suits you best — all with AI in just seconds!
► AI Retouch
Fix those imperfect moments with cutting-edge AI. Open closed eyes, correct blurry photos, and generate multiple perfect versions instantly.
► Aging Video
Curious about how you'll look when you're older? Use our fun, easy aging filter powered by AI to see yourself in the future — lifelike and entertaining.
► Animate Photo
Bring your photos to life with the Animate Photo feature. Turn still images into moving memories in seconds.
► AI Future Baby Generator
Upload two faces and let AI predict what your future baby might look like. A fun and heartwarming experience.
► AI Photo Generator
Turn your selfies into stylized photos — from LinkedIn profiles and business looks to wedding, vintage, and old-money aesthetics.
► AI Filter
Transform your photos into art with thousands of possible filters. Want to become your favorite superhero or character? It’s just one tap away!
► AI Face Swap
Swap faces in photos with realistic results. Become a princess, witch, celebrity, or anything you imagine — powered by AI.

bluejetty:00087010:ios.summary: Alchemy AI is an infinite craft alchemy game focused on experimenting with elements and discovering new combinations. Start with classic elements like Water, Fire, Earth, and Air, then combine them to create a wide range of new elements and
bluejetty:00087010:ios.description:
Alchemy AI is an infinite craft alchemy game focused on experimenting with elements and discovering new combinations. Start with classic elements like Water, Fire, Earth, and Air, then combine them to create a wide range of new elements and collections.
Inspired by little alchemy games and expanded with AI tech, Alchemy AI offers a deeper alchemy experience with more creativity freedom. Each session encourages experimentation as you explore how different elements interact and evolve.
Infinite Craft Gameplay:
Alchemy AI delivers a true infinite craft experience. Instead of relying on a small set of fixed recipes, the game allows you to combine elements freely and uncover new outcomes. As your alchemy collection grows, the number of possible combinations increases.
Advanced Element Mixing:
Mix up to four elements at once to unlock more complex results. Advanced alchemy mechanics introduce deeper logic and reward players who test creative or unusual element combinations.
Puzzle and Lab-Style Design:
This is a puzzle game built around logic, testing, and experimentation. If you enjoy lab-style gameplay where elements are the core mechanic, Alchemy AI provides a structured yet open-ended alchemy system to explore.
Discover and Progress:
-Unlock common, rare, epic, and legendary elements
-Earn recognition for unique alchemy discoveries
-Expand your infinite craft collection over time
-Take part in weekly challenges and limited-time events
A Growing Alchemy Experience:
New elements, crafting paths, and events are added regularly to keep the infinite craft gameplay fresh. Whether you’re a fan of alchemy games, cozy games, creative puzzles, or discovery systems, Alchemy AI offers a long-term experience centered on combining elements.
Start crafting and exploring the possibilities of alchemy today.

bluejetty:00177144:ios.name: MagiScan - AI 3D Scanner app
bluejetty:00177144:ios.summary: MagiScan is an AI-driven 3D scanning app. It easily captures real-world objects and turns them into 3D models, with various format choices like OBJ, STL, FBX, PLY, USDZ, GLB, GLTF, and more. Moreover, it can export these models to NVIDIA Om
bluejetty:00177144:ios.description:
MagiScan is an AI-driven 3D scanning app. It easily captures real-world objects and turns them into 3D models, with various format choices like OBJ, STL, FBX, PLY, USDZ, GLB, GLTF, and more. Moreover, it can export these models to NVIDIA Omniverse and integrate them smoothly into Minecraft as block structures.
With MagiScan, you don't need any specialized hardware or technical expertise. All you need is a smartphone camera and the app to get started. Whether you're an artist, designer, or engineer, MagiScan offers a fast and affordable way to create 3D models of real-life objects.
As a new user, you'll get a few scans for free without having to subscribe. This is a great way to get familiar with the app and see the quality of 3D models that MagiScan produces. Once you've used up your free scans, you can subscribe for unlimited access to the app's features.
Minecraft mode
Discover the all-new MagiScan's Minecraft mode - your key to a revolutionary gaming experience! Scan real-world objects, effortlessly convert them into 3D models, and seamlessly export them into your Minecraft adventures! 
DISCLAIMER: MagiScan is an unofficial app for Minecraft, not endorsed by Mojang AB. Mojang AB is not liable for MagiScan or its purchase. "Minecraft" name, brand, and assets belong to Mojang AB. MagiScan utilizes the term "Minecraft" as a secondary title, and the icon and screenshots are custom-designed, not from the official game assets.
NVIDIA Omniverse support
MagiScan has developed a plugin for NVIDIA Omniverse called MAGISCAN AI OMNIVERSE EXTENSION, which lets you combine MagiScan's capabilities with Omniverse. This plugin allows you to scan real-world objects with MagiScan and use the obtained data to create detailed 3D models in Omniverse. This unique partnership opens up new possibilities for creating unique and high-quality visual effects in various industries.
Room Plan
Room Plan in MagiScan is an innovative feature that utilizes AR and LIDAR technology for quickly creating 3D schematic floor plans with dimensions. It supports both metric and imperial units, making it a valuable tool for professionals and personal use. Compatible with NVIDIA Omniverse, it's available on LIDAR-equipped devices, starting from iPhone 12 Pro.
Point Cloud
With iOS device's LIDAR technology, users can now capture stunning 3D models like never before using Point Cloud 3D Scanning Mode in MagiScan. This mode opens up a world of possibilities, as it enables users to scan entire spaces and surroundings within a range of up to 5 meters, transforming reality into captivating 3D art.
Enjoy an intuitive user experience with automatic and manual scanning options for precise control. Customize your scans by adjusting LIDAR points and point size to match your creative vision. The resulting scans feature vibrant colors from the device's camera, with real-time tracking for perfect captures. Premium subscribers get unlimited access during the beta phase, with lightning-fast on-device processing, secure cloud storage, preview and easy export in various formats like PLY, XYZ, PTS, and PCD.
*** MagiScan PREMIUM ***
MagiScan PREMIUM Subscription offers you 10 additional scans every day. As soon as you subscribe, you will receive your first 10 scans, which will accumulate and stay with you forever.
Import photos from your device's gallery, drones, and professional cameras to capture incredibly detailed and precise images for your 3D models.
Capture photos offline and import them later when you have a stable connection.
Redefine reality with the Point Cloud Mode, available in PREMIUM.
Choose a yearly subscription for even greater savings with a substantial discount.
Get the best value for your money and enjoy a hassle-free scanning experience with MagiScan PREMIUM Subscription.

bluejetty:00026803:ios.name: Magic Earth Navigation & Maps
bluejetty:00026803:ios.summary:
As we celebrate the 10-year anniversary of Magic Earth on the App Store in 2025, our commitment to privacy and innovation has never been stronger.
Magic Earth is now freemium, giving everyone free access to core features like map browsing,
bluejetty:00026803:ios.description:
As we celebrate the 10-year anniversary of Magic Earth on the App Store in 2025, our commitment to privacy and innovation has never been stronger.
Magic Earth is now freemium, giving everyone free access to core features like map browsing, search, favorites, and turn-by-turn navigation.
For even more powerful features, Magic Earth Premium subscription unlocks:
• Traffic-aware navigation
• Activity recording
• Offline maps
• Elevation map style for clearer terrain visualization
To all our active subscribers: Thank you! Your continued support empowers us to build a better, more private Magic Earth for everyone.
Magic Earth uses OpenStreetMap data and a powerful search engine to offer you the optimal routes for driving, biking, hiking, and public transportation. Find the best route to your destination even without an internet connection.
PRIVACY FIRST!
• We do not track you. We do not profile you. We do not trade in your personal data; moreover, we do not have it.
MAPS
• Save big on mobile internet costs and navigate reliably with offline maps powered by OpenStreetMap. 233 countries and regions are ready to be downloaded. 
• Choose between 2D, 3D, and Satellite map views.
• Get ready for travel and know every detail of your route like surface, difficulty, distance and elevation profile.
• Learn more about the points of interest near you from Wikipedia articles.
• Spot nearby parking places to easily park your car. 
• Stay up-to-date and enjoy regular free map updates.
CARPLAY compatibility
• Connect to Apple CarPlay and enjoy the ultimate navigation experience.
NAVIGATION
• Find the fastest or the shortest route to your destination when you travel by car, bike, on foot or with public transport. 
• Plan your route with multiple waypoints.
• Stay safe with the free Head-up Display (HUD) feature which projects the most important navigation info onto the windshield of your car.
• Know in advance which lane to take with precise turn-by-turn navigation and lane assistance.
• Get notified about speed cameras and stay up to date with current speed limits. 
TRAFFIC INFO
• Get real-time traffic info, updated every minute.
• Discover alternative routes that avoid traffic jams and save you time on the road.
PUBLIC TRANSPORT
• Get around town quickly and easily. Choose from public transit routes that combine all transportation modes: bus / metro / subway / light rail / train / ferry 
• Get walking directions, transfer times, departure times, number of stops. And when available, the cost. 
• Find wheelchair or bike-friendly public transportation.
WEATHER
• View current temperature and local weather forecasts for your favorite locations.
• See what weather conditions to expect in the next hours and view the forecast for the next 14 days.
APPLE WATCH
• Take a quick glance at your Apple Watch to get directions, distance, speed and workout details in real-time-right on your wrist.
Notes:
* Some features are not available in all countries.
* Some features require internet connection.
Your free trial will be automatically renewed to a paid subscription if you don't cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The payment will be charged through your Apple ID account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless they are cancelled at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00061642:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061642:ios.description:
Meet iScanner—the AI-powered document scanner trusted by 145M+ users to scan, edit, and manage files.
Students, professionals, remote workers, teachers. For many, important documents still exist on paper when they should be digital. Built on 10+ years of scanning experience, iScanner solves that. Just point your camera at a contract, a receipt, or a handwritten note and get a clean file back. 
With iScanner, you can:
• Scan documents to PDF, JPG, DOC, or other formats with automatic quality correction.
• Sign PDFs, fill out forms, and annotate documents without switching apps.
• Extract text from any scan using built-in OCR in 20+ languages.
Here's what you get:
AI-POWERED DOCUMENT SCANNER
Got a crumpled receipt or a contract shot at an angle? iScanner's in-house AI automatically detects borders, straightens skewed pages, corrects colors, and removes shadows, fingerprints, and noise. The result looks like it was produced by a flatbed scanner. Export as PDF, JPG, DOC, XLS, PPT, or TXT.
ALL-IN-ONE DOCUMENT EDITOR
Unlike most scanner apps that stop at the scan, iScanner handles every step of document management. Sign by hand or from a photo, fill out forms, annotate pages, and redact sensitive text. Merge several scans into one file, split pages, send a fax, and organize them into folders with drag and drop.
OCR & AI PDF ASSISTANT
Built-in OCR turns printed text into editable content in 20+ languages—copy it, convert the scan to a DOC or TXT file, or search any PDF. Got a dense contract or a document in a foreign language? AI Chat can summarize, translate, rewrite, or answer specific questions about it.
PRIVACY & DOCUMENT SECURITY
Passports, medical records, financial documents. Some files belong on your device, not a shared cloud. iScanner keeps them there by default, with no third-party access. Lock the app with a PIN, Face ID, or Touch ID. Password-protect PDFs, set expiration dates on shared links, and add a decoy password that opens a fake version of the app.
SPECIALIZED SCANNING MODES
Beyond everyday documents: create secure digital copies of passports, ID cards, and driver's licenses. Photograph a math equation and solve it instantly. Measure object dimensions, count similar objects, and read QR codes—all in one app.
CROSS-DEVICE ACCESS
Files sync through secure AWS cloud storage and are available to manage from any browser using the web version. Import from Gmail, Google Drive, and Apple Files.
PAPERLESS IMPACT
Since 2015, iScanner has helped millions of people replace printouts with digital files. Track your real environmental impact inside the app and earn eco certificates for going paperless.
Download iScanner—the AI-powered document scanner that handles everything from the first scan to the final signature.
FAQ
Q: Can I scan multiple pages into one PDF?
A: Yes—scan as many pages as you need and combine them into a single file.
Q: Does iScanner work without an internet connection?
A: Yes—scanning, editing, and viewing files all work offline; only cloud sync and backups need a connection.
Q: How do I transfer my documents to a new phone?
A: Sign in on your new device and everything restores automatically from iScanner's cloud storage.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• iScanner Pro unlocks all scanner features
• You won’t be charged until your purchase is confirmed
• Your subscription will auto-renew 24 hours before its expiration date
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store settings
Privacy Policy: http://iscanner.com/mobileapp/privacy
Terms of Use: http://iscanner.com/mobileapp/terms
We’d love to hear from you! Please leave a review to help us make our document scanner even better. You can also get in touch with us at http://iscannerapp.com/scanner/support.

bluejetty:00123666:ios.name: Age of Conquest IV
bluejetty:00123666:ios.summary: Age of Conquest is a turn-based grand strategy wargame. Command your armies in one of the many ancient and medieval countries including the Roman Empire, the Inca, France, Russia, Japan or the Chinese Dynasties. From Rome to Asian nations,
bluejetty:00123666:ios.description:
Age of Conquest is a turn-based grand strategy wargame. Command your armies in one of the many ancient and medieval countries including the Roman Empire, the Inca, France, Russia, Japan or the Chinese Dynasties. From Rome to Asian nations, you create your own warring experience. Wage colossal wars solo, against the AI, or take on your gaming friends in cross-platform multiplayer games. Form alliances and fight co-op style with the AI and other players for ultimate victory.
Range of functionality is comprised of expansion, diplomacy and managing your nation's finances and economy. You do your best to keep your population happy. You forge alliances and together you take on your enemies. Are you ready for the challenge? Will your place be in the history books or in the mud? Assemble your armies, take on the world and achieve greatness in this epic historical strategy game.
 - Turn-based grand strategy game with maps & nations from all over the world.
 - Challenging AI for single player games based on a genetic algorithm.
 - Cross-platform multiplayer & hotseat-Play including co-op team games.
 - Diplomacy management of economy & population.
 - Map scenarios including Europe, Colonization, Asian Empires, World Conquest and many more.
 - Map editor and a central server to host and distribute player-modded bundles.
 - Empires including the Roman Empire, Carthage, Persia, Celts and Inca amongst others.
 - High score, playing statistics, achievements and multiplayer ELO-ranking.
 - Engaging music, sound effects and fantastic graphics.

Just pick up to 5 photos within the Photos app, tap share and choose '
bluejetty:00179489:ios.description:
Navigate to Photo is a convenient way to navigate to any photo taken with location data, with your favorite navigation app, from any app using iOS built-in share sheet!
Just pick up to 5 photos within the Photos app, tap share and choose 'Navigate to Photo'.
Want to visit that nice place you've been to last week, but don't remember how to get there? It's not a problem anymore with Navigate to Photo!
MUST HAVE! Still wondering why this is not a standard iOS functionality. It's never been easier to return to the places you've been to before.
FEATURES:
- Select up to 5 photos, see all of them on the map simultaneously and navigate to the one of your choice. 
- Innovative auto-detection of navigation apps available on your device.
- Incredibly easy to set up the list of your favorite navigation apps, which can be re-arranged for your convenience.
- We strive to keep our list of supported navigation apps as complete as possible. If your favorite navigation app is not on the list, you can request an app added by contacting us within the app.
- Full iOS 14 and DARK mode support.
LIST OF SUPPORTED NAVIGATION APPS:
- Apple Maps
- AutoMapa
- Citymapper
- Gaia GPS
- Guru Maps (Galileo Offline Maps)
- Garmin U.S.
- Google Maps
- HERE WeGo
- iGo primo
- Lyft
- Maps.me
- MotionX GPS
- MotionX GPS Drive
- MotionX GPS HD
- NAVIGON
- Navmii GPS (Navfree GPS)
- Pocket Earth
- Scout Navigation
- Sygic Navigation
- TomTom (only pre-GO Mobile versions are supported)
- Transit App
- Uber
- Waze
- Yandex.Navigator
FACTS AND REVIEWS:
#2 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Czech Republic
#4 Top-Paid app in Navigation in the Netherlands
#5 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Belgium
#6 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Saudi Arabia
#7 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Poland
#7 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Spain
#9 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Mexico
#10 Top-Paid app in Navigation in Italy

Banking Made Easy

Stay in Control

Security You Can Trust

bluejetty:00083618:ios.name: Penjo: Pencil Journal, Planner
bluejetty:00083618:ios.summary: Penjo is a digital journal and planner you write by hand. In the morning, today's page shows your Apple Calendar events and reminders, and you plan around them with Apple Pencil or your finger. By evening, the same page is your diary, with
bluejetty:00083618:ios.description:
Penjo is a digital journal and planner you write by hand. In the morning, today's page shows your Apple Calendar events and reminders, and you plan around them with Apple Pencil or your finger. By evening, the same page is your diary, with notes, sketches and photos of the day, and iCloud keeps it on your iPad, iPhone and Mac. Later, search finds the words you wrote, even in your handwriting.
In September 2026, the App Store featured Penjo in "Make the Most of Apple Pencil" in 173 countries.
PLAN WITH YOUR CALENDAR
• See your Apple Calendar events and Apple Reminders on the day page and in the week and month views, including Google and Exchange calendars. Add, edit and complete them without leaving Penjo.
• Reminders you haven't finished from earlier days appear under Overdue on today's page.
• On iPad and Mac, the day drawer keeps the day's plans beside your page as you move from day to day.
• See your week at a glance, with each day's page and plans. The month page is a canvas too, for a habit tracker or a mood chart.
MAKE IT YOURS
• Give each journal its own look: 18 cover colors, 20 paper colors, and blank, lined, grid or dotted paper in different spacings.
• Use Day Mode for a page every day, or List Mode for occasional notes, class notes, trips or scrapbooks.
• Choose fonts and colors for your text, set up your own Apple Pencil tool palette, and pick light or dark.
WRITE YOUR DAY
• Every page starts blank on the paper you chose, and you decide what goes where. Add more pages to a day when you need them.
• Penjo can straighten the lines you draw, and you can scribble over words to erase them.
• Photos: remove the background, add a sticker effect or an instant photo frame, flip a photo or clip it to a shape, right on the page. Add text boxes, shapes and maps too.
• Add moments from your day and gratitude prompts with Journaling Suggestions, and use Writing Tools and Image Playground on supported devices.
SYNCED AND PRIVATE
• iCloud keeps your journals in sync on iPad, iPhone, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. They stay in your own iCloud, and we never see what you write.
• Lock the app or a single journal with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode.
• Export a day, week or month as a PDF, or back up and transfer whole journals as .penjo files.
LOOK BACK
• Search also finds the text in your photos, with text recognition on your device.
• On This Day shows what you wrote on the same date in earlier years.
READY FOR THE NEWEST APPLE DEVICES
• The Liquid Glass design on iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and later, in your journal's colors.
• iPhone Duo: open it like a book, with the page on one side and the day's events and reminders on the other, or set it half open on a table and write on the flat half. Fold it shut and the journal closes.
• Home Screen widgets, and Penjo in 22 languages.
FREE AND UNLIMITED
Penjo is free to start, with no account to create: 3 journals and 14 day pages in each. Penjo Unlimited adds Apple Calendar and Reminders, iCloud sync, unlimited journals and pages, app and journal locks, PDF export and .penjo backups, on all your devices. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or pay once with Lifetime. Family Sharing is available on the monthly plan.
Questions? Every message gets a personal reply.
support@penjoapp.com
Privacy Policy: https://penjoapp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

By evening, the same page is your diary, with notes, sketches and photos of the day, and iCloud keeps it on your iPad, iPhone and Mac. Later, search finds the words you wrote, even in your handwriting.

In September 2026, the App Store featured Penjo in "Make the Most of Apple Pencil" in 173 countries.

PLAN WITH YOUR CALENDAR
• See your Apple Calendar events and Apple Reminders on the day page and in the week and month views, including Google and Exchange calendars. Add, edit and complete them without leaving Penjo.
• Reminders you haven't finished from earlier days appear under Overdue on today's page.
• On iPad and Mac, the day drawer keeps the day's plans beside your page as you move from day to day.
• See your week at a glance, with each day's page and plans. The month page is a canvas too, for a habit tracker or a mood chart.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Give each journal its own look: 18 cover colors, 20 paper colors, and blank, lined, grid or dotted paper in different spacings.
• Use Day Mode for a page every day, or List Mode for occasional notes, class notes, trips or scrapbooks.
• Choose fonts and colors for your text, set up your own Apple Pencil tool palette, and pick light or dark.

WRITE YOUR DAY
• Every page starts blank on the paper you chose, and you decide what goes where. Add more pages to a day when you need them.
• Penjo can straighten the lines you draw, and you can scribble over words to erase them.
• Photos: remove the background, add a sticker effect or an instant photo frame, flip a photo or clip it to a shape, right on the page. Add text boxes, shapes and maps too.
• Add moments from your day and gratitude prompts with Journaling Suggestions, and use Writing Tools and Image Playground on supported devices.

SYNCED AND PRIVATE
• iCloud keeps your journals in sync on iPad, iPhone, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. They stay in your own iCloud, and we never see what you write.
• Lock the app or a single journal with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode.
• Export a day, week or month as a PDF, or back up and transfer whole journals as .penjo files.

LOOK BACK
• Search also finds the text in your photos, with text recognition on your device.
• On This Day shows what you wrote on the same date in earlier years.

READY FOR THE NEWEST APPLE DEVICES
• The Liquid Glass design on iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and later, in your journal's colors.
• iPhone Duo: open it like a book, with the page on one side and the day's events and reminders on the other, or set it half open on a table and write on the flat half. Fold it shut and the journal closes.
• Home Screen widgets, and Penjo in 22 languages.

FREE AND UNLIMITED
Penjo is free to start, with no account to create: 3 journals and 14 day pages in each. Penjo Unlimited adds Apple Calendar and Reminders, iCloud sync, unlimited journals and pages, app and journal locks, PDF export and .penjo backups, on all your devices. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or pay once with Lifetime. Family Sharing is available on the monthly plan.

Questions? Every message gets a personal reply.
support@penjoapp.com
Privacy Policy: https://penjoapp.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

DOWNLOAD NOW

EMOJIS :D

SEASONAL QUIZ PACKS

● Christmas, Christmas Emoji, Star Santa
● Winter, Spring, Summer, Fall/Autumn
● Halloween, Thanksgiving

SONG & MUSIC

SOCCER

NOSTALGIA

We believe that inclusivity, respect and community are values that truly make a connection great. That’s why we've worked hard to build an LBTQ dating app that upholds those values at every step.
The Wapa community is a welcoming and judgment-free space where you can connect with LBTQ women safely. With our Verified Photos feature, you can see proof that the other person is genuine. Verifying your photos through Wapa is simple and secure. No ID necessary, so your privacy is always protected.
Whether you are a lesbian, trans, bi, or queer woman – Wapa is committed to providing a safe and friendly environment. Join the Wapa community and connect in a supportive place made just for you. Find friends, dates and so much more!
Meet single women in your area or around the world. Send unlimited messages and translate discussions instantly. Whether you're looking for new friends or lasting love – connect with authentic LBTQ+ women locally and from around the world on Wapa.
TOP FEATURES OUR USERS LOVE
SAFE & SECURE
Wapa is committed to providing a safe and protected environment.
- Fully moderated for your safety
- Passcode lock the app for added privacy
- User photos are all reviewed by our team
- Real human support is only a tap away – just use our in-app live chat
FUN & INCLUSIVE LBTQ DATING
Find community, love, or friendship. Regardless of what you’re looking for, you belong.
- Easily upload your photos and find a date in just a few taps
- Wapa is the dating app made for every lesbian, bi, trans, queer woman
- Use Tracks to see who has viewed your profile
- Get push notifications, so you never miss a connection
FIND YOUR MATCH WITH EASE
Dating on Wapa is easy, fun and exciting!
- Filter your search by age, location, and more to find the perfect date
- Our filtering tools are easy to use, so we only show you people you’re interested in 
- Send and receive unlimited video and audio messages
- With no daily limits, you can match with as many users as you’d like
- Save your matches in your favorites section
CHAT WITH WOMEN LOCALLY AND AROUND THE WORLD
- No matter where you are, you can match with LBTQ women from anywhere
- Traveling? Meet and connect with local women in other countries before you go
- Translate languages instantly in-chat so language is never a barrier
Wapa is safe LBTQ dating for everyone.
Your safety is our top priority. We created our Photo Verification system to help protect you and others. Know who you’re talking to without having to give away your personal, identifying information. 
UNLOCK BONUS FEATURES & REMOVE ADS
Subscribe to Premium and we’ll give you full access to our app AD FREE and packed with extra features! Upload extra photos to your profile, choose to lock pictures and send longer videos. You also get priority support and quicker photo approval!
