All kinds of handsome confidants and fans will follow and grow with you to overcome your obstacles. They will bear witness to your ascension to become the most outstanding streamer.
[Hundreds of styles and fashion to choose from]
The ever-changing fashion style and rich matching outfits allows you to be dressed from head to toe, from the coolest futuristic style to being a sweet loli. Leading the fashion trend, the spotlight is all centered on you. Don't forget to put on your makeup too. From the mature style of a Korean to the sweet style of a Japanese lady is all included! Do you want to be an innocent angel or a sexy-looking girl? It is all up to you!
[Handsome guys full of personality and thrilling dates]
Favoured by the God of Luck, you have chances to have some wonderful encounters. Domineering presidents, newbies in the entertainment industry... 5 different handsome men, there must be one that could capture your heart. Dating with different men, chating online with sweet conversation, both of them becoming true! Here will be a real emotional experience!
[Manage your own team and increase your ability]
You can build your own team. Recruiting members, expanding the size of your studio and power, making the streaming business flourish. A strong team will be your back on your acting career, solving your problems and always staying with you.
[Interesting Events, work and entertainment]
In your free time, apart from the busy life of an artist, you also have time of your own. You can go out for a walk and have your favourite afternoon tea with your favourite guy, go shopping at clothing store to buy new clothes for yourself or study with your team in the Library. Even if you are shopping aimlessly, there might be unexpected surprises waiting for you!

bluejetty:00015399:ios.description:
Educational Math for Kids 123 is an award-winning math learning app for 4, 5 and 6-year-olds which provides a cool way to start your child’s journey in the world of math.
Kindergarteners, preschoolers, and toddlers are always eager to learn numbers, counting & shapes. The app is a complete program with cool math games where kids can learn counting, addition, subtraction and more!  
Kids can learn shapes such as square, circle, a triangle with popping, tracing and matching. 4, 5 and 6-year-olds will have a great time learning numbers from 1-100 with a variety of addictive games!
The perfect way of learning numbers! Have your kid count and develop his or her skills through fun math games!
FEATURES
Number Sense: Learn the numbers!
Geometry: Learn the basic shapes!
Counting: Learn to count up to 100!
Categorizing: Learn to sort and categorize in groups!
Comparison: Compare objects based on their properties!
Patterns: Learn to recognize and identify! 
Math Skills: Learn to add & subtract!
Subscription Details:
- Subscribe to get access to full content including future updates.
- Payment will be charged to Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Manage App Subscriptions in your Apple Settings.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- An account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- Use the subscription in any iPad/iPhone/iPod registered with your Apple account.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: http://www.kidlo.com/privacypolicy.php
Terms of service: http://www.kidlo.com/terms_of_service.php
If you need help or have any feedback, email us at support@kidlo.com
***It’s never too early to start learning! Download now and make sure your child is gonna be 1st in class!***

bluejetty:00081140:ios.description:
The ultimate teleprompter app trusted by creators, influencers, and live streamers on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and more.
Never forget your lines again — record your videos smoothly in just one take!
Why Choose Teleprompter?
Simply paste or sync your script into the teleprompter panel and start recording. The app will scroll your lines automatically, helping you stay confident and natural in front of the camera — whether you’re filming content or live streaming.
 Key Features:
Live Streaming Assistant
Control the teleprompter panel remotely via a browser on the same Wi-Fi network. Update your script in real time during live streams — fast and convenient.
 Intelligent Auto-Scroll
The script scrolls at a speed that matches your speech rhythm. Speak naturally while the app adjusts automatically — perfect for recording short-form videos.
 Floating Window Teleprompter
Overlay the teleprompter on any other app. Compatible with third-party beauty cameras. Supports both portrait and landscape modes.
Fully Customizable
Adjust board width, font size, font color, scroll speed, and background transparency to suit your recording style and environment.
Fast Script Import
Import scripts with one tap from DOC/DOCX/TXT files, photos (OCR), voice input, or even videos and images — boost your efficiency.
Cloud Sync & Backup
Access your saved videos and scripts from multiple devices, anytime, anywhere.
Perfect For:
 Content creators & influencers
 Online educators & coaches
 YouTubers & TikTokers
 Live streamers & video marketers
Make your video creation smarter, faster, and smoother — with Teleprompter.

bluejetty:00141613:ios.description:
Lalalab is the best app to print your photos easily from your iPhone. In just a few clicks, turn all your favourite memories into prints, photo albums, posters, and more - and get them delivered right to your doorstep. Whether for you or someone you love, there’s a Lalalab product for everyone. Our app has been used over 13 million times! 
◆ THE HIGHEST-RATED PRINTING APP ◆ 
Simple and intuitive, our app has been used to send millions of smiles around the world. All our products are printed exclusively in Europe to ensure optimal quality and fast delivery. Create, order, and enjoy! We guarantee you’ll love it.
◆ PRINT YOUR BEST MOMENTS IN 5 MINUTES ◆
Create unique photo products in just a few minutes thanks to a super-intuitive, easy-to-use interface. Putting together a photo album has never been so simple! Want to really make it yours? Customise your photos with filters, colourful backgrounds, captions, and emojis.
◆ THERE ARE SO MANY REASONS TO USE LALALAB ◆
- Decorate your space with memories you love
- Make your loved ones happy with unique, personalised gifts
- Create lasting souvenirs out of family moments that you can revisit again and again
- Relive your last holiday!
◆ PLEASING PRODUCTS FOR EVERYONE ◆
- PRINTS: Our most-loved product! Choose from 6 formats, matte or gloss finish, framed or borderless… There’s something for everyone. 
- PHOTO ALBUMS: Create books containing anywhere from 26 to 100 photos, available in landscape, square, or mini formats. Fun to flip through again and again! - PHOTO BOXES: Keep all your best moments in a beautiful photo box that holds up to 150 prints. Choose from your favourite formats: Mini-Vintage, Vintage, or Classic! 
- MAGNETS: Heart, circle, or Mini-Vintage shapes! Your fridge will thank you.
- POSTERS: Show off your favourite photos with a single large image or a mosaic of many.
- CANVASES: Turn your favourite photos into art. Comes in 30x30cm or 50x50cm. 
- FRAMES: a ready-to-hang print in a black or natural-wood frame 
- CALENDAR: keep track of your year with our square or landscape calendars 
- POSTCARDS: easily send postcards from your weekends and holidays to friends and family
Check out all our latest products and updates in the app.
◆ HOW DOES IT WORK? ◆
LALALAB. lets you print photos in multiple formats, including prints, albums, posters, magnets, postcards, and more. We strive to offer you quality products and fast, high-quality, easy-to-use functionalities. Your photos are waiting!
- Select the product of your choice from prints, albums, posters, magnets, and more.
- Upload your photos from your iPhone, Instagram feed, Facebook or Dropbox.
- Personalise your product as much as you like with a wide range of colours, backgrounds, and text options.
- We’ll auto-save your unfinished creations so you can come back to them later if you’d prefer.
- Place your order securely using Apple Pay, Paypal, or a credit/debit card. 
- Receive your order (wrapped carefully and sent with love) at home or at a pick-up point near you.
◆ ABOUT LALALAB ◆
With more than 3 million clients, Lalalab is the most downloaded and highest-rated printing app in Europe! Enjoy all your most cherished moments again and again with our products. 
Created in France in 2012, Lalalab became a proud member of Exacompta-Clairefontaine in 2015. Our beautiful photo products are produced exclusively in Europe (in France and Germany, to be precise) in order to ensure fast delivery and excellent quality.
Become part of our community of over 500,000 on social media by following us on Instagram, Facebook, and Pinterest. @lalalab #photography #memories #love #inspiration
It’s easy to get in touch with us! Simply write to contact@lalalab.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

bluejetty:00172614:ios.description:
SIMPLE TO USE
Track all your services in one user-friendly app. You can easily order and manage individual services.
PLANS
Choose a plan that fits your lifestyle. A plan is a set of products and services for everyday banking, which includes an account, a card, payments, and ATM withdrawals.

Use multiple currencies in one account. You can exchange money within your account in a few seconds and simply pay in the local currency abroad, wherever you go.
CHOOSE YOUR OWN ACCOUNT NUMBER AND NAME IT
Set your own account number, for example, your birthday or wedding anniversary. You can name the account whatever you like.
SAVINGS ACCOUNT AND ENVELOPES
Open a savings account online and have up to 10 savings envelopes. Organize your money into envelopes for whatever you need.
CARD ORDERING AND MANAGEMENT
In KB+ you can order, unlock, and lock a card or view the PIN. Choose one of the designs offered and add your card to Apple Pay.
KB KLÍČ IS NOW PART OF KB+
You no longer need 2 apps to verify payments and logins. Now you can do everything in the KB+ app.
DRAG AND DROP PAYMENTS
Move money quickly and easily between your accounts and savings envelopes with a simple drag and drop.
TOUCH ID AND FACE ID
Make app login and payment verification easier with Touch ID or Face ID. Just use your finger or scan your face.
3D TOUCH
Long press the KB+ app icon on your mobile to choose from the most used features.
SPOTLIGHT
Explore the ability to search KB+ app features through Spotlight.
BUILDING SAVINGS
Get state support of up to 2,000 CZK per year and enrich your savings with a guaranteed interest rate for 6 years.
EXTRA SERVICE CESTOVÁNÍ
Insure yourself against unexpected events on the road. With the extra service Cestování, you won't be caught off guard by a traffic accident, lost luggage, or a trip cancellation. The service is valid all year round.
SUPPLEMENTARY PENSION SAVINGS
Save and invest for retirement. In KB+, you can now arrange a pension not only for yourself, but for your child too. In addition, your child can collect a third of their own contributions from the age of 18.
CHILDREN'S SAVINGS ACCOUNT
Save for your child with a great interest rate. You can open an account via the application. Additionally, your child can manage their own account from the age of 6, and from 15, they can open an account on their own.
PLAN FOR ENTREPRENEURS
Open and manage your business account in the app. Share access to it with managers or your accountant. With higher-level plans, you also get a multicurrency account for free.

bluejetty:00093411:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00093411:ios.description:
Hello everyone!
If you are a user of the older Insteon for Hub app, are using a Hub 2 (2245-222), and haven’t yet tried this newer app version, here are some great enhancements to know about:
This app is an entirely new experience, redesigned to simplify how you manage your home. Bold tiles give you quick access to your devices and scenes. New one-touch actions make it easy to quickly control multiple devices in your home all from the same screen. And adding favorites is now as simple as tapping a single icon.
The app also brings new features to Insteon, including a Schedules view that makes it easier to see what’s happening in your home throughout the day. We’ve also added one of the most-requested features to schedules: sunrise and sunset offsets, so your scenes can occur up to 4 hours before or after the sun goes up or down in your local area. 
We’ve added sensor check-in tracking so that if your sensor supports heartbeat broadcasts, we will let you know when it’s time to check the battery or other communication issues.
You’ll also find that everything in the app is faster. From logging in to navigating between screens, you can expect a faster, fluid experience. Statuses display quickly—no more waiting for each individual device to update. You’ll see the most significant improvements in creating and editing scenes. We’ve completely overhauled how we manage scene updates, in many cases bringing the experience down from minutes to seconds (depending on scene complexity).
Here are some high-level things you should know about the new mobile app before you dive in.
--Faster time from launch to device control - Depending on device you can be in less than 3 seconds from launch
--Faster scene creation - Depending on the complexity of the scene, up to 80% faster in some cases
--Easier scheduling – Schedule multiple devices for the same time without the need to create scenes
[Device Support]
Wired-in Devices
--i3 Dial, Paddle, Outlet and Keypad
--Paddle Switch and Dimmer
--Toggle Switch and Dimmer
--Keypad On/Off and Dimmer
--Inline On/Off and Dimmer
--Micro On/Off, Dimmer, and Open/Close
--Dual Outlet
--Outlet Dimmer
--Ceiling Fan and Light Controller
--240V Controller
--Ballast Dimmer
--Din Rail On/Off and Dimmer
--Wired Thermostat
Plug-ins and bulbs:
--Dimmer Module
--On/Off Module
--Outdoor On/Off Module
--LED Bulbs
--I/O Module (aka IOLinc)
--Siren
--Range Extender
Sensors:
--Hidden Door Sensor
--Open Close Sensor
--Leak Sensor
--Motion Sensor
--Motion Sensor II
[Requirements]
Compatible with North American Hub 2 (2245-222) and requires access to Insteon Hub service. Learn more at http://www.insteon.com/hub

PRIVACY FIRST

ONE-TIME PURCHASE

firefox-addons:3131416.name: Jatayu Passwords
firefox-addons:3131416.summary: Your Jatayu passwords, codes and passkeys in Firefox.
firefox-addons:3131416.description:
Jatayu Passwords brings your Jatayu vault to Firefox. Sign in once and your passwords, verification codes and passkeys are ready to fill on every site.
FILL IN ONE CLICK
• Logins for the site you're on appear under the username and password fields, and at the top of the toolbar popup.
• Ctrl+Shift+L (⌘+Shift+L on Mac) fills the login for the current site.
• Jatayu only offers a login on the site it was saved for, checked against the page's real address.
SAVE AS YOU GO
• After you sign in somewhere new, Jatayu offers to save the login, or to update it when you change a password.
• Creating an account? Pick "Use a strong password" in the password field.
VERIFICATION CODES
• Your two-step codes from the Jatayu app, live in Firefox.
• In a code field, Jatayu suggests the code for that site. Click any code in the popup to copy it.
PASSKEYS
• Sign in with passkeys saved in Jatayu, and save new ones as you create them.
• Passkeys sync with the Jatayu app on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your vault is encrypted on your device before it syncs. Turn on Advanced protection in the Jatayu app and only your master password can open it.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking. The extension talks only to Jatayu's sync service.
Requires a free Jatayu account with sync. Set up your vault in the Jatayu app first, then connect the extension from the toolbar popup.

fdroid:ru.netstatus.app.name: White List?
fdroid:ru.netstatus.app.summary: Detect whitelist-only mobile Internet with lightweight HTTPS probes.
fdroid:ru.netstatus.app.description:
Note: the app's interface is in Russian only — it is aimed at users in Russia, so the screenshots are in Russian too.
White List? is a free, open-source network diagnostic tool. When you have a signal but only some sites load, it helps you tell what is going on.
It sends lightweight HTTPS probes to several groups of websites and gives a probabilistic verdict:
- All good — unrestricted access
- Looks like a whitelist — only an allowed set of resources is reachable
- No Internet — no connectivity at all
- Looks like a VPN (outside your country) — traffic appears to exit elsewhere
It is a diagnostic tool, not a VPN or a bypass tool. It unblocks nothing — it only checks reachability and reports a likely state.
Features: home-screen widget, background monitoring with change notifications, a check journal with CSV export, per-site live status, operator detection, Android TV support, light and dark themes.
Privacy: only INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and POST_NOTIFICATIONS permissions. No ads, no trackers, no proprietary dependencies.
